raw.excerpt: At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone.
raw.description:
At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone. We put people first, and work hand in hand with employees and customers to create a diverse and inclusive environment. Passionate about building insurance and financial services solutions, we push the boundaries of what’s possible. We need you to help us shape what’s next. You’ll be encouraged to share your experiences, ideas and skills to help others take control of their financial future.

Join a team that has received numerous awards for being a top place to work: TruStage awards and recognition

Job Purpose:


This position leads sourcing and contracting activities in support of category strategies and business initiatives at TruStage and is responsible for achieving cost-effective procurement outcomes while maintaining and improving product quality and supplier service levels. They partner closely with stakeholders across Procurement, business areas, and internal support functions to deliver cost-effective solutions, support supplier performance, and achieve business outcomes. Adopts best practices that drive simplification, standardization, and operational efficiency.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Conduct RFx, guides supplier selection process, and executes contracting process
  • Work to minimize the total cost of transactions and helps to identify ways to transition more spend to the strategic categories over time
  • Leverage existing sourcing strategies for spend categories as appropriate
  • Ensure that all purchases made adhere to policies and procedures
  • Upholds internal and external policies, regulations and laws
  • Drive best practices across processes and procedures. Identifies ideas to improve process.
  • Leading cross-functional teams to develop and implement category strategies
  • Uphold internal and external policies, regulations and laws

The above statement of duties is not intended to be all inclusive and other duties will be assigned from time to time.


Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, IT, Engineering or related field.
  • 3-5 years related work experience in Procurement.
  • Demonstrated expert team facilitation, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage entire order to payment process.
  • Ability to translate the identified requirements into clear, comprehensive, consistent, and mutually exclusive requirements.
  • Highly effective listening, interpersonal, influencing, team work, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to comply with existing/quickly adapt to new processes within the organization.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; Able to forge internal customer/ external supplier relationships.
  • Service oriented.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish priorities and manage deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience sourcing and negotiating categories: software, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity or other technology solutions.
  • Experience negotiating software licenses, subscription, and technology services agreements
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating contracts involving artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities and AI-related commercial terms
  • Experience in highly regulated industries

If you’re ready to help make a difference, apply today.A resume is required to apply. TruStage may process applicant information using an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool.This tool automatically generates a screening score based on how well applicant information matches the requirements and qualifications for the position. TruStage recruiters use the screening score as a guide to further evaluate candidates; the score is one component of an application review and does not automatically determine whether a candidate moves forward.Candidates may choose to opt out of this process.

Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan and exemption status.

Base Salary Range:

$83,100.00 - $124,700.00

At TruStage, we believe a sound, inclusive benefits program is of vital importance, along with a flexible workplace that allows for work-life balance, career growth and retirement assistance. In addition to your base pay, your position may be eligible for an annual incentive (bonus) plan. Additional benefits available to eligible employees include medical, dental, vision, employee assistance program, life insurance, disability plans, parental leave, paid time off, 401k, and tuition reimbursement, just to name a few. Beyond pay and benefits, we also recognize that flexibility, including working in a place you prefer, is essential to caring for our employees. We will continue to strive to offer flexibility and invest in technology and other tools that will make hybrid working normal rather than an exception, so that when “life happens,” you can focus on what’s most important.

Accommodation request

TruStage is a place where everyone can bring their best self and thrive. If you need application or interview process accommodations, please contact the accessibility department.

The associate will design and refine training programs and blended learning journeys, while coordinating with facilitators and client stakeholders to ensure effective delivery. Daily responsibilities involve working with learning management systems, creating or improving learning content, tracking program effectiveness through data and feedback, and preparing reports and recommendations for clients. The role also collaborates with internal teams to continuously improve frameworks, tools, and processes that support talent development and organizational effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess skills in Training & Development to plan, deliver, and evaluate blended learning and capability-building interventions.

  • Experience with assessments, competency frameworks, and data-driven evaluation of learning outcomes.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple projects, and meet client timelines.

  • Familiarity with e-learning authoring tools, gamified learning approaches, and blended learning models is beneficial.

raw.title: Director, Rare Disease Product Marketing & Sales Enablement
raw.excerpt: Position OverviewWe are seeking a Director of Product Marketing & Sales Enablement to shape how Zenith genomics is positioned, explained, and adopted in the rare disease market.
raw.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing & Sales Enablement to shape how Zenith genomics is positioned, explained, and adopted in the rare disease market. Rare disease diagnostics is a market where the standard playbook doesn't apply: the ordering audience is specialized, the diagnostic odyssey is long, and every clinician interaction has to count.

This leader owns the work that turns strategy into field results: how our value is told, what the sales team carries into the room, how well the field is trained, and how quickly a new account moves from first conversation to routine ordering. You will partner closely with the marketing leader who owns clinical community engagement (KOLs, conferences, and speaker programs), and with Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and corporate Commercial Operations, to ensure a single, integrated go-to-market plan.

The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a roll-up-your-sleeves mindset, and is equally comfortable in a messaging workshop, a field ride-along, and a funnel dashboard. As the business scales, this role is expected to grow into a team.

Key Responsibilities

Product Marketing & Messaging

  • Positioning & Messaging: Own product positioning and the core messaging framework for Zenith, translating complex genomic science into clear value propositions for clinicians, genetic counselors, and health systems.
  • Collateral & Content: Lead development of sales and customer-facing assets (brochures, leave-behinds, clinical summaries, sell sheets, digital content), including the claims library and MLR / compliance review workflow.
  • Competitive Intelligence: Maintain a current view of the rare disease genomics landscape and equip the field with differentiated, evidence-based positioning.
  • Evidence Integration: Work with Medical and Clinical teams to convert new publications, real-world data, and utilization insights into messaging and field tools.
  • Launch Support: Own the product marketing workstream of the Zenith launch plan, including launch messaging, asset readiness, and field communications.

Sales Enablement & Customer Adoption

  • Field Enablement: Design and run onboarding, training, and ongoing education for the sales team on the science, the competitive landscape, and the value story; equip reps to be credible with geneticists and specialists.
  • Customer Adoption Journey: Map and continuously improve the path from first call to routine ordering, including implementation, EMR integration touchpoints, and utilization resources, to shorten time to adoption.
  • Sales Interface: Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing partner to Sales leadership; run regular field feedback loops and translate what reps and customers are telling us into messaging, tools, and priorities.
  • Market Access Pull-Through: Partner with Market Access and Reimbursement to convert coverage and payer developments into field-ready tools and messaging.

Commercial Insights & Targeting

  • Segmentation & Targeting: Partner with Sales and corporate analytics to define customer segments and account prioritization using clinical, claims, and market data; inform target lists and field focus.
  • Performance Tracking: Define the KPIs that track funnel health, ordering behavior, and adoption for the BU, and use insights to adjust messaging, enablement, and resource focus.
  • Sales Operations Liaison: Represent the Rare Disease BU's needs to corporate Commercial Operations (CRM, reporting, forecasting, and ordering workflow) and ensure the field has clean data and low-friction processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Integrated Planning: Partner with the clinical community marketing lead (KOL, conferences, speaker programs) so that field events, thought-leader engagement, and product messaging operate as one plan.
  • Matrix Collaboration: Serve as the commercial connective tissue across Sales, Medical Affairs, Product, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Regulatory, and Legal.
  • Budget & Vendor Stewardship: Manage assigned budget and agency / vendor partners with a focus on measurable ROI.
  • Team Growth: Build the business case and hire for additional capacity (for example, sales training, content, or analytics) as the business scales.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, or Marketing; MBA, MPH, or advanced scientific degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of commercial experience in diagnostics, genomics, or life sciences, including product marketing, sales enablement, commercial strategy, or sales operations.
  • Demonstrated success supporting or leading product launches in a complex clinical diagnostics or specialty setting.
  • Experience in genomics, rare disease, or precision diagnostics strongly preferred.
  • Experience partnering directly with a field sales organization, including training, tools, and CRM / analytics.
  • Experience managing or developing a team is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Messaging Craft: Ability to learn and distill complex clinical and genomic data into compelling, compliant narratives for HCPs and field teams.
  • Analytical Rigor: Comfortable interpreting segmentation, funnel, and commercial performance data to drive decisions.
  • Operational Excellence: Track record of building scalable commercial processes, enablement programs, and cross-functional workflows.
  • Reimbursement & Access Savvy: Working understanding of diagnostic reimbursement, LDT considerations, and payer dynamics.
  • Strategic Agility: Comfort operating in white space where market data is limited and the playbook is still being written.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Influences without authority, and builds strong partnerships with clinical and scientific experts.

Why This Role Matters

In rare disease, every day matters. The clarity with which we explain Zenith's value, and the speed at which a new account adopts it, directly affect how quickly a family reaches a diagnosis. You will build the messaging, field readiness, and adoption path that make that possible.

The "Rare" Candidate Profile

What We Are Looking For

Mindset

Builder who sees a small, specialized market as an opportunity to get the details right.

Field Credibility

Earns trust with sales teams by delivering tools and training that reps actually use.

Communication

Sophisticated enough for a PhD; practical enough for a sales rep on their first day.

Collaboration

Pairs with deep clinical and community expertise to create one integrated plan.

Leadership

A mentor who builds resilient, mission-driven teams.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$186,600—$233,300 USD

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus

  • Long-term equity awards

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range
$186,600—$233,300 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

At Oversee, we build practical AI solutions for the $1.6 trillion global travel industry.

For over a decade, we have helped travel agencies and global enterprises cut travel costs and work more efficiently. Our AI-based reshopping products, FareSaver for air and HotelSaver for hotels, track booked trips and automatically rebook them when a better rate becomes available.

AgentSee, our agentic AI platform, works alongside travel agents. It reads traveler requests, handles bookings and changes, and takes on routine servicing tasks, so agents can manage more trips while improving service quality.

We work with the largest travel agencies and fortune 500 companies, supporting over $15B in annual booking volume for more than 11,000 customers in over 60 countries.

If you want to solve real problems with a focused team in a fast-moving market, Oversee is the place to build, grow, and make an impact.

Why join us?

We're looking for our first dedicated Account Executive in EMEA. You'll have the opportunity to step into a pivotal role where your impact is felt immediately. As an Account Executive, you won’t just be chasing numbers - you’ll be building meaningful partnerships, expanding our channel base, and shaping the growth of our business. We value self-starters who thrive on ownership, and we give you the space and support to execute with confidence. If you’re motivated by driving results, surpassing quotas, and being part of a fast-growing team where your success directly fuels company success, Oversee is the place to be.

Come shape the future of business travel with us!

What you'll do:

  • Own and grow the EMEA territory, identifying and closing new business opportunities;
  • Build and execute a territory strategy to drive pipeline, revenue, and long-term growth;
  • Use AI-powered tools throughout the sales cycle to improve prospect research, account planning, outreach, meeting preparation, follow-up, and overall sales productivity;
  • Develop relationships with Travel Management Companies (TMCs), travel technology providers, and other strategic partners;
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through contract negotiation and close;
  • Generate, nurture, and manage a healthy pipeline through outbound efforts, referrals, industry relationships, and partnerships;
  • Represent Oversee at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings;
  • Engage directly with executive stakeholders including CEOs, COOs, and commercial leaders;
  • Act as the voice of the market, sharing customer insights and competitive intelligence with Product and Leadership teams;
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Leadership to support strategic deals and drive customer outcomes.

About you:

  • Previous experience within travel technology, business travel, TMCs, travel SaaS, GDS, corporate travel, or adjacent travel-related sectors strongly preferred;
  • 7+ years of experience in a quota-carrying Account Executive, Business Development, or Strategic Sales role;
  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your day-to-day sales workflow to research accounts, prepare for customer conversations, personalize outreach, and work more efficiently;
  • Proven experience consistently achieving or exceeding quota;
  • Strong hunter mentality with a bias for action and a track record of creating opportunities from scratch;
  • Experience selling B2B SaaS solutions to enterprise customers;
  • Experience building a territory, launching a new market, or operating as an early commercial hire is highly desirable;
  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced startup environment;
  • Strong executive presence and experience selling to senior decision-makers;
  • Curious about AI, technology, and the future of business travel, with the ability to learn new products quickly and communicate their value to customers.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

We provide employment opportunities without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

raw.excerpt: This is a remote position. The opportunityMastarRec is a retained executive search firm focused on senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory and Cybersecurity leadership.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The opportunity

MastarRec is a retained executive search firm focused on senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory and Cybersecurity leadership. We are expanding our U.S. client-development capability and are looking for an experienced, commercially credible professional who already understands how to build senior-level relationships and originate executive-search business.

This is not a high-volume recruiter role and it is not a salaried employee vacancy. It is designed as an independent business-to-business contractor relationship for someone who can create and develop their own U.S. client opportunities, while using MastarRec's brand, executive-search capability and agreed commercial resources to convert suitable opportunities into retained assignments.

What you will do
  • Develop your own relationships with U.S. CEOs, CROs, CCOs, CISOs and other senior decision-makers in Financial Services, FinTech and related regulated markets.
  • Identify genuine business, regulatory, growth, succession, risk and leadership pressures that may create a need for senior executive capability.
  • Originate qualified client opportunities and introduce them to MastarRec for retained executive-search discussions.
  • Lead or participate in commercial conversations where appropriate, with Tariq Masood, Founder & CEO, available for founder-to-executive and closing conversations.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity and relationship records using agreed MastarRec processes.
  • Protect the MastarRec brand through professional, relationship-led business development; no indiscriminate candidate or client spam.

What this opportunity is not
  • It is not a fixed-hours call-center role.
  • It is not an employee position with a guaranteed salary, employee benefits or prescribed daily working schedule.
  • It is not primarily a candidate-sourcing desk.
  • It is not an invitation to mass-message prospects or represent unverified vacancies.

Requirements

Who we want to speak with
  • Experienced executive-search, recruitment, staffing, retained-search or professional-services business developers with U.S. market credibility.
  • Professionals comfortable speaking directly with C-suite and senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory or Cybersecurity leaders.
  • People who can independently decide how, when and where to develop their market and who are comfortable being accountable for commercial results.
  • Professionals with an existing network in U.S. Financial Services, FinTech, banking, payments, insurance, asset/wealth management, cybersecurity or adjacent regulated sectors.
  • Individuals who value consultative conversations and long-term relationships over transactional vacancy chasing.
90-day pilot success measures
  • Qualified senior decision-maker conversations.
  • Client discovery meetings with genuine leadership or succession issues.

·Retained-search opportunities created.

  • Retained proposals issued and assignments won.
  • Collected search revenue from contractor-originated business.
  • Quality of client relationships and commercial intelligence, not raw dial or message volume.
How to apply
Please send a concise introduction explaining your U.S. market background, the sectors and senior decision-makers you know best, and examples of executive-search, recruitment or professional-services business you have personally originated. We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate relationship-led business development rather than high-volume outreach.

Company:MastarRec Limited |

Founder & CEO:Tariq Masood


Benefits

Commercial model

The proposed pilot is performance-based. The final commission schedule will be stated in the written contractor agreement. Our intended starting model is a substantial share of MastarRec's net collected search fees on qualifying new client business personally originated by the contractor. Commission becomes payable only after the relevant client payment has been received and cleared by MastarRec, subject to the agreement's account-ownership, refund, replacement, tax and clawback provisions.

For discussion, Commission is 22% of qualifying net search fees actually collected by MastarRec from new client business personally originated by the contractor. The final structure may vary according to the scope of the contractor's role, whether MastarRec provides delivery support, and applicable legal/tax requirements.

Independent contractor basis

The successful professional will be expected to operate as an independent businessperson, subject to the final written agreement and applicable federal and state law. The contractor will ordinarily control the manner, means, timing and location of their work; remain responsible for their own ordinary business expenses, taxes and insurance; and, subject to confidentiality, conflict and account-protection obligations, remain free to provide services to other clients. MastarRec will define required commercial outcomes, brand/confidentiality standards and client-account protections rather than prescribing day-to-day working methods.

Important notice

This specification describes MastarRec's intended commercial model and is not a legal determination of worker status. Worker classification depends on the actual facts and circumstances and may differ under federal, state and local law. MastarRec will complete appropriate legal/tax review before engagement. No candidate should rely on the title, commission method or written agreement alone as determining independent-contractor status.

About the Position & Company

Our client is a global leader in Linux infrastructure and security solutions, known for pioneering automated live patching technologies that enable enterprises to apply critical kernel updates without reboots or downtime. They also provide extended support for end-of-life Linux distributions, helping organizations maintain compliance and enterprise-grade security.

With a fully remote team of 250+ professionals worldwide and a client base of over 4,500 enterprise customers—including major tech industry leaders—they deliver robust infrastructure solutions across the US, Europe, Latin America, and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research & Analysis: Investigate upstream security (CVE) and bug fixes; analyze patch dependencies and impact on legacy kernels.

  • Kernel Packaging: Build and rebuild kernel source and binary packages using reproducible build environments for RPM and Debian ecosystems.
  • Validation & Testing: Validate patched kernels through build tests, runtime tests, and regression analysis to ensure stability.
  • Tooling & Automation: Enhance internal workflows (patch preparation, build automation, validation pipelines) using Python, Go, and Shell scripting.
  • AI Integration: Leverage agentic/AI-assisted development tools to accelerate tasks, while rigorously verifying every generated output.
  • Documentation & Collaboration: Document technical decisions, participate in code reviews, and communicate clearly with team members across time zones.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Strong C proficiency and hands-on Linux debugging skills.
  • Proven commercial experience in Linux kernel development—specifically patching, backporting, or debugging.
  • Solid experience with Git, GNU build tools (make, autotools), and standard Linux developer utilities.
  • Experience building Linux kernels or distribution packages from source.
  • Scripting and automation skills: Python, Go, or Shell.
  • Practical exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Codeium, or similar), with a disciplined approach to code verification.
  • English: Intermediate or higher (B1+), both written and spoken—you’ll be working in an international team and communicating in English daily.
  • Strong ownership mindset, balanced technical judgment, and ability to articulate trade-offs.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with RPM/SRPM or Debian kernel packaging.
  • Familiarity with security patching, CVE analysis, and extended lifecycle maintenance.
  • Working knowledge of Docker, QEMU, Jenkins, or other CI systems.
  • Experience designing kernel validation tests, analyzing core dumps, and investigating regressions.

Candidate Profile (Cultural Fit)

  • Hands-on practitioner: You love working directly with kernel code, not just theorizing.
  • Methodical and detail-oriented: Kernel patching requires precision, reproducibility, and thorough validation.
  • Ownership-driven: You take responsibility for outcomes, document your work, and proactively communicate risks.
  • AI-curious but cautious: You embrace AI tools to accelerate development but never skip verification.
  • Remote-first compatible: You thrive in async environments with minimal supervision and clear communication.

Benefits

  • 100% remote work with flexible hours — work from anywhere in the world (focus on LATAM-friendly time zones).
  • 24 paid vacation days + 10 national holidays + unlimited sick leave.
  • Private medical insurance compensation.
  • Coworking space and sports/fitness reimbursement.
  • Professional development budget — conferences, courses, certifications.
  • Reward program for patentable ideas.
  • A collaborative, non-corporate environment with a strong engineering culture.

You will design and execute strategies that accelerate product adoption, drive pipeline, and equip sales teams to win within the actuarial segment. raw.description:
Be part of an amazing story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work. 

Job Overview

The Senior Manager, Asset Protection Technology is responsible for leading the deployment, adoption, execution, and ongoing optimization of Asset Protection technology solutions across stores, supply chain operations, and field organizations. Guided by service and anticipation, this role partners with Asset Protection leadership, Macy's Technology, Operations, Supply Chain, Fraud, vendors, and field teams to evaluate business needs and deliver technology solutions that enhance operational effectiveness, risk mitigation, and shortage reduction.

The Senior Manager, AP Technology oversees implementation and support strategies for video management systems, RFID solutions, investigative technologies, exception reporting platforms, and other Asset Protection tools. This role leads proof-of-concept testing, business case development, technology rollout planning, training initiatives, and change management efforts to ensure successful adoption across the organization. The Senior Manager also manages vendor partnerships, expense budgets, project execution, technology governance, and a team of AP Technology Managers supporting regional operations.

Success in this role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, business partnership, and project management capabilities, along with the ability to translate operational challenges into scalable technology solutions that support Macy's Asset Protection objectives.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the deployment, adoption, and ongoing optimization of Asset Protection technology solutions across stores, supply chain facilities, and field organizations.
  • Manage a team of AP Technology Managers responsible for supporting technology programs, deployments, and operational execution across regional markets.
  • Partner with Asset Protection leadership to define technology priorities and align initiatives with strategic business objectives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and vendor solutions that support shortage reduction, investigative effectiveness, operational efficiency, and associate safety.
  • Oversee proof-of-concept testing, pilot programs, and operational evaluations to determine business value and implementation readiness.
  • Develop business cases, operational assessments, risk analyses, and recommendations supporting technology investment decisions.
  • Lead implementation planning, deployment strategies, communication plans, and adoption efforts for new AP technology solutions.
  • Partner with Macy's Technology teams to ensure effective integration, support, maintenance, and long-term sustainability of AP technology platforms.
  • Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, performance expectations, and contract deliverables to maximize solution effectiveness and value.
  • Oversee technology-related expense budgets and ensure responsible management of project and operational expenditures.
  • Monitor project progress, key milestones, implementation risks, and resource requirements to ensure successful execution.
  • Establish processes and governance that promote consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across AP technology programs.
  • Collaborate with Stores, Supply Chain, Fraud, Operations, Technology, and cross-functional business partners to identify opportunities for technology-driven improvements.
  • Support enterprise risk assessments and operational reviews related to security technology, investigative platforms, and AP operational capabilities.
  • Lead change management strategies that drive user adoption, engagement, and effective utilization of technology solutions.
  • Evaluate technology performance metrics and operational outcomes to identify enhancement opportunities and demonstrate business impact.
  • Develop and deliver executive summaries, status updates, and recommendations to Asset Protection and enterprise leadership teams.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
  • In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Technology Strategy & Deployment: Experience leading enterprise technology implementations, managing deployment activities, and driving successful adoption across diverse operational environments.

Leadership: Ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and professional growth.

Vendor Management: Strong experience managing vendors, service providers, performance expectations, contracts, and strategic technology partnerships.

Project Management: Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, mitigate risks, and deliver projects on schedule and within budget.

Business Partnership: Ability to build strong relationships across Asset Protection, Operations, Technology, Supply Chain, and executive leadership teams.

Change Management: Experience driving organizational adoption of new technology solutions through communication, training, and stakeholder engagement.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to evaluate business needs, identify long-term opportunities, and align technology solutions with organizational goals.

Risk Assessment: Knowledge of risk management principles, operational controls, and security technologies that support asset protection objectives.

Financial Acumen: Experience managing budgets, evaluating business cases, measuring return on investment, and supporting informed technology decisions.

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and present effectively to leadership audiences.

Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business challenges and develop practical, scalable technology solutions.

Operational Excellence: Ability to establish processes, standards, and governance models that improve consistency, efficiency, and performance.

Adaptability and Initiative: Thrives in a fast-paced environment and effectively manages changing priorities, technology advancements, and evolving business needs.

Integrity and Professionalism: Commitment to exemplifying the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, and professional conduct.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Criminal Justice, Asset Protection, Technology Management, Operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will also be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in Asset Protection, technology operations, systems implementation, project management, retail operations, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience managing teams, projects, or cross-functional technology initiatives.
  • Experience leading enterprise technology deployments and large-scale operational implementations.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, technology contracts, and service delivery expectations.
  • Knowledge of retail technology solutions, video management systems, RFID technologies, investigative tools, analytics platforms, or related security technologies preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex projects involving multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
  • Strong analytical, financial, and business planning capabilities.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills with experience supporting executive-level decision making.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes and build consensus across multiple business functions.
  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.
  • Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs, including travel as required.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

 Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives. 

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

About Our Team

You’ll join a collaborative and growing global Internal Communications team who partner with leaders and teams across the business - building trusted relationships and influencing how priorities, change, and strategy are communicated.

Working across regions, we ensure communication is clear, inclusive, and relevant to diverse audiences – balancing global consistency with local nuance. Together, we help colleagues stay informed, connected, and engaged in Sage’s strategy, culture, and transformation.

Your New Role

As an Internal Communications Business Partner (ICBP), you’ll act as a strategic advisor to senior leaders, shaping and enabling clear, credible and effective communication that supports Sage’s business strategy and employee experience. This is a high-impact partnering role where you'll use judgement, insight, and influence to guide leaders on what to communicate, when, and how – particularly in complex or ambiguous situations.

Alongside this advisory and insight‑led role, the ICBP is accountable for activating and delivering internal communications across assigned areas, ensuring communications are audience‑led, well‑timed and consistently aligned to Sage’s enterprise narrative and Employee Experience principles.

You will:

  • Act as an internal communications advisor to leaders within assigned regions, functions or business pillars, providing strategic counsel on intent, risk, sequencing and audience impact to shape effective communications approaches.

  • Translate internal communications strategy, enterprise narrative and employee experience (EX) principles into integrated, audience‑led communications plans that support business priorities and outcomes.

  • Shape, challenge and sense‑check communications requests to ensure clarity of purpose, appropriate tone, realistic sequencing and alignment to enterprise narrative expectations, balancing consistency with local relevance.

  • Apply judgement to plan and sequence communications activity within assigned areas, operating within prioritization, escalation and risk thresholds.

  • Own publishing and send authority for agreed communications within assigned areas, advancing activity linked to defined change agendas or enterprise‑level risk as appropriate.

  • Actively assess and surface communications‑related risks, tensions or misalignment, adjusting approach where possible and advancing when organizational, reputational or employee‑relations thresholds are met.

  • Sense‑check how communications and change are landing with colleagues, interpreting feedback, sentiment and delivery experience to inform advice, planning and continuous improvement.

  • Bring real‑world insight and emerging sentiment into the Internal Communications function, contributing to planning, prioritization, standards and evolution of the Business Partnering model.

  • Collaborate closely with Employee Experience, channels, operations and specialist roles to ensure clear briefs, strong alignment and effective hand‑offs from planning through delivery.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of business context, leadership priorities and organizational dynamics within assigned areas, using this insight to strengthen communications advice and impact.

Can you be our new Internal Communications Business Partner? We are looking for:

  • Significant experience in internal communications, corporate communications or a related field, operating in complex, matrixed or multi‑stakeholder environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior strategic advisor to leaders, providing credible counsel on communications approach, sequencing and risk, not simply delivery support.

  • Strong critical thinking skills, with the ability to connect business intent, organizational context, audience needs and employee experience principles to shape effective communications plans.

  • Sound judgement and confidence operating in ambiguity, applying discretion and independent thinking to assess risk, trade‑offs and implications for colleagues and the organization.

  • Proven ability to influence and challenge senior collaborators constructively, building trusted relationships and shaping decisions without relying on formal authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging, tone and framing for different audiences, contexts and levels of complexity.

  • Experience planning and delivering internal communications that support business priorities, change activity and leadership objectives, balancing enterprise consistency with local relevance and nuance.

  • Strong understanding of employee experience, organizational dynamics and change, with the ability to interpret how communications and change are landing with colleagues and feed insight back into planning and decision‑making.

  • Comfortable working across specialist and operational roles (e.g. channels, operations, events), providing clear direction, strong briefs and effective collaboration from planning through delivery.

  • Organized and disciplined in approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, apply sequencing judgment and maintain high standards in fast‑moving environments.

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact . All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

Pay Transparency & Benefits Package:

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include bonuses or benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with SAGE covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. raw.excerpt: About Lead Surge Lead Surge is a performance-driven agency with 15 years of proven success for national and regional clients in the home improvement industry.
raw.description:
About Lead Surge

Lead Surge is a performance-driven agency with 15 years of proven success for national and regional clients in the home improvement industry. We develop TV and digital media campaigns to generate quality leads for our clients. We rely on one constant source of truth: performance data.

We’re a team of experts who specialize in every step of the lead generation process, including strategic planning, creative production, media services, and performance analytics. We focus on making impactful, precise, and most importantly, data-informed decisions that break through the clutter and drive conversions for our clients.

While you’re running your business, we’re keeping our eyes on your sales capacity, cost per lead, cost per issued lead, sales volume, cost of marketing, media attribution, set rates, and any other relevant tracking metric. Our campaigns maximize response because we dig in and learn what motivates homeowners to act. We interview sales reps, review sales feedback, speak to management, and study the competition to figure out exactly what influences customer behavior.

We know lead flow can’t wait, which is why we stay in constant communication with our clients. From early campaign ideation to creative production to ongoing performance analysis and optimization, we exist to fill your pipeline with the right amount of quality sales leads.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled, behind-the-camera Digital Content Creator to produce high-performing visual assets including carousels, static images, and templated social media style videos for execution across our Demand Generation and YouTube campaigns. In this role, you will focus on utilizing our robust content libraries to churn out new video, image and carousel assets, optimize creative for varied aspect ratios and placements, help track creative performance, and develop new creative strategies aligned with our content calendar.

What you'll do

  • Generate engaging carousels, static images, and social-first templated videos tailored for demand generation campaigns.
  • Learn the ins and outs of our robust content libraries to analyze which footage can be utilized to create a variety of different creative assets.
  • Create multiple spot variations after monitoring creative performance metrics to innovate and refine asset design, messaging, and visual hooks over time.
  • Work exclusively behind the camera to produce high-quality digital media, drawing on prior experience in social media and YouTube content creation.
  • Design and edit assets efficiently using templating software (e.g., Canva), along with Adobe Creative Suite as needed.
  • Format and generate proper aspect ratios across all images and carousels, as well as any videos produced in-house.
  • Brainstorm and execute new content strategies and creative concepts that align with established content calendars.
  • Work closely with our copywriter and our larger creative team as well as our clients to generate new concepts to test.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Experience creating content for YouTube or social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, or Facebook.
  • Basic photography and video-production skills.
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to follow established brand guidelines while bringing creativity and fresh thinking to assignments.
  • Ensure individual and project deliverables meet strict deadlines, quality standards, and budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and effectiveness in the creative workflow.
  • Monitor performance metrics to ensure campaign creative targets are met or exceeded.
  • Communicate clearly with cross-functional partners and department leadership to align on project priorities.
  • Represent the creative function in meetings, sharing updates, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Encourage open communication and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and file organization.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional design, digital marketing, creative, or content-production experience.
  • Demonstrated portfolio of behind-the-camera content created for YouTube and major social media channels.
  • High proficiency with Canva or other template-based tools.
  • Proficiency in Figma.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
  • Deep understanding of social media video formats, image aspect ratios, and export requirements.
  • Strong ability to analyze asset performance and translate insights into fresh content ideas.
  • Desire to continue learning and using new creative tools, including emerging AI-assisted design and content-creation tools.

Physical demands:

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Work environment:

This is a remote position. This person must be a self-starter, able to stay on task in a remote environment, and utilize Slack, Zoom, and email to communicate with coworkers.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

We are seeking a highly motivated Hydraulic Technical Sales Specialist to support and grow our Canada Distribution Vertical. This role is responsible for driving profitable sales growth, expanding market share, and developing new business opportunities across the hydraulic distribution channel. As the hydraulic subject matter expert, the successful candidate will provide technical leadership, application support, and strategic guidance to distributors and end users, while building strong customer relationships and delivering innovative fluid handling solutions.

Working closely with the Vertical and Sales teams, this individual will execute growth strategies that exceed market performance, increase margins, and strengthen ContiTech's position as the preferred partner in the hydraulic distribution market. Success in this role requires a combination of technical hydraulic expertise, consultative selling skills, business acumen, and a strong commitment to customer-centricity.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute a hydraulic sales strategy to maximize profitable growth and market share within the IAM Canada Distribution vertical.
• Drive profitable sales growth within the Canadian distribution channel by identifying, developing, and converting new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
• Serve as the technical subject matter expert for hydraulic hose, fittings, adapters, couplings, and fluid handling solutions, providing application and product support to distributors, end users, and internal stakeholders.
• Partner with distribution sales teams and vertical leadership to develop and execute strategic growth plans that maximize revenue and profitability across targeted markets and accounts.
• Conduct customer visits, product demonstrations, training sessions, and technical presentations to strengthen customer relationships and drive product adoption.
• Support distributors in identifying new opportunities, developing sales pipelines, and implementing market penetration strategies to expand ContiTech's presence within targeted industries.
• Collaborate with customers to understand operational challenges and provide value-added hydraulic solutions that improve equipment reliability, productivity, and total cost of ownership.
• Manage and grow strategic customer accounts through regular business reviews, joint planning activities, and continuous engagement with key decision-makers.
• Assist in the development of business proposals, quotations, contract negotiations, and account strategies to secure new business and strengthen existing partnerships.
• Monitor market conditions, competitive activity, emerging industry trends, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities and inform business strategy.Champion a customer-centric culture by ensuring exceptional responsiveness, technical support, and service throughout the customer journey.
• Work closely with Marketing, Product Development, Customer Service, Operations, and Application Engineering teams to ensure effective execution of customer programs and business initiatives.
• Support new product launches, promotional initiatives, and strategic projects designed to enhance ContiTech's market position and customer value proposition.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, pricing guidelines, and contractual requirements while conducting business activities.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a technical discipline (or minimum 10 years or more of relevant experience if no degree).
• 5+ years of hydraulic hose sales experience.Experience converting a major customer's business from a competitor and developing, presenting, gaining approval, and executing on major business cases.
• Strong background in sales, customer relationship management, and business development.
• Excellent negotiation and presentation skills, with proficiency in PowerPoint.
• Financial acumen with the ability to manage sales, margin, and cost structures.
• Strong communication skills, emotional intelligence and cultural sensitivity.
• Knowledge of industrial distribution and hydraulic markets.
• Ability to travel up to 50%, including overnight stays.
• Legal authorization to work in Canada (no sponsorship available).
• No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

ADDITIONAL WAYS TO STAND OUT

Preferred Qualifications:
• Strong hydraulics product knowledge, including hydraulic fittings, braided and spiral hose, and assemblies.
• Basic understanding of industrial rubber products, including hydraulic hose, fittings, and assemblies.
• Proven success in hunting and closing new customers and business opportunities.
• Minimum of 1 year of business development, R&D, applications engineering and/or sales engineering experience.

THE PERKS

  • Robust Total Rewards Package
  • Competitive Bonus Programs
  • Paid Time Off
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Employee Discounts, including tire discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Future Growth Opportunities, including personal and professional
  • And many more benefits that come with working for a global industry leader!

ContiTech is one of the world’s leading industry specialists and offers its customers connected, environment-friendly, safe, and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 42,000 employees in more than 40 countries and sales of some 6.8 billion euros (2023), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.

Are you ready to shape the future with us?

raw.description:
C2C Forward Fellow, Data Programs

100% Remote within California

Travel Requirement: All fellows will need to travel to Sacramento once a month for an in-person team meeting. We are looking to hire two fellows for each track.


The Foundation for California Community Colleges (FCCC) is recruiting experts to join the inaugural C2C Forward Fellows Program to work directly within the Office of Cradle-to-Career in advancing the work of bridging gaps in state-wide data. The Office of Cradle-to-Career Data (C2C) is a neutral source of trusted information that links siloed data across the state to answer questions on what happens to students once they enter and leave our school system and beyond.

C2C Forward is a fiscally sponsored program of the Foundation of California Community Colleges. As C2C Forward Fellows, leaders and experts from across sectors can contribute their knowledge, experience, and innovation to support Cradle-to-Career Data System’s growth and long-term success.


Fellows will gain hands-on experience creating and maintaining a P20W data system while applying their expertise in domains such as TK-12 education, post-secondary education, workforce outcomes, economics, user center design, data visualization, data file preparation, and more. Fellows will be placed at C2C as an integral member of the Data Programs or Data Infrastructure team to advance the work of C2C’s annual workplan, embracing cross-sector collaboration, and gaining insight into underlying governmental structures and partnerships. As a fellow, you will gain a depth of experience and a wealth of knowledge that can be applied at institutions and beyond to advance research that will better serve Californians in the future.

C2C is required by statute to produce data insights such as dashboards, data reports, query builders via CSV files, a research request process via secure data enclave, and query builders. With the aptitude and bandwidth of the fellows, C2C will be able to produce more useful and necessary tools at a more rapid speed while enhancing the data system infrastructure with up-to-date best practices and most current privacy and security features.

In addition to the projects assigned to fellows, fellows will engage in a work culture that values equity, collaboration, transparency, accountability, and curiosity. C2C staff and leadership take pride in implementing values in the day-to-day work and expanding the team with individuals who also share these same values. Fellows will be empowered to take initiative and responsibility for their work in a safe, fun, and intellectually stimulating environment.


Track I: Data Programs

  • The Data Programs team (DPS) is responsible for planning, creating, iterating, and releasing data tools for a wide audience that includes but is not limited to students, families, educators, researchers, advocates, legislators, and policy makers. Fellows on data programs will develop dashboards, query builder tools, and analytical data reports to inform research, advocacy efforts, and policy analysis.
  • In collaboration with the engagement team, DPS frequently engages in community conversations to raise awareness of data tools, increase data literacy by discussing data insights with the public, and gathering feedback from the public to iterate designs. The DPS team also works alongside the data infrastructure team to adopt modern cloud-based data practices. Transform your knowledge, expertise, and hands-on experience into practical guidance and toolkits.

Applicant Profile:

  • Extensive knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies.
  • Knowledge of workforce and higher education admissions, policies, and legislation.
  • Direct experience or knowledge of current challenges in data systems, college applications, and transfer processes.
  • Experience in providing direct support services to students or experience as an administrator in an educational setting.
  • Experience conveying quantitative and qualitative research findings in many formats.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Project management experience and ability to stay highly organized.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in moderate direction.
  • Fellows possess a unique combination of technical and interpersonal skills, disciplinary backgrounds, and relevant experience. This includes many of the skills listed below:
  • You are a systems and platform thinker who loves enabling data teams with tools to do their work efficiently and effectively. The following captures the intersection of your interests and expertise
  • You love engaging with people as much as engaging with data and technology
  • You are constantly learning and engaged in the modern data stack ecosystem and enjoy staying up to date on emerging and best practices
  • You have a knack for and enjoy communicating technical and architectural tradeoffs clearly to different audiences
  • You value simplicity and elegance in architecting solutions over needless complexity and have a sixth sense for evaluating platforms that are fit for purpose
  • You like keeping knowledge fresh on platforms and are willing to get in and support the team on testing and implementing platforms
  • You value good documentation and guidance to help others successfully use data platforms
  • You take pleasure in sharing your knowledge and experience with others to help them succeed in adopting modern data practices
  • You relish demonstrating the value of a cloud-first approach to data tools and the benefits of applying software engineering approaches to data work and are eager to hands-on engage with project work to ensure that value is communicated
  • You are excited about applying your talents to improve the lives of Californians

Additional Qualifications:

  • Technical Skills
  • Extensive knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies
  • Statistical competency in at least one data analytic programming language such as Python, R, Stata, and SQL
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau
  • Experience working with large administrative data sets
  • Experience collaborating with both technical and non-technical teams
  • Extensive knowledge of Learning and Employment Records
  • Understanding of Open Science best practices
  • Advise management and executive level staff on governance and policy that support forward movement
  • Experience cleaning and merging complex and incomplete datasets.
  • Practical Skills
  • Experience working with government programs, policies, operations, and/or data
  • Has professional or educational experience in education, workforce development, policy, economics, or similar social science field or within government
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills
  • Ability to communicate statistical results to diverse audiences, both in text and in graphical form
  • Behavioral Skills
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
  • An interest in designing and participating in project processes that incorporate both quantitative and qualitative research methods and practices
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about state agencies and the role they play
  • Flexibility, self-motivation, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a team
  • The ability to continually track large numbers of projects and tasks and to juggle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Education and Experience Eligibility

  • Qualified candidates have a minimum of 5 years of experience in one or more of the following criteria:
  • Demonstrated portfolio that you have implemented analytical and/or digital tools such as dashboards, user-center design, research request tools, secure data enclaves, modern data stacks, and more.
  • Experience Staff employed in higher education labs focusing on education, economics, public policy, or relevant areas of research
  • Curriculum development for interacting and engaging with public facing data tools
  • Computer science background and/or ability to code in one or more languages
  • Experience building and/or maintaining large databases
  • Quantitative research and analysis
  • PhD in applied research
  • Master of Public Policy alumni
  • High profile innovative projects
  • Experience with tokenization of sensitive data elements
  • If you have experience with Tokenization of sensitive data elements, provide a detailed description of your relevant experience in your cover letter.

Additional position requirements

  • Fellowship requires a full-time two-year commitment
  • Must be able to accommodate a January 2027 start date
  • Fellows will be responsible for advancing the work outlined in Cradle-to-Career’s annual work plan. Fellows will be prohibited from conducting any personal research project or advancing any personal research agendas.

Attributes for Success

These values define how the Office Cradle-to-Career Data interacts with each other and stakeholders.

Advancing Equity: Equity is our north star. We’re recruiting for mission-driven, passionate, equity-minded individuals with a strong desire to impact and change people’s lives for the better

Transparency: Our work holds great weight and responsibility, and the opportunity to impact the lives of millions of individuals in California. Transparency enables us to build trust with the public and with each other.

Accountability: We are committed to an emphasis on shared leadership, to ensure growth for employees and the organization overall. When we experience success, we collectively acknowledge the result of our work. When we experience setbacks, we collectively solve problems.

Collaboration: Team members are hired for their expertise in niche areas across our areas of impact and higher education overall, and for their knowledge of business, philanthropy, technology, communications, and more. Multiple perspectives from each other and the public transform good individual ideas into innovative and creative accomplishments.

Curiosity: We’re recruiting for mission-driven, passionate, equity-minded individuals with a strong desire to impact and change people’s lives for the better. When our work gets tough, we get curious.

Working Hours, Location, and Travel requirements:

  • Working Hours: Full-time position, 40 hours per week, with additional hours needed to address the organization’s needs. California-based with the flexibility to work remotely (in California).  Fellowship requires a full-time two-year commitment.
  • Location: California-based with the flexibility to work remotely (in California).
  • Travel Requirements: All fellows will need to travel to Sacramento once a month for an in-person team meeting. (Travel costs covered by FCCC.) Fellows will have more opportunities to join in-person meetings with C2C and its data partners if they reside near Sacramento.
  • Must be able to accommodate a January 2027 start date
  • Fellows will be responsible for advancing the work outlined in Cradle-to-Career’s annual work plan. Fellows will be prohibited from conducting any personal research project or advancing any personal research agendas.

What we Offer

FoundationCCC is fully committed to a “remote-first” philosophy, and recruits and hires talent across the state in fully remote positions, where virtual work is possible. Our headquarters are located in Downtown Sacramento, just blocks from California’s State Capitol. Fellows will have more opportunities to join in-person meetings with C2C and its data partners if they reside near Sacramento.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, generous PTO, and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Wellness offerings
  • CalPERS retirement program and optional 403(b) and 457 Retirement plans
  • Carrot reproductive health and fertility support
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness certified employer

How to apply:

Applicants may apply online by visiting insert website link. The following should be included for your application to be considered:

  • Resume/CV
  • Cover letter
  • Writing Sample
  • 3 References
  • Identify as a subject matter expert in one of the following categories:
  • Early childhood education
  • K-12 Education
  • Higher Education
  • Labor Economist/ Workforce Development
  • Health and Social Services
  • Computer science, data infrastructure, software engineering, cloud computing

After the application has closed, selected candidates will proceed through:

  • A pre-interview task to complete.
  • A formal interview with a panel of FCCC, C2C staff, and C2C leadership via Zoom or in-person

Budgeted Annual Salary Pay Range:

$101,000.00 - $110,000.00

Final salary and rates are based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.

Title: Research / Senior Research Manager, Farmer Insights and Field Research (Weather Initiative)

Location: India (remote). Candidates must have existing authorization to work in India; PxD is unable to sponsor visas for this role.
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India

Position: Full-time

Application deadline: October 25, 2026 (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)

About the Role:

Precision Development (PxD) is seeking a dynamic, creative, and self-motivated Research / Senior Research Manager to join a high-performing team in India working on our weather initiative - a high-profile, fast-growing area of PxD's work with significant potential for impact and visibility.

In this role, you will help design, test, evaluate, and scale evidence-based weather solutions for smallholder farmers, working closely with researchers, government partners, and cross-functional teams. We're looking for a proactive self-starter with strong research management skills, excellent stakeholder engagement abilities, and a passion for generating actionable evidence to improve program outcomes.

While anchored in research and iterative learning, the role will work fluidly across programmatic, service delivery, and research functions — ensuring insights are embedded into program implementation, operational decision-making, and government-facing engagements.

This is a role for someone as comfortable running a farmer focus group as they are writing up what it means for message design, and who can hold together a fieldwork effort spanning several states and use cases at once.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the design and implementation of farmer visits across multiple states, structured around the specific forecast use cases relevant to farmer decision making and forecast message design
  • Plan and run qualitative research with farmers, including interviews, co-design sessions, and message testing, to surface what farmers need to act on a forecast and how they respond to different message formats
  • Synthesize insights from the field into clear, usable findings, and iterate directly with the relevant use case teams so those findings shape message and service design in near real time
  • Share synthesized insights with relevant teams on a regular cadence, not just at the end of a research cycle
  • Develop generalizable protocols, discussion guides, and field materials so that fieldwork can be replicated across states and use cases without being redesigned each time
  • Coordinate across the different weather forecast use case teams to ensure fieldwork priorities reflect what each team actually needs to learn next
  • Provide guidance to Associate and Manager level staff supporting the fieldwork
  • Contribute to internal and external communications on findings, including briefs and presentations
  • Contribute to PxD's institutional knowledge management on farmer-facing forecast design

What You'll Bring

  • Degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, anthropology, or a closely related field
  • Experience designing and leading qualitative field research with rural or agricultural communities, ideally including message testing or user research methods
  • Demonstrated ability to manage fieldwork logistics across multiple locations or teams at once
  • Strong synthesis skills: the ability to turn open-ended qualitative material into clear, generalizable findings that a program or research team can act on
  • Experience developing research protocols or materials meant to be reused across contexts
  • Comfort working closely with quantitative researchers and technical teams, even without being one yourself
  • Strong writing and oral communication skills in English
  • Willingness to travel frequently to field sites across states

About Precision Development (PxD):

PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.

Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

How to Apply:

To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. The position will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the application deadline of October 25, 2026, 5pm IST.

In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
