raw.title: Territory Sales Executive/Responsable des Ventes Territoriales
raw.excerpt: Donnez plus de vie.  Êtes-vous prêt à accélérer votre potentiel et à faire une réelle différence dans les sciences de la vie, le diagnostic et la biotechnologie ?
raw.description:
Donnez plus de vie.


Êtes-vous prêt à accélérer votre potentiel et à faire une réelle différence dans les sciences de la vie, le diagnostic et la biotechnologie ?


Chez Cepheid, l’une des plus de 15 filiales opérationnelles de Danaher, notre travail sauve des vies—et nous sommes tous unis par un engagement commun à innover pour un impact concret.

Vous vous épanouirez dans une culture d’inclusion où vous et votre point de vue unique comptez. Et en tirant parti du système d’amélioration continue de Danaher, vous contribuez à transformer les idées en impact – en innovant à la vitesse de la vie.


Chez Cepheid, nous sommes passionnés par l’amélioration des soins de santé grâce à des tests diagnostiques rapides et précis. Notre mission nous anime à chaque instant, alors que nous développons des solutions évolutives et révolutionnaires pour relever les défis de santé les plus complexes au monde. Nos collaborateurs sont impliqués à chaque étape du diagnostic moléculaire, de l’idéation au développement et à la livraison d’innovations qui améliorent les résultats pour les patients dans divers contextes. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous pouvez avoir un impact immédiat et mesurable à l’échelle mondiale, dans un environnement qui favorise la croissance et le développement professionnel.


Cepheid est fier de collaborer avec une communauté de six autres entreprises de diagnostic du groupe Danaher. Ensemble, nous travaillons au rythme du changement sur des outils diagnostiques qui répondent aux plus grands défis de santé mondiaux, motivés par la certitude que derrière chaque test se trouve un patient en attente. Découvrez le Danaher Business System, qui rend tout cela possible.


Le/la Responsable des ventes territoriales pour le marché du Québec est chargé(e) de mener des ventes complexes et multi-départementales auprès des hôpitaux, depuis l’introduction de nouveaux concepts diagnostiques jusqu’à la conclusion et la mise en œuvre d’un portefeuille de tests de diagnostic moléculaire. Établit des relations professionnelles avec les personnes clés des comptes clients.


Ce poste fait partie de l'équipe de ventes du Canada et est un rôle à distance situé dans la province de Québec.


Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l’opportunité de:


  • Cultiver et maintenir des relations positives avec les laboratoires, les pharmacies, les services de contrôle des infections, la direction des soins infirmiers, les urgences, la gestion des risques et les médecins dans le secteur des soins aigus afin d’identifier des prospects qualifiés, accroître la part de marché, augmenter les revenus et réduire l’attrition des clients.
  • Stimuler la demande et l’adoption de nouveaux tests et instruments pour atteindre les objectifs trimestriels et annuels de commandes et de revenus ; améliorer la marge bénéficiaire sur les ventes d’équipements, de réactifs et de contrats de service.
  • Optimiser le cycle de vente en utilisant Salesforce.com (outil CRM) pour suivre l’activité des clients et des comptes, cartographier la visibilité et accroître la part de marché, et prioriser les opportunités de vente.

Exigences essentielles du poste:

  • Diplôme de baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent avec plus de 5 ans d’expérience en vente dans le secteur de la santé, de préférence en diagnostic de laboratoire ou maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent avec plus de 3 ans d’expérience en vente dans le secteur de la santé, de préférence en diagnostic de laboratoire.
  • Succès avéré en vente, notamment dans la commercialisation de produits à prix premium.
  • Expérience dans l’engagement de plusieurs interlocuteurs au sein de l’hôpital, incluant le laboratoire et les services hors laboratoire.
  • Bilingue en français et en anglais.
  • Capacité à satisfaire aux exigences de certification des fournisseurs.
  • Disponibilité pour voyager jusqu’à 75 % du temps.

Voyage & dossier de conduite exigences:

  • Capacité de voyager 75 % du temps
  • Doit avoir un permis de conduire valide avec un dossier de conduite acceptable

Un atout supplémentaire serait:

  • Maîtrise de l’utilisation du CRM Salesforce.
  • Expertise dans la création de demande pour des technologies innovantes plutôt que pour des technologies de remplacement.

Cepheid, une entreprise du groupe Danaher, propose une large gamme de programmes d’avantages sociaux complets et compétitifs qui enrichissent notre vie. Qu’il s’agisse de soins de santé ou de congés payés, nos programmes contribuent à une vie équilibrée au-delà du travail. Consultez nos avantages sur .


Chez Cepheid, nous croyons en la conception d’une main-d’œuvre meilleure et plus durable. Nous reconnaissons les avantages des modalités de travail flexibles et à distance pour les postes éligibles et nous nous engageons à offrir des carrières enrichissantes, quel que soit le mode de travail. Ce poste est éligible à un aménagement de travail à distance depuis votre domicile. Des informations supplémentaires sur cet aménagement seront fournies par l’équipe d’entretien. Découvrez la flexibilité et les défis que Cepheid peut offrir.


La fourchette salariale annuelle pour ce poste est de 100,000 à 120,000 CAD. C’est la fourchette que nous croyons de bonne foi représenter la rémunération possible pour ce poste au moment de cette annonce. Cette fourchette peut être modifiée dans le futur. Ce poste est également admissible à une rémunération incitative.


Nous offrons un ensemble complet d’avantages sociaux, incluant des congés payés, une assurance médicale/dentaire/vision et un régime de retraite pour les employés admissibles.


Note : Aucun montant de rémunération n’est considéré comme salaire ou compensation tant que ce montant n’est pas gagné, acquis et déterminable. Le montant et la disponibilité de tout bonus, commission, avantage ou toute autre forme de rémunération attribuable à un employé particulier restent à la seule discrétion de l’Entreprise, sauf et jusqu’à ce qu’il soit payé, et peuvent être modifiés à la seule discrétion de l’Entreprise, conformément à la loi.



Bring more to life.


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Territory Sales Executive for the Quebec market is responsible for driving highly sophisticated, multi-departmental, hospital sales from the introduction of new diagnostic concepts through closure and implementation for a portfolio of molecular diagnostic tests. Establishes professional relationships with key personnel in customer accounts.


This position is part of the Canada Sales Team and is a remote role located in Quebec Province.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Cultivate and maintain positive relationships with laboratory, pharmacy, infection control, nursing management, emergency department, risk management and physician partners within the Acute healthcare market in order to identify qualified leads, grow market share and increase revenue, and reduce customer attrition.
  • Drive demand for and adoption of new assays and instrumentation to deliver on quarterly & annual orders and revenue sales targets; improve profit margin on equipment, reagent and service contract sales.
  • Optimize cycle time by using Salesforce.com (CRM tool) to maintain customer and account activity, to map visibility and drive market share, and to prioritize sales funnel.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in field with 5+ years of related healthcare sales experience, preferably in laboratory diagnostics or Master’s degree in field with 3+ years of related healthcare sales experience, preferably in laboratory diagnostics
  • Proven sales success, specifically in selling premium-priced products.
  • Experience engaging multiple call points within the hospital, to include both laboratory and outside-of-the laboratory.
  • Bi-lingual in French and English
  • Ability to pass vendor credentialing requirements.

Travel & Motor Vehicle Record Requirements:

  • Ability to travel 75% of the time
  • Must have a valid driver`s license with an acceptable driving record

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Proficient using SalesForce CRM
  • Expertise in demand creation for ground-breaking technologies versus replacement technology is a plus.

Cepheid, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at .


At Cepheid we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Cepheid can provide.


The annual salary range for this role is CAD 100,000 to 120,000. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future. This job is also eligible for incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and retirement plan to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit .

Danaher Corporation and all Danaher Companies are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other characteristics protected by law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to access our website, and as applicable participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at 1-202-419-7762 or to request accommodation.

raw.description:
FindTutorsis one of the leading online education platforms in the UK, connecting students with qualified tutors across academic and professional subjects. We support learners at all levels by providing personalised tutoring that improves understanding, confidence, and academic performance.

We are looking for a knowledgeable and motivated Online Law Tutor to join the FindTutors team. This is a flexible remote opportunity to support students studying Law and Legal Studies across different academic levels in the UK.

You will help students understand key legal concepts, improve their academic performance, and build confidence in their studies through structured and engaging online lessons.

What you’ll do

Deliver online Law tutoring sessions to UK students.
Support learners with essays, coursework, and exam preparation.
Explain legal concepts in a clear and structured way.
Help students develop analytical and critical thinking skills.
Guide university-level and pre-university Law studies.

Requirements

No previous tutoring experience required.
Strong knowledge of Law or Legal Studies (LLB knowledge is a plus).
Good communication and analytical skills.
Ability to explain complex topics clearly.
Passion for education and student success.

What we offer

Flexible working hours – set your own schedule.
Fully remote role – work from anywhere in the UK.

Competitive pay: £20–£40 per hour.

Opportunity to support motivated Law students.
Valuable experience in legal education and tutoring.

Start helping students succeed in their Law studies by joining FindTutors today.

raw.title: Tech Lead
raw.excerpt: Somos a Conexa, o maior ecossistema digital de saúde física e mental da América Latina.
raw.description:
Somos a Conexa, o maior ecossistema digital de saúde física e mental da América Latina. Contamos com milhares de médicos, psicólogos, nutricionistas e enfermeiros que, por meio de nossa plataforma, conseguem cuidar de pacientes em qualquer lugar que eles estejam. Unimos pacientes, profissionais, empresas e operadoras com o objetivo de reduzir as ineficiências de custo e qualidade de atendimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.

Nascemos com o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à saúde de qualidade, e acreditamos que corpo e mente precisam ser tratados de forma integrada para que o paciente tenha uma vida saudável. Atualmente, realizamos mais de 7,2 milhões de consultas por ano, com mais de 6.000 profissionais de saúde em mais de 35 especialidades. Com nosso modelo de negócios, cobrimos mais de 35 milhões de vidas elegíveis, com 190+ operadoras parceiras e 10.000+ clientes corporativos.

Temos um time formado por pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e que acreditam em um futuro com mais saúde física e mental para todos!

✨ Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Leadpara liderar times de Engenharia em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a resultados. Essa liderança será responsável por garantir a performance e o desenvolvimento do time, atuando diretamente no equilíbrio entre entregas técnicas, evolução das pessoas e alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa. A posição é ideal para quem já liderou times de desenvolvimento e deseja atuar como ponte entre pessoas, processos e produto, com senso de dono e compromisso com eficiência, cultura e qualidade.

Aviso importante! 🚨

A Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas exclusivamente pela Gupy e o processo de inscrição é totalmente gratuito. Caso receba qualquer pedido de pagamento ou oferta de vaga fora da Gupy, desconfie! Isso não faz parte da nossa prática de recrutamento.

Você será responsável por:

Contribuição Técnica & Hands-On

  • Atuar ativamente no desenvolvimento de soluções full stack, contribuindo com código de qualidade no dia a dia da squad.
  • Participar de code reviews, pair programming e decisões técnicas junto ao time, sendo referência prática não apenas estratégica.
  • Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos complexos, desbloqueando o time com agilidade e protagonismo.
  • Prototipar, validar e evoluir soluções arquiteturais com base em contexto real de produto e negócio.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) com as tecnologias do stack do time, garantindo que as decisões técnicas sejam embasadas em experiência prática.

Performance, Entregas & Processos

raw.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend + Frontend)
raw.excerpt: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era.  Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it.
raw.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll work across our entire stack: Java backend services and the TypeScript/Angular frontend that power Soda Cloud. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll own features end-to-end, talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship from database to UI without waiting for hand-offs. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side.

What You'll Do

  • Build features end-to-end: backend APIs, database changes, frontend UI, and ship them to production yourself.
  • Design and implement backend services for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Work with relational databases (MySQL): schema design, query optimization, data modeling.
  • Build frontend features that are clean, fast, and don't get in the way.
  • Optimize performance across the stack and write tests at every layer (unit, integration, e2e).
  • Build agentic features into the product: LLM-powered workflows that help users find, understand, and fix data issues.
  • Improve our systems for agentic development: agent instructions, skills, and the test feedback loops that make agents effective across the codebase.
  • Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years building software at a product company: you've owned meaningful parts of a real production system.
  • Strong Java: REST APIs, database interactions, async processing.
  • TypeScript and a modern frontend framework: Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud).
  • Frontend fundamentals: complex UIs, component architecture, state management, performance, responsive design.
  • Solid SQL in a backend context: schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse.
  • Testing as a habit: you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
  • Architectural judgment: you design APIs from the consumer's perspective and understand how those choices shape data flow and latency across the stack.
  • DevOps fluency: containers, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, comfortable on Linux.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience.
  • An eye for design: you can spot a misaligned pixel.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

raw.description:
This is an individual contributor role, based remotely in North America

Description

When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a team that values curiosity, expert insights, bold ideas, and intellectual courage, while driving partnerships with global organizations to make the right decisions on their key initiatives. Through constant learning, discovery, innovation, and collaboration, you’ll not only help clients accomplish their mission-critical priorities but also grow your career and the scope of your impact across industries. If you’re always looking for what’s next in business and technology, Gartner is looking for you.


Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for world-leading organizations. A Senior Director Analyst is a leader at Gartner and within their area of emerging technology research, making them a trusted source of guidance and advice for clients. As the subject matter expert, a Senior Director Analyst produces innovative, pragmatic and provocative written content, and is a decision-maker and leader of cross-team and cross-practice initiatives. They also engage with clients directly through virtual and in-person interactions, meetings, conferences and industry events. The Senior Director Analyst will challenge clients to reframe their thinking across key initiatives, interpret contextual realities and propose new ways to obtain data to solve complex problems and improve client performance.

What you will do:

  • Lead research initiatives on emerging AI safety and security topics with a focus on the convergence of artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, robotics and other physical AI solutions that interact with and transform the physical world
  • Develop and execute comprehensive research agendas covering AI safety and security for the physical AI ecosystem, including AI-driven autonomous systems, agentic systems, sensor technologies, robotics, and AI-hardware integration
  • Serve as a primary authority on physical AI safety and security technologies and related market dynamics, to deliver insights that inform strategic decisions, investment priorities, and physical AI-related product/service recommendations.
  • Identify AI-related emerging trends, breakthrough technologies, and potential disruptions before they become mainstream
  • Lead primary research initiatives including expert interviews, technical assessments, case study development, and both qualitative and quantitative analysis of emerging market technologies and trends
  • Analyze the competitive landscape across emerging physical AI business use cases and applications, tracking key players from startups to established companies
  • Assess AI technology readiness levels, commercialization pathways, and adoption barriers across different sectors
  • Evaluate geopolitical dimensions of physical AI development, including international competition, export controls, and regulatory frameworks
  • Author authoritative research papers and briefings on physical AI trends, opportunities, and implications
  • Present research findings to diverse audiences including C-level executives, product leaders, investors, and technical communities
  • Support and help build Gartner’s reputation as the global authority on AI
  • Cultivate relationships with researchers, entrepreneurs, investors, and industry practitioners in the physical AI ecosystem
  • Synthesize perspectives from technical experts, end users, and specialists in and facilitate dialogue between stakeholders with different perspectives on physical AI safety and security

What you will need:

  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • Deep understanding of emerging AI enabled software development tools and Agent technologies, markets, costs, and providers
  • Recent experience in bringing AI-driven solutions to market
  • A strong focus on detail and ability to understand the requirements of complex systems that call for an all-new approach to cybersecurity
  • Critical thinking, curiosity, and self-motivation to discover and make sense of early emerging technology signals
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical, and presentation skills
  • Executive presence with the ability to engage C-level provider and end-user clients and respond effectively to questions to quickly build rapport
  • Relentless drive to understand emerging technologies and their implications, comfortable operating at the frontier of knowledge where answers are uncertain
  • Strong foundational understanding of AI risk management

Preferred:

  • Understanding of the rapidly emerging field of physical AI
  • Experience working across multiple industry sectors such as defense, logistics, real estate (facilities management), and/or manufacturing
  • Strong understanding of human resource management and a vision for how agents (both physical and digital) may augment/replace human capabilities in the future
  • Prior experience managing research projects or complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives that call for a high level of attention to detail on safety and security
  • Hands-on experience developing, deploying, or operating AI-driven solutions
  • Experience with emerging areas such as agentic AI, world models, reasoning models, robotics, or autonomous weapons policy
  • Publications in large enterprise reports, periodicals, or industry publications.
  • Multilingual capabilities


Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 172,000 USD - 202,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

raw.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire an Account Executive, Large Enterprise to the Sales & Success team.

Why join Sprout’s Sales & Success team?

At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like PwC, Publicis Groupe, and Bank of Ireland. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.

What you’ll do

  • Prospect, develop and close sales opportunities with a focus on acquisition and new logos in the large enterprise segment.
  • Own your numbers - consistently meet and exceed your activity goals (prospecting and meetings completed) to build a fruitful pipeline that will provide consistent quota retirement.
  • Establish deep relationships within your book of business through multi-threading, achieving both executive or VP level and end user engagement.

What you’ll bring

Sprout Social is looking for a highly driven and tech-savvy Account Executive with strong business acumen to join our expanding Large Enterprise sales team. Ideally, you will be equally driven by a customer-centric mentality as well as a desire to find and close new business.

These are the minimum qualifications that our hiring team is looking for in this role:

  • 5+ years of closing experience in B2B sales
  • Proven success selling/cross-selling to large enterprise organizations (5,000+ global employees)
  • Ability to manage a large number of prospective accounts and identify problems, opportunities and consultatively provide solutions for each of them

Additionally, these are the preferred qualifications that would indicate a particularly strong candidate:

  • Experience building relationships, presenting and selling to senior level decision makers across multiple functions
  • SaaS experience preferred
  • Experience working with internal partners and cross-functional stakeholders to increase deal momentum and exceed both prospects and customers expectations

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
  • Partner with Enterprise Leadership to define key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them.
  • Meet with current members of the Enterprise Sales team individually to understand what’s working, what’s not, and gather learnings to implement into your role.
  • Shadow Account Executives on calls live or through Gong to learn sales strategies and positioning.
  • Dive right into our platform to learn about what makes our platform unique, how our solution impacts business objectives and why customers love our solutions.
  • Learn Sprout’s go-to-market messaging, key differentiators, develop and personalize segment-specific value propositions.
  • Learn the relevant customer stories and case studies to justify your value propositions with real ROI examples from the field.
  • Complete a demo and written certification to ensure comprehension.
  • Learn Sprout’s existing customer sales process by shadowing your peers.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Meet with all your existing customers within the book of business and begin the process of building relationships with key strategic stakeholders.
  • Identifying the top 20-25% of new logo opportunities within your book of business to create focus and execution in your weekly prospecting activities.
  • Understand the language of all your customers and where we can expand our offerings by expansion into new business units or increasing utilization of our platform with existing customers.
  • Own your numbers - consistently meet and exceed your activity goals to build a fruitful pipeline that will provide consistent quota attainment after ramp.
  • Co-build account & territory plans with your BDR &, Solutions Engineers teammates.
  • Regularly meet with your BDR to define a relationship that ensures seamless communication and coordination on all net new business generation and expansion opportunities.
  • Conduct active research leveraging all available tools and data sources to understand your customers’ brand, culture, KPIs, partners, and success metrics so you can add value throughout your interactions and become a trusted advisor.
  • Gain a solid understanding of your customer’s internal transitions and mitigate the risk of customer churn.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Have built solid relationships at the C-Level with existing customers within your “book of business".
  • Have built strong internal relationships with your peers, customer success, professional services, solutions engineering, our legal partners and others who will take part in your deal cycles. You will have a deep understanding of each team’s partnership expectations and service level agreement..
  • Have built 4X your monthly quota target of net new logo pipeline.
  • Become a Sprout Social and social media expert to confidently speak to ever-changing trends, new product features and platform enhancements to help our customers realize their full potential and accomplish their goals.
  • Consistently achieve your monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Mentor and develop your BDR to become best in class at their respective functions and further advance their skill sets and career trajectory.
  • Step up as a peer leader to share best practices across the organization and help others grow from your experiences.
  • Consistently meet and exceed monthly activity, pipeline and new business metrics.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Private Health: 100% premium coverage for you and your eligible dependents through AXA Health, including benefits for dental and vision.
  • Pension Scheme: We contribute 4% to your NEST pension (on top of your 5% contribution).
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave, plus all public/bank holidays and additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days.
  • Paid Parental Leave: We support all growing families with 26 weeks of full pay for birthing parents and 16 weeks of full pay for non-birthing parents.
  • Family & Care Support: Access to subsidized child/eldercare through Care.com.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including free coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): An annual $700 USD fund to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Career Development: Full access to our internal Grow@Sprout program for career pathing, plus learning platforms and mentorship.
  • Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible organizations.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: £148,000.00 – £185,000.00 OTE annually. OTE is governed by an incentive plan. It is the sum of a fixed base salary plus incentives at target performance. Incentive compensation will vary based on performance. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth opportunities available as you progress in your role.

The full OTE range for this role is £148,000.00 - £203,500

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

If you require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the interview process or to submit your application, please email us at . Include the nature of your request and your preferred contact information. We'll do everything we can to support your success during our recruitment process while upholding your privacy. Please note that only inquiries regarding accommodations will receive a response from this email address; other inquiries will not be addressed (e.g., you send your resume but are not requesting an accommodation).

Candidates for this remote work opportunity must be based in either England, Northern Ireland, or Wales. If you are based in another location within the United Kingdom, we aren’t able to hire in your location at this time.

Sprout Social Inc. and its subsidiaries process personal data submitted through your application to assess your qualifications for employment and to inform our hiring decision and, where applicable, for required governmental reporting. For more information, please review Sprout's Global Applicant Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
About Global University Systems (GUS)

Global University Systems (GUS) is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. We believe education drives careers, lives, and society forward, enabling a brighter future for all. Our network of 30 institutions offers the broadest range of industry-relevant skills through inclusive, accessible, and digital-first learning. We currently educate around 122,000 students on campuses worldwide and have 20M+ unique subscribers to our courses. Our global ecosystem powers accessible digital learning and academic achievement.

About the Role

Role Purpose

Seeking an experienced, highly analytical and commercially aware Nigeria Compliance Officer to strengthen the quality and compliance of student recruitment from Nigeria.

The role will be responsible for identifying and mitigating visa and recruitment risks across the Nigerian student pipeline, analysing refusal trends, reviewing applicant profiles and supporting the business and partner universities in improving visa outcomes, student quality and conversion.

This is not a visa application processing role. It is a strategic market compliance role focused on risk identification, analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

1.Visa Refusal Analysis and Risk Management

2.Applicant Quality and Pre-CAS Risk Review

3.Agent Compliance & Performance

  • Monitor visa outcomes by agent and identify agents generating disproportionate levels of refusal or high-risk applications.

4. Refusal Notice Management

  • Analyse refusal notices and identify common themes.

  • Maintain an accurate refusal database that can be used for trend analysis and partner reporting.

  • Ensure significant refusal trends are communicated promptly rather than waiting for periodic reporting.

5. Data & Analytics

The role will have a strong analytical component.

The successful candidate will:

  • Develop and maintain compliance KPIs and dashboards.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against indicators including:

  • Reduction in avoidable visa refusals.

  • Timeliness and completeness of refusal-notice collection.

  • Accuracy and quality of refusal analysis.

  • Quality of pre-CAS risk interventions.

  • Agent compliance and improvement following intervention.

  • Quality and timeliness of management reporting.

  • Completion of compliance training programmes.

  • Partner university satisfaction with the quality of Nigeria compliance reporting.

  • Evidence of improved application quality and conversion through appropriate risk management, rather than simply increasing application volumes.

Person Specification

Essential

Analytical capability: Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

UK Student visa / compliance knowledge:Strong understanding of the UK Student visa route and relevant UKVI requirements.

Higher education / international recruitment experience:

  • Experience within international student recruitment, UK higher education, admissions, compliance or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of the Nigerian international student recruitment environment.

Professional judgement: Comfortable escalating difficult issues.

Desirable

  • Experience working directly with UK universities or education providers.

  • Previous UKVI compliance or international admissions experience.

  • Experience conducting applicant interviews or credibility assessments.

Global University Systems equal opportunity employer. We provide equal opportunities and are committed to the principle of equality regardless of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, record of offences, marital status, family status or disability.

The post holder may be asked to undertake different or additional duties in line with business requirements at the request of their line manager.

There is an expectation that all employees will maintain the values of the Group and will comply with the code of conduct as well as equality and diversity, health and safety and safeguarding policies.

Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, we are a fast-growing national team passionate about transforming the way people access the care they need. If you're driven by purpose and excited by growth, Direct Meds is the place to be.

Engagement Team Representative (Remote)

Company: DirectMeds

Location: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)
Compensation: $41,600 Base Salary + Uncapped Commission

Note: The base salary listed above represents a good-faith estimate of the minimum and maximum target for this position. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on the candidate's geographic location, job-related skills, experience, and education.

Top sales performers are encouraged to apply. If you have a proven track record in telesales, telehealth, peptide sales, nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, or high-volume inside sales, this is an opportunity to maximize your earning potential while working remotely.

Position Overview

DirectMeds is seeking experienced, results-driven sales professionals to join our growing Engagement Team. This is a consultative sales role focused on strengthening relationships with existing patients, identifying opportunities to improve their treatment experience, and recommending additional products that align with their wellness goals.

Success in this role requires confidence on the phone, strong objection-handling skills, the ability to build rapport quickly, and a history of consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals.

  • Conduct high-volume outbound calls and patient outreach to drive engagement and sales.
  • Consult with existing patients to identify opportunities for additional products and treatment enhancements.
  • Educate patients on peptide therapies and other available wellness solutions.
  • Consistently exceed daily, weekly, and monthly sales goals.
  • Overcome objections and confidently close sales while maintaining a patient-first approach.
  • Accurately document all patient interactions within the CRM.
  • Navigate multiple platforms, including CRM systems, Five9 dialer, and patient management software.
  • Collaborate with leadership to optimize sales performance and patient satisfaction.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of proven inside sales, telesales, telehealth sales, or call center sales experience.
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.
  • Excellent closing, upselling, and cross-selling abilities.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable managing a high-volume outbound call environment.
  • Ability to multitask across multiple software platforms while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Professional, self-motivated, and driven by performance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling peptides, hormone therapies, telehealth services, pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, or wellness products.
  • Experience using Five9, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.
  • Background in healthcare, medical sales, or patient engagement.

Technical Requirements

  • Reliable desktop or laptop computer.
  • Stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Professional USB or Bluetooth headset with microphone.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $41,600 annual base salary + Uncapped commission with significant earning potential
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Ongoing sales coaching and career advancement opportunities
  • Join a fast-growing healthcare company with opportunities to grow into leadership roles

If you're a competitive sales professional who thrives in a performance-driven environment and enjoys helping patients while maximizing your income, we'd love to hear from you.

Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is a place to do great work, offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also a great place to work, providing you the unique, gamer-centric #LifeAtRazer experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.

Job Responsibilities :

Razer is seeking a highly strategic, culturally fluent, and operationally rigorous Senior Marketing Partnerships Manager (Console) to lead creator, talent partnerships, esports, and athlete strategies across the Console division, setting program strategies that increases product visibility, adoption, and revenue. This role serves as the marketing lead for Console Audio, Console Controllers, and Mobile, developing integrated influencer, creator, and esports strategies that accelerate awareness, engagement, and commercial growth across the business.


Acting as the central marketing owner for the Console category partnerships across influencers, esports, talent, and athletes. This role aligns cross-functional marketing teams—including Regional and Global Marketing, KOLs, Social, Paid Media, Gaming Partnerships, Ecommerce, and Product Marketing—around common business objectives and measurable outcomes. While this role does not directly manage these organizations, it provides strategic direction, campaign priorities, performance targets, and ongoing business leadership to ensure every marketing investment contributes to Console growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, own, and manage the creator, influencer, esports, and athlete strategies across the Console division—tied to the Console portfolio, NPI launches, partnerships, and major campaigns—including creator partnerships and campaign planning.
  • Recruit and manage Console-focused creators, ambassadors, and key opinion leaders (KOLs); partner with the Global Influencer and Regional teams to leverage the broader creator ecosystem and seeding programs while prioritizing Console business needs; and measure creator performance across awareness, engagement, conversion, and sales impact.
  • Translate brand and business objectives into measurable creator programs that drive audience engagement, conversation, and commercial impact—increasing product visibility, adoption, and revenue.
  • Lead development of go-to-market plans for influencer programs, and define influencer and partnership priorities for NPI launches, and sustain content, including creator seeding, KOL activations, and publisher and gaming partnership tie-ins.
  • Lead development of go-to-market plans for FPS and Console game releases, esports leagues, and tournaments—identifying the key games, product benefits, and influencer and esports partners needed to position Razer in front of the console audience, working with the esports, business development, and global and regional marketing teams to drive execution.
  • Manage high-profile creator and talent integrations from planning through execution—including negotiations, content coordination, activations, and product launches.
  • Build and manage relationships with key gaming creators, streamers, esports organizations, athletes, entertainers, agents, and talent representatives across multiple verticals. Increasing the exposure for Razer’s brand voice, console products and partnerships.
  • Set the seeding briefs and monthly seeding targets for both sustain and NPI launches, partnering with the Global Marketing team to ensure Console Seeding reaches its target audience across all regions.
  • Develop strategic partnerships with game publishers and platform partners, capitalizing on major game launches, esports moments, and cultural gaming events.
  • Manage feedback from influencers and pro players to inform and improve the Console product roadmap and share a clear point of view on how to innovate and lead in the console space.
  • Partner cross-functionally across Paid Media, Regional & Global Marketing, Community, Brand, eCommerce, and Business Development teams—and external partners—to deliver cohesive global campaigns for the Console influencer program.
  • Manage agency partners and oversee campaign execution to ensure work meets Razer's creative, operational, and business standards.
  • Measure creator and campaign performance across awareness, engagement, conversion, revenue, and ROI, and recommend optimizations based on consumer insights and analytics.
  • Lead marketing planning and business reviews, and present campaign performance and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Operate effectively across multiple high-visibility initiatives simultaneously while navigating compressed timelines, shifting priorities, and fast-moving launch environments.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • Minimum of 8 years of product management and marketing experience in consumer electronics industry; streaming product line marketing experience highly preferred with experience in gaming a big plus.
  • Experience developing and overseeing execution of marketing plans.
  • Experience with PC or consumer electronics sales channels: retail, direct, online and distribution.
  • Able to write marketing copy and provide design direction on creative including digital marketing, web merchandising, print ads, video, graphics, etc.
  • Has previously developed detailed marketing plans and was involved in articulating the strategy and requirements for success.
  • Work independently, prioritize, and handle multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Strong administrative, organizational, and communication skills include ability to successfully interact with executive management.
  • Preferred experience in working in a Global company with multiple stakeholders across different countries and time zones.
  • Must have Microsoft Office Experience: Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint

Education & Experience

College degree in marketing or other related discipline or equivalent experience.


Travel Requirements

Travel required up to 25%.

$124,800.00 - $217,672.00 (per annum)

raw.title: Assoc General Counsel - EU/Data Privacy - Clinical & Commercial
raw.excerpt: As a pharmaceutical support industry leader, UBC is devoted to empowering health solutions for a better tomorrow.
raw.description:
As a pharmaceutical support industry leader, UBC is devoted to empowering health solutions for a better tomorrow. We take pride in improving patient outcomes and advancing healthcare. At UBC, we provide services to enhance the entire drug development process and commercialization lifecycle - From clinical trial support to real-world evidence generation.

Embark on a rewarding career journey with UBC! Grow your career while making a meaningful impact on the world around you. UBC fosters a culture built on our Core Values being: Collaborative, Conscientious, Curious, Consultative, and Compassionate. We believe in an inclusive workplace that fosters creativity.

If you are seeking a career that will challenge, inspire, and reward you, join us at UBC!

Brief Description:

The Associate General Counsel will provide (a) primary strategic legal counsel on clinical and commercial (i.e., patient access and support, and copay, programs) and healthcare regulatory matters, including US and EU clinical trials, and (b) provide support to UBC’s Data Privacy and other Legal team members with regard to privacy and data protection, both with a focus on supporting regulated biopharmaceutical, clinical research, and commercial healthcare services, and operations. This role will also advise cross-functional business, compliance, clinical and commercial operations, EU (and as necessary, US) human resources and employee relations, information security, quality, and other UBC stakeholders and teams on complex legal and regulatory issues.

The successful candidate will bring broad and deep clinical trial and commercial regulatory knowledge and sound judgment, a firm understanding and experience with privacy and data protection (sufficient to support Privacy and Legal team functions and, as needed be a primary source of counsel in advising business-side stakeholders), and practical knowledge of EU employment law, including multi-jurisdictional employee relations, workforce transitions, employee privacy, works council or employee representative engagement, and employment-related data protection issues. The role requires comfort operating in a highly regulated and dynamic environment and partnering closely with business stakeholders to manage legal risk while enabling responsible innovation, compliant clinical research activities, and legally sound workforce decisions.

Specific job duties:

  • Serve as a primary/lead legal adviser with respect to the Company’s clinical and commercial biopharma services operations, regulatory, pharmacovigilance, real-world evidence, data management, and business teams on legal and regulatory issues arising in clinical and commercial CRO/biopharma services programs.
  • Provide legal support for clinical trial and commercial program regulatory documentation and operational processes, including informed consent language, authorization/enrolment form language, subject recruitment materials, investigator/site communications and agreements, trial data use, and cross-border data transfer considerations.
  • Support Privacy and Legal teammates with respect to, and serve as a primary resource in, advising business stakeholders on, compliance with privacy and data protection frameworks, including GDPR, UK GDPR, HIPAA state consumer privacy laws, health data privacy requirements, breach notification laws, and other applicable federal, state, and international requirements.
  • Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting clinical research, privacy, cybersecurity, data governance, health data, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies; assess business impact and recommend practical compliance strategies.
  • Develop, update, and operationalize privacy policies, procedures, templates, playbooks, training materials, and governance processes tailored to healthcare and clinical research activities.
  • Lead or advise on privacy impact assessments, data protection impact assessments, legitimate interest assessments, data mapping, records of processing activities, and risk analyses for clinical and healthcare data processing activities.
  • Support privacy-by-design and compliance-by-design reviews for new programs, systems, technologies, data initiatives, artificial intelligence tools, digital health solutions, and vendor engagements.
  • Partner with Human Resources, Employee Relations, Compliance, and business leaders on workforce initiatives in Europe, including coordination with local counsel on country-specific employment law requirements, works council or employee representative matters, collective consultation processes, and employee privacy considerations.
  • Provide practical legal guidance on EU and multi-jurisdictional employment law matters, including hiring, employment documentation, workplace policies, employee relations, disciplinary actions, terminations, redundancies, restructurings, consultation obligations, employee transfers, and employment-related disputes.
  • Draft, review, mark-up and negotiate client and vendor master and independent contractor master/service agreements, work orders and change orders, data processing agreements and data sharing agreements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and business clients, appropriately balancing legal risk, patient protection, operational feasibility, and business objectives.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel and internal stakeholders on complex regulatory, contractual, transactional, and compliance matters.

Supervisory Responsibility:

None initially, but subject to change based on evolution of role and candidate’s growth trajectory.

Required Qualifications and Skills/Core Competencies:

Qualifications –

  • Minimum of 15 years legal experience, including at least 7 years in-house legal experience at increasingly more responsible levels, in a clinical research organization, biopharma services, or pharmaceutical/biotechnology company.
  • Experience advising on global clinical trials, decentralized or hybrid trial models, real-world evidence, registries, patient access/support programs, pharmacovigilance.
  • Familiarity with global privacy laws and regulations.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, de-identification, anonymization, pseudonymization, cybersecurity, and data governance frameworks in a life sciences setting.
  • Experience advising on EU workforce matters, including multi-country employee relations, restructuring or redundancy processes, works council or employee representative engagement, workplace investigations, and employment litigation or dispute strategy.
  • Experience supporting privacy leadership in a privacy program implementation, including management of DPIAs and DSARs.

Skills/Core Competencies –

  • Strategic legal judgment and savvy risk assessment: Ability to assess complex clinical and commercial regulatory risks, as well as privacy considerations, and provide prudent, clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Business partnership with time sensitive/solutions orientation: Collaborative approach to supporting operational teams while maintaining appropriate legal and compliance safeguards; commitment and focus on prompt/timely assessment and solutions-delivery.
  • Regulatory fluency: Strong understanding of the intersection of privacy, healthcare, clinical trial, EU employment law, employee data protection, data governance, and technology requirements.
  • Contracting expertise: Ability to draft, negotiate, and operationalize sophisticated commercial contracts, and privacy, data protection, clinical research, and vendor terms.
  • Leadership and influence: Ability to guide cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive alignment across legal, compliance, privacy, technology, clinical, and commercial teams.
  • Pragmatism and accountability: Strong ownership mindset, sound risk tolerance, and ability to deliver practical advice under tight timelines.

Reporting Relationship:

The position will report to, and support, the SVP/Chief Legal Officer, and support (but not report to) the Data Protection Officer (who reports to SVP/Chief Legal Officer)

UBC Benefits:

At UBC, employee growth and well-being are always at the forefront. We offer an extensive range of benefits to ensure that you have everything you need to thrive personally and professionally. Here are some of the exciting perks UBC offers:

  • Remote opportunities
  • Competitive salaries
  • Growth opportunities for promotion
  • 401K with company match
  • Tuition reimbursement (after 90 days of employment)
  • Flexible work environment
  • Discretionary PTO (Paid Time Off)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee assistance programs
  • Medical, Dental, and vision coverage
  • HSA/FSA
  • Telemedicine (Virtual doctor appointments)
  • Wellness program
  • Adoption assistance
  • Short-term disability (after 90 days of employment)
  • Long-term disability
  • Life insurance
  • Discount programs

UBC is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class. We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that fosters respect for each other, our clients, and our patients.

raw.description:
Solutions Architect – Cloud Infrastructure

Location: Remote from France

Engagement: Independent Contractor, B2B

Compensation: OTE — 70/30 split

About Virtuozzo

Virtuozzo is a leader in operating system and cloud infrastructure software for service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises. Our technology enables organisations to build, operate, and monetise cloud and AI services on their own infrastructure, under their own brand, and on their own terms. Across virtualisation, storage, Kubernetes, automation, and cloud management, we help customers improve performance, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency while reducing overall cost and complexity. Virtuozzo provides a flexible alternative to VMware, hyperscale, and legacy cloud platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to support our Territory Manager and lead the technical side of the sales process. You will act as the technical counterpart to the Territory Manager, working directly with prospects, customers, and partners from initial discovery through solution validation and commercial close.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing individual contributor role. You will combine strong infrastructure knowledge with commercial awareness, helping customers understand how Virtuozzo can address their technical requirements, operational challenges, and business objectives.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to prospects, customers, and partners throughout the sales cycle.
  • Partner closely with the Territory Manager to develop account strategies, progress opportunities, and remove technical barriers to purchase.
  • Lead technical discovery to understand each customer’s infrastructure, workloads, operating model, commercial priorities, and decision criteria.
  • Design and present solution architectures based on Virtuozzo’s cloud infrastructure platform.
  • Translate customer requirements into clear technical solutions and explain their operational and commercial value.
  • Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, trials, and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Engage confidently with stakeholders at different levels, from infrastructure engineers and architects to CTOs and business leaders.
  • Respond to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, clearly articulating Virtuozzo’s technical capabilities and competitive value.
  • Address technical questions relating to architecture, deployment, integration, performance, security, scalability, and migration.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Professional Services to validate solutions and communicate customer requirements.
  • Provide structured customer and market feedback to help inform product positioning and roadmap discussions.
  • Support a clear handover of successful opportunities to the teams responsible for implementation, onboarding, and ongoing customer support.
  • Contribute to technical sales documentation, reference architectures, competitive materials, and internal enablement resources.
  • Maintain current knowledge of Virtuozzo products, the competitive landscape, and relevant cloud infrastructure technologies.

What You Bring

  • Strong experience in sales engineering, pre-sales consulting, solution architecture, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience supporting complex B2B software or infrastructure sales cycles.
  • Solid knowledge of virtualisation, cloud infrastructure, storage, networking, Linux, or related infrastructure technologies.
  • A strong understanding of modern infrastructure architectures, deployment models, configuration, integration, and performance considerations.
  • Experience leading technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, workshops, trials, or proof-of-concept projects.
  • The ability to translate business and operational requirements into credible technical solutions—and explain complex technology in clear commercial language.
  • Strong consulting, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Confidence engaging both technical specialists and senior decision-makers.
  • A customer-focused and commercially aware approach, with the ability to influence complex buying decisions.
  • The ability to work independently while maintaining close alignment with the Territory Manager and wider sales team.
  • Fluent English and professional fluency in either French or German would be a great advantage to support the regional efforts.
  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, partner engagements, industry events, and internal meetings when required.

Strong Advantages

  • Experience working with cloud service providers, managed service providers, hosting companies, telecommunications providers, or infrastructure software vendors.
  • Knowledge of private, hybrid, sovereign, or multi-tenant cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with technologies or ecosystems such as KVM, VMware, OpenStack, Kubernetes, software-defined storage, and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience working in a channel, partner-led, or service-provider go-to-market model.
  • Experience with customer onboarding or technical project coordination.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • The quality and effectiveness of technical discovery and proposed solution architectures.
  • Progression of qualified opportunities through technical validation.
  • Successful demonstrations, workshops, trials, and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • The ability to identify and resolve technical blockers during the sales cycle.
  • Contribution to territory performance, technical win rates, and customer confidence.
  • Quality of collaboration with Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery teams.
  • Contribution to reusable technical sales materials and customer insights.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote B2B engagement based in France.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a high level of autonomy.
  • A visible role with meaningful influence over customer solutions, competitive positioning, and territory success.
  • Direct collaboration with an experienced international Sales, Product, and Engineering organization.
  • The opportunity to work on technically complex infrastructure solutions in a rapidly changing market.
  • A supportive, engineering-driven culture with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Eligibility to participate in the company’s share option program, subject to applicable plan terms and approvals.
  • Additional perks and engagement support depending on location and contractual setup.

Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make:

As a Field Marketing Specialist at Risepoint, you will play a key role in expanding access to affordable, career-focused education. By building relationships within local communities, promoting workforce-aligned degree programs, and supporting university partners. The Field Marketing Team at Risepoint is a diverse group of professionals with specialized expertise in healthcare, K-12 education, and business industries. We serve as trusted representatives of our university partners, working directly within local communities to build meaningful connections with prospective students and organizations.


As the outward-facing presence of our partners, we craft and implement tailored outreach strategies at the local, state, and regional levels. These strategies are designed not only to strengthen brand recognition, but also to cultivate long-term relationships that drive enrollment growth and open access to new audiences.


This opportunity will represent Fitchburg State University (Fitchburg) and recruit qualified students into online business and healthcare degree programs throughout the states of New Hampshire, Vermont and Maine. We are looking for an experienced sales or business development professional, who is passionate about higher education and understands the value of advanced degree programs.


This is a remote position that requires at least 75% of domestic travel and must reside in New Hampshire, Maine, Vermont, or Massachusetts.


How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life:

What You Will Do:

  • Market online advanced healthcare and business degree programs offered by Fitchburg State University to community college students and healthcare professionals throughout the states of New Hampshire, Vermont, Maine and key counties in New York.
  • Successfully develop and manage a territory to increase brand awareness and interest throughout the state.
  • Achieve monthly lead goals by organizing and facilitating 15 in-person recruiting events (information sessions) each month.
  • Attend regional and state conferences to network with administrators, generate leads, and establish new relationships for future events.
  • Meet with community college and healthcare leaders, throughout the territory to establish new partnerships and gain access for recruitment sessions across healthcare facilities and community colleges.
  • Consistently introduce and leverage the roll-out of marketing campaigns and establish new partnerships to expand the territory.
  • Utilize social media tools to expand recruiting efforts and promote the university partner’s program offerings.
  • Expand knowledge of regional and national programmatic and workforce trends and effectively communicate to internal and external stakeholders on a regular basis.

What Success Looks Like:

  • 3 Monthly B2B’s
  • 15 Recruitment Events, including 10 in-person events and 5 additional events/activities.
  • Proper territory management /Acquiring new accounts to gain access to live sessions

How Impact Will be Measured:

  • Leads
  • Events
  • Partnerships

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most:

  • Bachelor’s degree required with a minimum of 2 years of sales, field sales experience or business development experience or healthcare industry related experience.
  • Operational Excellence: highly competent organizational and time management skills; professional success and continuous career growth, preferably in the healthcare industry
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and be self-motivated to achieve monthly/quarterly KPIs.
  • Results oriented professional with consistent, strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficient with using Microsoft applications.
  • Ability to successfully manage a large geographic area.
  • Location Requirements:
    • Must reside in New Hampshire, Maine, Vermont, or Massachusetts.
    • Ability to travel throughout the assigned territory
    • This is a remote role that requires extensive travel (minimum of 75%) across New Hampshire, Maine, and Vermont, with potential travel to key counties in Massachusetts. The position focuses on active territory management and expansion in partnership with Fitchburg State University.

Experience That’s Great to Have:

  • Basic reporting and data organization skills
  • Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce
  • Experience with brand promotion and lead generation activities
  • Preferred: 2 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, healthcare sales, or a healthcare-related industry.
