The SMB Business Development team is responsible for managing key partnership moments with our most strategic restaurant partners. Our team steps in at pivotal times—such as contract renewals, exclusivity negotiations, and high-impact strategic initiatives—to ensure long-term success before transitioning accounts back to the broader Account Management team. We collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Strategic Finance, Selection, US Local Markets, and Legal to drive retention, exclusivity, and deal efficiency at critical junctures.

About the Role

As Manager, SMB Business Development - Retention, you will lead our efforts to drive success in key partnership moments, ensuring that our most valuable restaurant partners maximize their potential on our platform. You will own strategic interventions that drive retention and exclusivity, execute high-stakes deal strategies, and enhance product adoption during pivotal phases of the restaurant partnership lifecycle. Additionally, you will lead a team of four direct reports, focusing on their growth and effectiveness in executing high-impact partnership engagements. This role requires a strategic mindset, strong negotiation skills, and cross-functional collaboration.

You will report to Blair Toll, Sr. Manager of Business Development, within the Rx Success organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own Key Partnership Moments – Drive successful engagement at critical phases such as renewals, exclusivity negotiations, and strategic initiatives before transitioning accounts back to Account Management.
  • Lead a High-Performing Team – Manage and develop four direct reports, fostering career growth and performance excellence.
  • Drive Strategic Initiatives – Lead the Business Development marketplace retention strategy, including proactive renewals, upsells, churn mitigation, deal structuring, and performance optimization at crucial points in the relationship.
  • Execute Competitive Strategies – Develop and implement competitive strategies in response to evolving market dynamics and competitor moves.
  • Work Cross-Functionally – Partner closely with Account Management, Account Development, Strategic Finance, Selection, US Local Markets, and Legal teams to optimize retention and enhance partner value during key moments.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have extensive experience in strategic account management – 6+ years of experience in restaurant partnerships, business development, or enterprise account management.

Workster is partnering with a leading international technology provider within the iGaming and Sportsbook industry to recruit a Business Development Manager. This is a fully remote B2B opportunity, open globally with a preference for candidates based in EMEA, including Turkey.

The role will focus on driving new B2B partnerships, expanding the company’s presence across key markets, and promoting an innovative portfolio of iGaming, Sportsbook, and AI-powered technology solutions.

Your Role

  • Identify and develop new B2B business opportunities within the iGaming and Sportsbook industry

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of operators, platforms, aggregators, and other industry partners

  • Drive the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and closing

  • Present and promote Sportsbook, gaming, platform, and AI-powered solutions to prospective partners

  • Develop relationships with key decision-makers across international iGaming markets

  • Identify opportunities where AI-driven technology, automation, personalisation, and data insights can create additional value for partners

  • Negotiate commercial agreements and establish long-term strategic partnerships

  • Represent the company at international iGaming conferences, exhibitions, and networking events

  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies across iGaming and Sportsbook

  • Collaborate with product, commercial, marketing, and technical teams to support client acquisition and growth

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline information, and commercial reporting

raw.description:
Gorilla Logic is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join a client-facing product team focused on building and improving high-traffic, user-facing web experiences.

In this role, you will work across a mature Ruby on Rails monolith and React frontend, owning features from architecture and implementation through testing and production release. You will contribute to a conversion-sensitive product experience where experimentation, measurable outcomes, and continuous iteration are central to how the team works.

You will also have the opportunity to build product capabilities powered by LLMs and online AI inference, using modern AI development techniques to reduce friction and improve the user experience.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who combines strong full-stack technical skills with a product mindset and is comfortable collaborating directly with a US-based client and cross-functional team.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, test, and ship full-stack product features using Ruby on Rails and React.
  • Work effectively within a large, established Rails monolith, safely extending existing functionality and improving the codebase as you go.
  • Build and refine React components and user-facing experiences with attention to performance, usability, latency, and conversion.
  • Own features across backend, frontend, and data rather than handing work off between technical boundaries.
  • Build product capabilities using LLMs and online AI inference, including prompting, context management, tools, and model reasoning.
  • Develop AI-powered text generation experiences that improve user workflows and reduce friction.
  • Design features so their impact on product, funnel, and conversion metrics can be measured.
  • Instrument and support experiments to evaluate product changes and inform future iterations.
  • Validate solutions using automated and traditional testing practices, as well as AI evals and tracing when applicable.
  • Apply strong engineering and system design principles to build observable, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready solutions.
  • Use agentic and AI-assisted software engineering techniques throughout planning, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, designers, and engineers to define solutions and identify technical opportunities and constraints.
  • Prototype and release MVPs early to gather feedback and support iterative product development.
  • Balance user experience quality, technical investment, and business objectives when making engineering decisions.
  • Participate in technical scoping and prioritization, helping stakeholders understand what is possible and where technical complexity exists.

What You Bring

  • Senior-level professional software engineering experience with strong full-stack development capabilities.
  • Substantial production experience working with Ruby on Rails, specifically within large, established monolithic applications.
  • Experience navigating mature Rails codebases, including legacy patterns, broad test suites, and careful database migrations.
  • Strong, current experience building production applications with React.
  • Experience with React component composition, state management, and frontend architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end across backend, frontend, and data layers.
  • Strong product mindset with the ability to consider user experience and business outcomes when making technical decisions.
  • Experience building or improving products against measurable funnel, conversion, engagement, or similar product metrics.
  • Experience with experimentation and the ability to evaluate results objectively to inform product decisions.
  • Strong software quality practices, including automated testing, observability, monitoring, and tracing.
  • Experience working with modern CI/CD and container-based deployment environments.
  • Effective use of AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools as part of day-to-day software delivery.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and system design principles for scalable production applications.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate directly with US-based clients and distributed teams operating in US Central Time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating LLMs such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, or open-weight models into production applications.
  • Experience building user-facing features that use online AI inference or text generation.
  • Practical knowledge of prompt design, streaming responses, latency management, fallback strategies, and AI output guardrails.
  • Experience implementing evals and tracing to measure and monitor AI-generated content quality.
  • Experience with A/B testing, experimentation platforms, or feature-flag frameworks.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Argo CD.
  • Experience deploying or operating applications in AWS environments.
  • Experience working on high-traffic consumer, marketplace, or SaaS products.
  • Experience optimizing forms, onboarding experiences, submission workflows, or other conversion-sensitive user journeys.

At C9Staff, we’re passionate about connecting exceptional Filipino professionals with stable, global clients who truly value long-term relationships. As a freelancer in the Philippines, we understand your need for stability. That’s why we focus exclusively on long-term clients who value enduring partnerships. We don’t just offer jobs; we offer career paths. Most of our clients stay with us for at least 4-5 years, so if you’re selected and find your perfect fit, you’re in it for the long haul! Imagine being recognized as a top performer and getting an all-expenses-paid trip to the US to visit your client. Or starting as a Data Entry Specialist and growing into a Data Analyst role over the years! These are just some of our success stories that make us more than just a remote staffing agency.

At C9Staff, we don’t treat our team as mere head-counts; we root for your growth and success every step of the way. 🚀

So, are you ready to be our next success story? 😊

🌟 The Opportunity

Are you the kind of person who lights up when everything finally clicks into place, when every moving part of a project runs smoothly because of you? Do you love building order out of chaos, keeping communication clear, and helping teams deliver their best work?

We’re looking for a Client Success Project Manager to join our client’s fast-growing digital marketing agency, a team built by industry veterans who understand what it takes to scale multi-location brands. They live and breathe both franchising and digital marketing, helping business owners grow through powerful, localized campaigns that actually work.

Your mission? Be the central connector who keeps things running behind the scenes. You’ll partner with Client Success Managers and other department PMs, Creative, Media, Finance, and Technology, to ensure every campaign launches accurately, on time, and with flawless coordination. If you thrive on communication, love creating clarity in fast-moving environments, and take pride in the small details that lead to big wins, you’ll love this role.

👤 The Client

This client is a fast-growing digital-marketing and operations partner built by franchise owners for franchise owners. Their founders, having owned multiple franchise locations themselves, saw that traditional agencies didn’t truly understand the multi-unit, local-marketing model, so they created a business that does.

They specialise in serving multi-location brands and franchise networks through “Facebook/Instagram-first” (and broader omni-channel) marketing, plus strong operational systems, analytics, and support.

  1. Deep understanding of franchise business models, local unit scalability, and multi-site operations
  2. A marriage of marketing execution + operations + technology + client-success mindset
  3. Remote-first team environment, cross-functional collaboration, rapid execution and disciplined process

  • Documentation & Follow-Through 🗂️: Keep communication, updates, and follow-ups documented in Airtable or Asana
  • Leadership Visibility 📣: Prepare project summaries and updates for leadership review
  • Workflow Optimization ⚙️: Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve cross-department efficiency
  • Onboarding & Rollout Support 🚀: Assist in implementing new initiatives and ensuring consistent execution

What You Can Expect

As Program Manager, Customer Advocacy, you will lead Zoom's end-to-end customer reviews strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, building a sustainable, always-on program that transforms customer evidence into a strategic engine for market proof and competitive differentiation. This role sits at the intersection of customer advocacy, marketing strategy, and analyst relations, with direct responsibility for elevating the customer voice into AI visibility, marketing narratives, and sales enablement at scale. You will move Zoom's approach from episodic, award-driven solicitations to a strategic program that serves analyst evaluation cycles, supports AEO/GEO visibility, and feeds cross-functional marketing initiatives across content, demand generation, and social. For a strategist who is equally comfortable setting direction and executing in the details, this role offers the scope, visibility, and organizational impact to build something genuinely differentiated.


About the Team

The Content and Customer Advocacy team sits at the center of Zoom's marketing engine, shaping the stories, strategies, and digital experiences that connect Zoom's brand with its most important audiences. We own content strategy, editorial programs, customer advocacy, and the digital experience on zoom.com, working across Sales, Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, and Analyst Relations to turn customer evidence into a competitive advantage. We are a high-impact, cross-functional team that stays relentlessly focused on measurable outcomes and business impact.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end customer review strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, shifting from episodic award-driven solicitations to a strategic, always-on program that drives market proof and competitive differentiation.
  • Own the customer review calendar, balancing continuous review generation across key product categories with strategic alignment to analyst evaluation periods and market priorities.
  • Prioritize AEO/GEO visibility of customer reviews to maximize AI citations, support core marketing narratives, and influence technology buyer evaluations across the dark funnel.
  • Manage Zoom's presence across all subscribed and non-subscribed review platforms, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and strategic positioning while tracking volume, quality, ratings, sentiment, and competitive standing.
  • Support key Analyst Relations market evaluations including Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and Gartner Magic Quadrant with high-quality customer references, partnering with Product Marketing and AR to match references to specific product, industry, and geographic requirements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Content, Integrated Marketing, Social Media, and Digital teams to drive multi-channel promotion and consumption of customer reviews.
  • Partner with reviews vendors to shift relationships from tactical solicitation to a strategic content engine, leveraging comparison reports, customer story generation, and reference identification.
  • Surface growth opportunities by integrating customer reviews into internal AI search tools, identifying key strategic focus markets, and building organizational expertise across review platform capabilities including intent leads, content licensing, and emerging features.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B technology marketing experience in roles such as integrated marketing, campaigns, field marketing, or content, combined with 3-5 years of direct experience in customer advocacy, customer reviews management, or analyst relations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing third-party review platforms including Gartner Peer Insights, G2, and TrustRadius, with the ability to track and analyze volume, quality, ratings, sentiment, and competitive standing.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, stakeholders, and deadlines across a complex cross-functional environment.
  • Superb customer-facing communication skills, with experience directing customer time and attention in ways that are respectful, strategic, and effective.
  • Comfort with data, metrics, and target-setting, including experience managing toward stretch goals and clearly reporting program performance to leadership.
  • Experience supporting analyst evaluations such as Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and Gartner Magic Quadrant with customer references, and a strong understanding of the B2B technology buyer journey and the role customer evidence plays in purchase decisions.
  • Familiarity with AEO/GEO concepts, customer advocacy platforms, and reference management tools; background in SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or enterprise technology marketing is a plus.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$76,800.00

Maximum:

$186,200.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

About the Job

Are you ready to help further shape the US Sanofi Vaccines to become a more agile, digital, and business to business-driven organization?

Do you thrive in an agile, collaborative, business acumen driven organization where positive outcomes are rewarded? Have you ever wanted to own your own franchise and be accountable to drive business outcomes across a full portfolio of vaccines, and strengthen customer relationships? We are responsible for the implementation of a new go-to market strategy within the US Sanofi Vaccines business unit and searching for several Area Business Managers to pave the pathway forward with us.

The Sanofi Vaccines team aim is to remain an industry leader through evolving the way we operate and build our new business model. This model will be that can be responsive to fast changing customer needs and environment, engage in a Business to Business activities model that supports the growth of HCPs vaccine programs, with the right support to engage customers in the moments that matter in vaccines, while rewarding high performers and growth of our vaccines business.

The Area Business Manager (ABM) will be responsible for engaging in account-based business to business interactions within customer segments (Pediatrics, Family/General Practice, IDN/IHNs, Health Systems, and Federally Qualified Health Centers), while presenting clinically focused selling messages to create and grow revenue and to consistently deliver the Sanofi Vaccines portfolio goals.

The ABM will act as an “account orchestrator” to provide a more cohesive customer experience and ultimately improve customer and patient outcomes by leveraging cross-functional support from internal teams across US vaccines. The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, and independence, and take ownership for meeting and exceeding individual business goals – simply put the ABM plays the role of business owner for their book of business. This will be accomplished by driving performance and delivering results in a compliant manner with a high degree of integrity.

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI Vaccines driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

  • Maximize budget allocated to the geographic territory to support execution of strategies and tactics and generate/ grow the business.

  • Participate and help lead initiatives to support sales success as assigned (e.g. participate in industry related congresses, local and regional meetings and medical conferences).

About You

Basic Qualifications

Minimum required skills & experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • A minimum of 3+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device sales experience required with business to business knowledge.

  • Broad understanding of the healthcare environment, decision making processes & market trends with a proven track record of accessing decision makers

  • Possess skills and success within a business to business environment

raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Storage Engineer to operate and maintain Ceph-based storage services supporting our on-premises Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms.

The role focuses on the day-to-day operation, reliability, and continuous improvement of production storage services, including monitoring, maintenance, upgrades, capacity management, hardware replacement, performance troubleshooting, and failure recovery.

This is primarily an operations and engineering role, rather than a position focused on developing a new distributed storage solution. Candidates with experience operating or engineering distributed storage platforms are encouraged to apply.

You will work closely with Kubernetes platform, network, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure storage services remain reliable, scalable, and supportable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and maintain Ceph and OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF) environments.
  • Monitor cluster health, capacity, latency, throughput, placement groups, and storage device status.
  • Manage OSD and node replacement, recovery, rebalancing, backfill, scrubbing, and routine maintenance activities.
  • Diagnose and resolve degraded placement groups, slow operations, quorum issues, device failures, and network-related storage issues.
  • Plan and perform Ceph and ODF upgrades, patching, capacity expansion, and configuration changes.
  • Support block and shared-file storage using ODF, Ceph CSI, RBD, and CephFS.
  • Troubleshoot persistent volume provisioning, attachment, mounting, expansion, and storage performance issues.
  • Maintain monitoring dashboards, alerts, operational runbooks, capacity plans, and recovery procedures.
  • Test and validate recovery procedures for disk, node, service, and network failures.
  • Coordinate server, disk, firmware, and network maintenance activities with infrastructure teams.
  • Participate in production incident response, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
  • Automate routine storage operations and maintenance activities where appropriate.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience operating and supporting Ceph environments.
  • Experience with storage monitoring, capacity planning, upgrades, expansion, maintenance, and component replacement.
  • Experience benchmarking storage workloads and analysing performance bottlenecks.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across storage software, Linux, networking, and physical hardware.
  • Good understanding of HDD, SSD, NVMe, HBA, firmware, and storage networking.
  • Experience with automation or scripting using Ansible, Python, Shell, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of backup, snapshots, replication, recovery, and disaster recovery operations.
  • Experience supporting production environments and responding to storage-related incidents.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, or OpenShift Data Foundation will be highly advantageous.

Practice Area: Appellate & Litigation / Trial Support

Position Overview

A growing civil litigation law firm is seeking an experienced Appellate & Litigation Support Attorney to join its team. This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished appellate attorney and exceptional legal writer who enjoys working closely with trial counsel on sophisticated insurance defense and civil litigation matters.

The attorney will handle all aspects of appellate practice while serving as a strategic resource to trial attorneys throughout the litigation process. Responsibilities will include appellate briefing, complex legal research and analysis, trial and hearing support, preservation of appellate issues, and advising attorneys and clients on litigation strategy and potential outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings recent insurance defense experience and at least 5 years of substantive appellate experience.

This position offers significant flexibility and may be performed remotely or from one of the firm's office locations. Candidates must reside in Florida or Georgia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle all phases of appellate litigation, including drafting appellate briefs, motions, memoranda, and other filings.
  • Collaborate with trial attorneys to provide strategic litigation and trial support on complex insurance defense matters.
  • Attend trials as needed to serve as appellate counsel, assist with preservation of issues for appeal, and provide real-time strategic guidance.
  • Conduct sophisticated legal research and analysis involving complex procedural and substantive issues.
  • Draft and review dispositive motions, post-trial motions, and other significant litigation filings.
  • Assist attorneys with hearing and trial preparation.
  • Analyze complex legal matters, identify potential risks and appellate issues, and develop effective case strategies.
  • Advise attorneys and clients regarding legal strategy, exposure, and potential outcomes.
  • Work collaboratively with attorneys, paralegals, and support professionals to ensure efficient case management and exceptional client service.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and timely case files, research, and documentation.
  • Meet established billable-hour expectations and internal deadlines.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as needed to support the firm's litigation and appellate practices.

What This Opportunity Offers

  • Remote work flexibility for qualified Florida and Georgia residents.
  • Opportunity to focus on sophisticated appellate, insurance defense, and litigation support work.
  • Exposure to complex civil litigation and high-level legal strategy.
  • Collaborative environment working closely with experienced trial attorneys.
  • Opportunity to play a meaningful role in both trial strategy and appellate outcomes.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

Ideal Candidate

The strongest candidate will be an experienced appellate attorney who combines outstanding legal writing with recent, hands-on insurance defense experience. This individual should be equally comfortable analyzing a complex trial record, developing appellate strategy, drafting a persuasive brief, and working alongside trial counsel to protect the record and position a matter for a successful appeal.

Candidates must reside in Florida or Georgia and must have an active Florida Bar license.

Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school.
  • Active admission to the Florida Bar.
  • 5+ years of substantive appellate experience.
  • Recent insurance defense litigation experience.
  • Demonstrated experience handling appellate briefs, complex legal research, and sophisticated written advocacy.
  • Insurance litigation experience involving one or more of the following:
    • First-party and third-party insurance claims
    • Insurance coverage
    • Bad faith litigation
    • Personal injury defense
    • Auto liability
    • Premises liability
    • Property damage
    • Products liability
  • Exceptional legal research, analytical, and writing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Strong understanding of appellate procedure and preservation of issues for appeal.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong critical-thinking, judgment, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative legal team.

Preferred Attributes

  • Significant experience handling insurance defense appeals.
  • Experience providing appellate counsel and support during complex civil trials.
  • Strong record of drafting persuasive appellate briefs and dispositive motions.
  • Ability to quickly analyze complex records and identify key legal and appellate issues.
  • Client-focused approach with a commitment to responsiveness and professional excellence.
  • Self-motivated attorney who is comfortable taking ownership of cases and projects from inception through resolution.

raw.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Role Overview

The Director, Pharmacy Solutions serves as the primary pharmacy strategic partner for an assigned portfolio of practices across The US Oncology Network. The Director leads practice-level infusion and oral drug strategy and optimization, translating Network pharmacy priorities into measurable execution by integrating clinical evidence, drug economics, payer and manufacturer dynamics, regulatory requirements, and practice operations. Through trusted relationships with pharmacy, physician, operational, and financial leaders, the Director develops practice-specific strategies that advance clinically appropriate therapy selection, optimize infusion and oral drug utilization and performance, improve patient access, and support safe, consistent, economically sustainable oncology care and long-term practice growth.

The Director owns the pharmacy relationship, strategic account plan, and engagement cadence for assigned practices. The role coordinates enterprise resources to address practice priorities, resolve barriers, and maintain accountability for results while contributing field insight to Network-wide initiatives and governance.


Preferred Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate will be a credible, practice-centered oncology pharmacy leader who combines sound judgment with disciplined execution. They will build trust quickly, navigate competing priorities, communicate clearly with clinical and business leaders, and maintain accountability across a varied portfolio of practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own assigned practice relationships and strategic account plans. Serve as the primary pharmacy partner for assigned practices; establish trusted relationships with pharmacy, physician, operations, and finance leaders; understand each practice’s priorities, risks, and operating environment; maintain actionable account plans; and coordinate a consistent engagement and performance-review cadence.
  • Lead drug strategy and therapy optimization. Integrate clinical evidence, pathways and P&T guidance, utilization and site-of-care trends, reimbursement, payer requirements, manufacturer dynamics, value-based care considerations, dispensing and administration operations, and practice economics to identify opportunities and guide clinically appropriate, financially sustainable therapy selection and adoption. Develop practice-specific strategies to optimize drug performance, including formulary and preferred-product adoption, payer alignment, patient access, workflow readiness, and response to market changes across the product life cycle.
  • Drive readiness, adoption, and sustained performance. Translate Network drug priorities into practice-specific implementation plans; assess clinical, operational, financial, dispensing, administration, and access readiness; align stakeholders; surface and remove barriers; support change management; and monitor adoption, utilization, and outcomes through stabilization.
  • Connect data and insight to action. Analyze clinical, financial, operational, access, dispensing, administration, and utilization trends across therapies; validate assumptions and data limitations; identify variation and performance gaps; develop decision-ready recommendations; and track adoption, access, economic, and patient-care results with practice and enterprise partners.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution and represent practice needs. Partner across GPO, operations, finance, research, analytics, technology, payer, manufacturer, and physician-governance teams to align support, resolve issues, and ensure enterprise solutions reflect practice needs and reduce friction.
  • Contribute expertise to Network initiatives and governance. Lead or participate in priority projects, Pharmacy & Therapeutics committees or subcommittees, and improvement efforts; share field intelligence and scalable practices; and contribute to consistent Network execution.

Minimum Requirement

  • Degree or equivalent and typically requires 10+ years of relevant experience. Less years required if has relevant Master’s or Doctorate qualifications.

Education / Licensure

  • PharmD or equivalent pharmacy degree required.
  • MBA, MHA, MS, or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Board certification in oncology pharmacy preferred.

Critical Skills

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in oncology pharmacy, community oncology, healthcare operations, drug strategy, market access, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with oncology practices or health-system leaders to improve clinical, financial, operational, access, or quality outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of community oncology and the oncology industry, with demonstrated expertise in drug strategy and therapy optimization, including clinical evidence and pathways, therapy adoption, utilization management, medically integrated dispensing, administration operations, reimbursement, payer dynamics, patient access, manufacturer and product life-cycle dynamics, drug economics, and regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex projects or portfolios across a matrixed organization and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience using clinical, financial, and operational data to identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and monitor outcomes.
  • Experience with advanced therapies, value-based care, medically integrated dispensing, or specialty pharmacy preferred.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Practice partnership — builds credibility, listens actively, understands local context, and balances practice needs with Network priorities.
  • Drug strategy and therapy optimization — synthesizes clinical evidence, pathways and P&T guidance, utilization, economics, reimbursement, payer and manufacturer dynamics, patient access, dispensing and administration operations, and patient impact into clear practice-specific recommendations.
  • Strategic account and portfolio management — prioritizes opportunities, maintains clear plans, coordinates stakeholders, and drives accountable follow-through across multiple practices and initiatives.
  • Influence and communication — communicates complex concepts clearly and credibly with physicians, executives, pharmacy leaders, operational teams, and technical partners.
  • Execution discipline — defines outcomes, milestones, measures, risks, and escalation paths; adapts plans while maintaining momentum and accountability.
  • Analytical judgment — evaluates complex and incomplete information, states assumptions and data limitations, and converts insight into timely action.
  • Change leadership — anticipates adoption barriers, aligns stakeholders, supports practices through change, and sustains performance after implementation.
  • Learning agility — monitors emerging therapies and market dynamics and rapidly translates new information into implications for assigned practices.

Working Conditions

  • Remote opportunity within the United States, subject to company policy.
  • Travel up to 30% for practice engagement, internal meetings, and relevant industry events.
  • General office demands.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States; sponsorship is not available for this position.

Qualifications and Experience


Qualifications

  • Sólidos conocimientos de motores diesel, sistemas hidráulicos y neumáticos.

Experience

ON-CALL TOXICOLOGIST

To support ICF’s dynamic growth and expanding client base, we are seeking an On-Call Toxicologist to work in our Health Science Practice. This group of 100+ science professionals provide toxicology, hazard assessment, epidemiology, risk assessment, exposure assessment, environmental modeling, and related support that addresses the full spectrum of potentially hazardous agents, including chemicals and microbes. We specialize in identifying, quantifying, and documenting the effects of environmental pollutants, such as metals, pesticides, and volatile organic compounds, on human health and the environment.


The On-Call Toxicologist’s project work will support federal agencies (such as U.S. EPA and NIEHS), state agencies, and private sector clients in developing reports that assess the human health impacts of pollutants. Specific activities include qualitative literature review activities, support for scientific meetings, and project management. The On-Call Toxicologist will contribute to the development of innovative, accurate, timely, and high-quality products and services, typically working on multiple projects with all levels of staff; they have the opportunity to apply their academic knowledge, gain exposure to major projects, and interact with experts and clients in the field, while building content knowledge and consulting skills. Location: Remote.


Hours: This is a part-time on-call position. The On-Call Toxicologist will work between 5 and 30 hours per week to support work on an as-needed basis. The hours are flexible. Students pursuing a Ph.D., scientists in a Post Doc, and toxicologists who are taking a break from full time employment are encouraged to apply.


Please note: This position does not involve hands-on laboratory or field work. 


As an On-Call Toxicologist, you will:

  • Work on a diverse team that specializes in identifying and quantifying the effects of environmental pollutants, such as metals, pesticides, and volatile organic compounds, on human health and the environment.
  • Review scientific and peer-reviewed literature to research a broad variety of scientific topics in environmental risk assessment, synthesize findings, and communicate them through various formats and media (e.g., written reports, online websites, visualizations).
  • Use a variety of data management and visualization tools to maintain rigorous databases and use them to create engaging end-product visualizations and dashboards.
  • Conduct study data extraction using electronic systematic review procedures and tools.
  • Conduct data and statistical analysis involving Excel, Access, R, SAS, Python, SQL, VBA, and/or other software. 
  • Participate in and support scientific workshop activities including notetaking, developing workshop summary reports, and other event logistics.  
  • Follow and implement standardized QA/QC procedures on documents and reports.
  • Perform Toxicology systematic review tasks, including literature screening, study quality evaluation, and study data extraction.
  • Support risk assessment report development, including writing methods, results, and discussion sections, reviewing conclusions based on the data, and synthesizing findings into a weight of evidence analysis.
  • Conduct dose-response analyses when needed.

As an On-Call Toxicologist, you will have:


  • The ability to interact with and present project updates to clients and develop quality professional relationships. Strong data-science skills including experience managing and visualizing large datasets
  • Exceptional research and scientific writing skills, including editing, using reference management software (e.g. EndNote), and proofreading skills.  
  • Strong qualitative and quantitative data collection, analysis, and visualization skills. Experience with environmental science systematic reviews is a plus.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, including experience with developing and delivering presentations.  
  • The ability to prioritize, multi-task, and work in groups, individually, and virtually under strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Toxicology, Epidemiology, Public Health, Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or related subject, or Bachelor’s degree in any of these fields combined with equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience.

It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Our SrAccounts Receivable Analyst is responsible for the collection of client receivables in accordance with contractual agreements. This includes review, maintenance and resolution of disputes, review of Clinical Trial revenue and expenses, review of study accounts receivable aging, patient accounts and pass through invoices, study finance trackers, patient trackers and contracts, as well as interaction with various departments in order to determine the validity of charges as well as the collection of those charges from sponsors.


Additionally, this position provides assistance to the Finance and Budget & Contracts departments on specifically identified projects and tasks listed below. This often involves analyzing multiple documents and often complex data to determine collectability of receivables.


This is a fully remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.


Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Monitor assigned accounts: review aging, look for irregularities, non-payments, and delayed payments in customer accounts
  • Contact Sponsors/CROs via phone to follow on unpaid/open invoices and ensure timely payments are received
  • Investigate and resolve sponsor, patient and customer disputes
  • ​Maintaining a strong business relationship with the Sponsors/CROs as the primary contact and voice for Sarah Cannon Research Institute in regards to payment of receivables
  • Reconcile financial study data with data provided by Sponsors/CROs as needed.
  • Review, interpret and discuss contracts internally and with clients to assist with resolving payment or dispute issues
  • Review medical procedure invoices in relation to the contracts to determine eligibility for reimbursement of costs
  • Identify, report on and work with supervisor to resolve trends that negatively impact payment or workflows
  • Work with other departments (i.e. Accounting, Treasury, Contracting) to resolve billing questions as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications for success include:

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred, experience may be substituted for education
  • 3+ years work experience reading and comprehending complex documents and identify financial impacts
  • Clinical Research experience highly preferred
  • Understanding of clinical financial systems and EMRs

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

raw.description:
About us

Joining Busuu means being part of one of the top EdTech companies in the world, a multiple award-winner recognised for its innovation and impact in language learning.

Busuu’s vision is to empower people through languages. We are the world’s largest online community for language learning, with 120+ million registered users. We make learning a language easy by combining AI-powered courses with feedback from our global community of native speakers and lesson content designed for real life.

Busuu is part of the global Chegg family. Chegg is the leading student-first connected learning platform and a NYSE listed company.

What does a Freelance Online Japanese Teacher do at Busuu?

As a Freelance Online Teacher at Busuu, you’ll play a key role in helping students learn language effectively and confidently. On a day-to-day basis, your responsibilities will likely include:

  • Planning, preparing, and teaching online lessons (45 minutes each) for corporate clients.

  • 1:1 Lessons: Deliver private lessons that include both language teaching and personalised coaching- conducting needs analyses, assessing levels, creating bespoke learning paths, checking progress during lesson time, and setting clear goals.

What we’re looking for in a Freelance Online Japanese Teacher:

  • C2 Level of Japanese

  • Valid teaching certificate such as TEFL/CELTA or related university degrees

  • Experience in online teaching and providing 1:1 coaching or personalised learning support

  • Fluency in additional languages:

    • B2 or above in an additional language

    • Bonus: Speaking more than two languages

  • Comfortable teaching: presentation skills, negotiations, business email etiquette, meeting management, multicultural communication, etc.

  • Excellent communication skills to engage and teach students

  • High-Speed Internet, Modern Laptop / PC with a microphone and camera

  • Must comply with local freelance/contractor regulations

What are the terms of this freelance role?

  • $14 paid per lesson taught

  • Remote position

  • Freedom to set your own schedule

  • Access to Busuu Premium, to continue your own language learning

  • Opportunity to interact with and teach students from around the world

  • Valuable teaching experience with one of the industry’s leading companies

What happens next?

We aim to have a simple and speedy hiring process and want to make sure that we are right for you as much as the other way around. The hiring process for the freelance online role are the following 3 steps:

  1. CV application review - We will review it as quickly as possible and update on the next steps

  2. Let’s chat - Quick interview with the teacher operations manager about your experience and the role

  3. Short onboarding course

Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. We pride ourselves on embracing our differences, whether they're cultural, racial, religious, or otherwise. This means each one of us comes to work knowing that we have a voice – and a safe, judgment-free zone to speak freely.

If you like the sound of that, join us. We'd love to hear what you have to say.

Reports to: Director of Partnerships

Department: Growth Marketing

Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.

Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.

Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $49,000 - $58,000

Tier 2 (National Markets): $45,000 - $53,000

Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $40,000 - $47,000

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

The Partnerships Coordinator provides essential administrative and operational support to our growing Partnerships team across Paleovalley and Wild Pastures. This role helps keep the behind-the-scenes processes of our partnerships program organized and running smoothly, allowing our partnerships team to focus on building relationships, growing our programs, and driving revenue.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently coordinate day-to-day administrative and operational needs of the Partnerships team across affiliate, paid, and business development initiatives, following established processes and escalating complex or non-routine issues as needed.
  • Coordinate affiliate commission payouts and partnership invoices, identifying and resolving routine discrepancies and ensuring payments are accurate, organized, and completed on time.
  • Coordinate partner gifting, including product gift boxes, holiday gifts, cards, and other gifting initiatives.
  • Create co-branded page requests and set up completed co-branded pages, links, codes, and other partner resources.
  • Gather, organize, and distribute partnership assets, links, promotional materials, and other resources needed by the team.
  • Independently coordinate and follow through on internal requests for partnership initiatives, including copywriting, design, creative assets, promotional materials, and other cross-functional needs, following up on routine roadblocks through completion and escalating more complex issues as needed.
  • Maintain organized and accurate partnership records, trackers, documents, Google Drive folders, and boards, proactively identifying missing or inaccurate information and taking appropriate action to resolve routine issues.
  • Support paid partnership asset and timeline management by tracking deliverables and gathering and organizing materials needed by the Partnerships team.
  • Assist with larger affiliate communications and initiatives by preparing partner-specific links, codes, assets, and other information for outreach.
  • Coordinate recurring administrative projects and other operational needs across the Partnerships team, managing routine work through completion and escalating issues outside established processes or scope.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 1–3+ years of experience in administrative, operational, marketing, partnerships, or similar support work preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to learn and independently follow established processes and workflows, exercise sound judgment within defined guidelines, and recognize when issues require escalation.
  • Comfort working with spreadsheets, shared documents, and other digital tools.
  • A proactive, dependable approach to completing tasks, following through on requests, and collaborating with others in a remote environment.

Bonus Points

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business Operations or related field
  • Hands on experience supporting marketing operations, affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, paid or creator partnerships.
  • Experience with, Everflow, Google Drive, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working remotely in a fast-paced or growing consumer brand environment.
  • An interest in health, wellness, nutrition, regenerative agriculture, or mission-driven consumer brands.

Our Commitment to You

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
  • Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
  • Paid sick time for when you need it
  • Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays
  • Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees
  • 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team
  • 401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service
  • $300 Paleovalley Monthly product stipend for for employees

Compliance & Employment Practices

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to .

All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility to work in the U.S.

To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology-assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team.

This role is open until filled.

raw.description:
The Opportunity:

The Sr. Manager, Environment and Sustainability reports to the Vice President of EHS3 and is responsible for leading the organization's environmental stewardship and sustainability strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, stakeholder expectations, and industry best practices. This role provides strategic direction and oversight for environmental compliance, sustainability initiatives, climate-related programs, resource conservation efforts, environmental risk management, and ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) reporting.

The Sr. Manager serves as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to executive leadership, partnering across business functions to develop and implement programs that enhance environmental performance, reduce operational impacts, support long-term sustainability goals, and promote a culture of environmental responsibility. The position requires a strong balance of strategic leadership, technical expertise, stakeholder engagement, and program execution.

How you will thrive and create an impact


Develop and Lead Sustainability Strategy

  • Establish and execute enterprise-wide environmental and sustainability strategies, objectives, and performance metrics that align with organizational goals.
  • Identify emerging trends, risks, and opportunities related to sustainability, climate change, resource management, and environmental stewardship.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that support long-term environmental performance and business success.

Provide Leadership and Governance

  • Serve as the organization's environmental and sustainability leader, providing strategic guidance to executive leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Develop policies, standards, and governance processes to ensure consistent implementation of sustainability initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability and environmental responsibility throughout the organization.

Oversee Environmental Compliance and Risk Management

  • Monitor and ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, local, and international environmental regulations and standards.
  • Assess environmental risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize legal, operational, reputational, and financial impacts.
  • Coordinate environmental audits, inspections, corrective action plans, and compliance reporting activities.

Lead ESG and Sustainability Reporting

  • Direct the collection, analysis, and reporting of environmental and sustainability data.
  • Oversee ESG disclosures and reporting processes in accordance with applicable frameworks and stakeholder expectations.
  • Ensure transparency, accuracy, and consistency in sustainability performance reporting.

Manage Climate and Environmental Programs

  • Lead initiatives focused on greenhouse gas reduction, energy management, waste minimization, water stewardship, pollution prevention, and circular economy principles.
  • Establish targets, monitor performance, and implement action plans to achieve environmental objectives.
  • Evaluate opportunities for innovation and operational improvements that support sustainability goals.

Collaborate with Internal and External Stakeholders

  • Build strong partnerships with operations, facilities, procurement, legal, finance, human resources, and other departments to advance sustainability priorities.
  • Represent the organization with regulatory agencies, industry associations, customers, consultants, community groups, and other external stakeholders.
  • Promote stakeholder engagement and awareness regarding environmental and sustainability initiatives.

Manage Budgets, Resources, and Vendor Relationships

  • Manage departmental budgets and sustainability program expenditures.
  • Evaluate and oversee consultants, contractors, and third-party service providers.
  • Ensure effective allocation of resources to meet strategic objectives.

Lead Team Development

  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and evaluate environmental and sustainability personnel as applicable.
  • Promote professional growth, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Establish performance expectations and accountability measures.

Monitor Industry Trends and Best Practices

  • Stay informed of emerging environmental regulations, sustainability frameworks, technologies, and industry developments.
  • Benchmark organizational performance against industry standards and recommend enhancements as needed.
  • Drive adoption of innovative practices that improve environmental and business outcomes.

Perform Other Duties as Assigned

  • Support strategic business initiatives and organizational priorities related to environmental sustainability and corporate responsibility.

What we're looking for


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, Natural Resources, Environmental Management, Industrial Engineering, Public Policy, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Engineering, Business Administration (MBA), Public Administration, or related discipline preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in environmental management, sustainability, ESG, environmental compliance, or related areas.
  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing environmental or sustainability programs, teams, or enterprise initiatives.
  • Experience developing and implementing sustainability strategies within complex, multi-site organizations preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Experience managing environmental compliance programs and regulatory interactions preferred.
  • Experience developing ESG reports and sustainability disclosures preferred.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Environmental Professional (CEP)
  • Certified Energy Manager (CEM)
  • Sustainability Excellence Associate (SEA)
  • LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP)
  • ISSP Certified Sustainability Professional (ISSP-CSP)
  • Professional Engineer (PE) or other related environmental designations, where applicable

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those necessary to perform the job competently)

  • Comprehensive knowledge of environmental regulations, compliance requirements, and sustainability principles.
  • Strong understanding of ESG reporting frameworks, sustainability metrics, and performance measurement systems.
  • Knowledge of climate risk assessment, greenhouse gas accounting, energy management, waste reduction, and resource conservation programs.
  • Ability to develop and execute strategic plans that align sustainability objectives with business priorities.
  • Exceptional leadership, coaching, and team development skills.
  • Strong project and program management capabilities with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Advanced data analysis and reporting skills with the ability to interpret complex information and communicate findings effectively.
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate with executives, employees, regulators, customers, and external stakeholders.
  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost-benefit analysis.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration across geographically dispersed teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and sustainability, environmental, and reporting software applications.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment.

Senior Accountant, US Revenue & Operations Accounting

6-Month Contract | Fully Remote, U.S. Based

About SuperOrdinary

SuperOrdinary is the leading global growth partner and marketplace expert connecting brands, creators, and consumers everywhere. We are the go-to partner for facilitating sustainable global expansion for some of today’s most exciting consumer brands, including Farmacy, Tower 28, OLAPLEX, The Ordinary, Boy Smells, and more.

Our global team of e-commerce, marketplace, and social commerce experts helps brands establish influence, scale sales channels, and connect with creators and consumers around the world.

In 2022, SuperOrdinary acquired FanFix, expanding our capabilities across the creator economy and building a multi-brand platform designed to streamline relationships between creators and brands globally. Today, we continue to build the foundation for a powerful global brand accelerator spanning international expansion, omnichannel distribution, social commerce, and content monetization.

With deep expertise in the rapidly evolving social commerce landscape, SuperOrdinary has a proven track record of growing brands across TikTok Shop and other marketplaces. By combining creativity, commerce, and technology, we are helping shape the future of how brands reach and engage consumers.

The Opportunity

SuperOrdinary is seeking an experienced Senior Accountant, US Revenue & Operations Accounting to join our U.S. Accounting & Finance team on an initial six-month contract-to-hire basis.

This role is designed for someone who can quickly integrate into the team, take ownership of key revenue and operational accounting responsibilities, and make an immediate impact in a fast-moving environment.

The initial commitment will be six months, with the potential to convert to a regular full-time position based on business needs, performance, and mutual fit. While conversion is not guaranteed, we are approaching this opportunity with the intention of identifying someone who can become a long-term contributor to the team.

This position will work closely with Accounting, Finance, Operations, and other cross-functional partners and will report to the Director, Revenue & Operations Accounting.

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in the United States.

What You’ll Do

As a key member of the U.S. Revenue and Inventory Accounting team, you will:

  • Play an integral role in monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring transactional data is captured completely, accurately, on time, and in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

  • Manage, record, and reconcile monthly revenue transactions in NetSuite for multiple entities utilizing journal entries and invoices.

  • Apply knowledge of ASC 606 and SOX 404 to revenue recognition processes and invoicing documentation requirements.

  • Ensure cost of goods sold and capitalized inbound freight are accurately recorded in NetSuite.

  • Partner with operational teams to maintain, analyze, and reconcile inventory held at company warehouses and third-party logistics providers.

  • Record and reconcile Accounts Receivable and inventory-related Accounts Payable transactions, including invoicing, payments, and assigned balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Record, expense, reconcile, and maintain monthly and quarterly accruals.

  • Assist with the management and reconciliation of AR and inventory sub-ledgers within NetSuite.

  • Manage AR aging and related follow-up processes.

  • Support the preparation of monthly financial reporting packages for the global Finance team.

  • Assist with the ongoing development, optimization, and maintenance of the NetSuite ERP environment.

  • Support year-end audit requests and documentation for assigned areas.

  • Support process improvements related to expense reimbursements and corporate credit card activity across multiple entities utilizing Expensify and in accordance with company T&E policies.

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, controls, reporting, and operational efficiency.

  • Serve as a positive, resourceful, and collaborative partner across the organization.

  • Support additional accounting, finance, and operational projects as business needs evolve.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting required.

  • 3+ years of professional accounting experience.

  • 1+ years of Revenue Accounting experience required.

  • Experience with ASC 606 revenue recognition.

  • Cost Accounting experience strongly preferred.

  • CPA or CMA preferred.

  • Previous Oracle/NetSuite ERP experience preferred.

  • Previous Expensify experience is a plus.

  • Experience within retail, e-commerce, consumer products, or manufacturing environments is highly desirable.

  • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, and related functions.

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial reporting.

  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.

  • Resourceful, analytical, and comfortable working through ambiguity.

  • Proven ability to identify and implement process improvements.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities as business needs evolve.

  • Collaborative mindset and a desire to be a trusted business partner across departments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Engagement: Contract
Initial Commitment: 6 Months
Location: 100% Remote, U.S. Based
Schedule: Full-Time Hours

This position will begin as a six-month contract engagement. During the contract period, the Senior Accountant will operate as an embedded member of the U.S. Accounting & Finance team with meaningful ownership of core accounting responsibilities.

At or near the conclusion of the initial contract period, SuperOrdinary may evaluate the opportunity for conversion to a regular full-time position based on individual performance, organizational needs, available headcount, and mutual interes

Please note: Benefits available during the initial contract period may differ depending on the employment or staffing arrangement and should be discussed during the interview process.
