raw.title: Service Call Technician - Dallas, TX
raw.excerpt: About Us and Why We’re Hiring At Terra Energy, we are passionate about accelerating the transition to clean, renewable energy.
raw.description:
About Us and Why We’re Hiring

At Terra Energy, we are passionate about accelerating the transition to clean, renewable energy. We specialize in delivering high-quality solar energy solutions that help homeowners and businesses reduce their energy costs while making a positive impact on the environment.

Our success is built on a commitment to exceptional customer service, operational excellence, and a team-first culture. As we continue to grow, we are looking for talented professionals who thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving problems, and take pride in creating outstanding customer experiences.

We believe that every interaction matters. From the initial installation to ongoing system support, our goal is to provide customers with the confidence that their investment is backed by a responsive and knowledgeable team dedicated to their success.

The Role

As a Service Calls Coordinator, you will play a vital role in ensuring our customers receive exceptional support throughout the lifecycle of their solar energy systems. You will serve as the primary point of contact for service-related inquiries, helping customers navigate issues, coordinating solutions, and ensuring every case is handled with professionalism, urgency, and attention to detail.

In this role, you will manage incoming service requests, perform initial troubleshooting, create and maintain service tickets, and coordinate with field technicians, monitoring teams, manufacturers, and internal departments to drive timely resolutions. You will be responsible for keeping customers informed throughout the process, managing expectations, and ensuring a positive customer experience even when complex issues arise.

Success in this position requires strong communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate enjoys problem-solving, thrives under pressure, and takes ownership of seeing issues through to completion.

This is an excellent opportunity for professionals with backgrounds in customer service, technical support, help desk, dispatching, logistics coordination, operations, or service management who are looking to grow their careers within the renewable energy industry while making a meaningful impact on customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers reporting service-related concerns, system issues, or warranty requests.
  • Receive and manage inbound calls, emails, and support tickets while providing a professional and customer-focused experience.
  • Gather and document relevant information to accurately assess and track service requests.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting and basic diagnostics using monitoring platforms, system data, and established procedures.
  • Create, update, and maintain detailed service tickets, ensuring all customer interactions and actions are properly documented.
  • Coordinate service appointments between customers and field technicians to ensure timely issue resolution.
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams, installers, manufacturers, and service partners to facilitate case resolution.
  • Monitor open service requests and proactively follow up to ensure cases move efficiently through the resolution process.
  • Keep customers informed by providing regular status updates and managing expectations throughout the service lifecycle.
  • Escalate complex technical or operational issues to the appropriate departments when necessary.
  • Assist with warranty claims, equipment replacements, and service-related documentation.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure all service activities comply with company processes and quality standards.
  • Identify recurring issues and communicate trends that may help improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Support a fast-paced environment by managing multiple cases simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy and responsiveness.
  • Contribute to delivering an exceptional customer experience that reflects Terra Energy's commitment to quality, reliability, and service excellence.

What We’re Looking For

We're looking for a proactive, customer-focused professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys solving problems. The ideal candidate is highly organized, communicates effectively, and takes ownership of issues from initial contact through resolution. If you're someone who enjoys helping customers, coordinating moving pieces, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks, we'd love to meet you.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Service, Technical Support, Help Desk, Service Coordination, Dispatch, Operations, or a related field.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to handle challenging situations professionally and empathetically.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and cases simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with CRM systems, ticketing platforms, or service management software.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Comfortable learning new technologies, systems, and processes.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Customer-first mindset.
  • Strong sense of urgency and accountability.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a growing, fast-paced company.
  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude.
  • Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the solar, renewable energy, electrical, construction, telecommunications, HVAC, or field service industries.
  • Experience coordinating field technicians, service teams, or customer appointments.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar systems.
  • Experience troubleshooting technical or operational issues.
  • Knowledge of solar monitoring platforms such as SolarEdge, Enphase, Tesla, SMA, or similar technologies.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.

How You’ll Work at Terra Energy

At Terra Energy, we believe great customer experiences are built through collaboration, accountability, and a commitment to continuous improvement. As a Service Calls Coordinator, you'll work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment where communication, problem-solving, and customer satisfaction are at the center of everything we do.

You'll collaborate closely with Operations, Scheduling, Monitoring, Project Management, Installation Teams, and external service partners to ensure customer concerns are addressed efficiently and effectively. No two days are exactly the same, and you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact by helping customers navigate issues and ensuring they receive the support they deserve.

Compensation & Details

  • Salary: $60,000 USD annually
  • Location: Tampa, FL
  • Reports to: Operations Manager
  • Department: Operations

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means delivering an outstanding customer experience while efficiently managing service requests from initial contact through resolution. You'll take ownership of cases, communicate proactively, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure issues are resolved accurately and on time.

  • Responding promptly and professionally to customer inquiries.
  • Maintaining accurate and detailed service records.
  • Effectively troubleshooting and coordinating service resolutions.
  • Managing multiple service cases while meeting deadlines and follow-up commitments.
  • Delivering a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Building strong working relationships with customers, technicians, and internal teams.
  • Contributing to a positive, solutions-oriented team environment.

A successful Service Calls Coordinator is organized, customer-focused, proactive, and committed to delivering exceptional service every step of the way.

In Summary

The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with customers, technicians, and internal teams to deliver timely and efficient service solutions.

Recruitment Process

  • Initial Contact (HR) – Quick intro and role overview
  • HR Interview – Experience and overall fit
  • Hiring Manager Interview – Technical and role deep dive
  • Offer Letter – Final offer and next steps

NOTE: This is a full-time position available for remote work within the contiguous United States if living beyond a 30-mile radius of a physical NuScale office. Otherwise, work must be performed in-office 4 days/week. Regardless of work location, occasional travel may be required for business needs.

POSITION SUMMARY:The Nuclear Contract Manager 3 provides procurement and contract throughout the lifecycle of a contract for engineering, design, fabrication, testing, manufacturing, and/or construction contracts in accordance with established policies and procedures. Performs tasks as assigned to include, but not limited to, planning, bidder prequalification, development of bidder lists, development of bid solicitation packages, bid analysis, negotiations, administration, change management, and closeout.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Drafts, evaluates, negotiates, and executes contracts, including, but not limited to, Non-Disclosure Agreements, Subcontracts, Consulting Agreements, Licensing Agreements, Master Services Agreements, Task Orders, and Purchase Orders review of customer proposed terms and conditions.
  2. Serves as the single point of contact on contractual matters. Acts as a contractual “liaison” between company employees and suppliers, ensuring timely review and approval / reconciliation of deviations.
  3. Provides redlined recommendations and often negotiates directly with suppliers’ attorneys or purchasing staff until consensus has been reached.
  4. Maintains contractual records and documentation such as receipt and control of all contract correspondence, supplier contact information, contract changes, status reports and other documents for all contracts.
  5. Provides guidance on contract matters to project managers or other operational staff.
  6. Monitors competitive terms. Monitors satisfaction with our terms and conditions and contracting practices. Recommends changes.
  7. Produces and manages Requests for Proposal (RFP), Requests for Information (RFI), and Requests for Quote (RFQ).
  8. Interfaces with ordering departments to ensure scope and technical requirements are clearly specified. Facilitates discussions with ordering departments and suppliers.
  9. Coordinates terms and conditions review with legal representation and Finance as necessary to ensure legal and other risks are minimized.
  10. Ensures contract closeout, extension, or renewal.
  11. Performs other duties as assigned.

CORE COMPETENCIES:To perform the job successfully, the individual should demonstrate competencies in performing the essential functions of this position by performing satisfactorily in each of these competencies.

  • Business Acumen:A strategic thinker with good business perspective and an understanding of the company’s business. Able to function comfortably in political interactions. Capable of developing strong interpersonal networks within the organization.
  • Problem solving:Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner, gathers and reviews information appropriately. Uses own judgment and acts independently; seeks input from other team members as appropriate for complex or sensitive situations.
  • Oral/written communication:Listens carefully and speaks clearly and professionally in all situations. Edits work for accuracy and clarity, is able to create, read, and interpret complex written information. Ability to develop strong interpersonal networks within the organization.
  • Planning/organizing:Prioritizes and plans work activities, organizes personal and project timelines and deadlines, tracks project timelines and deadlines, and uses time efficiently.
  • Integrity:Is trusted by peers.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Unobravo è la Startup che ha sdoganato per prima in Italia l’e-mental care, offrendo un servizio di psicoterapia online d’eccellenza e imponendosi rapidamente come leader del settore. Il Team Clinico oggi conta 3.500 terapeuti,ha seguito più di 113.000 persone lungo il percorso per il benessere psicologico e ha svolto più di 1,6 milione di sedute di terapia.

Se sei alla ricerca di uno spazio in cui le tue passionie competenze siano valorizzate, credi che ilconfronto clinico sia fonte di ricchezza e vorresti poterti concentrare esclusivamente nell’offrire supporto a ogni paziente, potresti essere l’Unobravo che stiamo cercando.

Siamo alla ricerca di psichiatri online proprio come te, da inserire nel nostro Team Clinico.

Il Team Clinico è il biglietto da visita dell’azienda, il sorriso di Unobravo agli occhi di oltre 113.000 persone. Impegnati in prima fila nella rivoluzione gentile che il nostro progetto rappresenta, i terapeuti Unobravo si fanno custodi di meravigliose storie di rinascita, offrendo a ogni paziente una terapia d’eccellenza, improntata all’affidabilità, autorevolezza ed empatia. Non cerchiamo solo degli ottimi professionisti, ma degli eccellenti esseri umani - insomma, vogliamo Unobravo, ma bravo davvero.

Con Unobravo, potrai lavorare da remoto, ovunque tu ti trovi: basta avere una connessione internet, da computer, tablet o telefono!

Agli psichiatri di Unobravo è richiesto di:

  • Aver completato il percorso di studio e la scuola di specializzazione

  • Avere almeno 3 anni di esperienza comprovata nella clinica con gli adulti

  • Avere almeno 10 ore di disponibilità settimanali

  • Incarnare i nostri valori: affidabilità, empatia e accoglienza

  • Credere nel lavoro di squadra

Processeremo la tua candidatura il prima possibile! Ci teniamo a fornire feedback a ogni candidato, sia con esito positivo che negativo, anche se riceviamo tantissime richieste.

Per questo non preoccuparti se non riceverai subito risposta: puoi stare certo che saremo noi a contattarti!

Humana is a Fortune 50 market leader in integrated healthcare with a clearly defined purpose to help people achieve lifelong well-being. As part of Humana's strategy to transform post-acute care delivery, OneHome leverages benefit management capabilities to improve outcomes, enhance care coordination, and deliver value for members, providers, and payers.

The OneHome Strategy Advancement Advisor will be a key member of a high-performing strategy team responsible for evaluating growth opportunities, shaping long-term business strategy and deliverables, and supporting execution of high-priority initiatives. Working closely with leaders across OneHome, CenterWell, and Humana, this role will develop business cases, strategic recommendations, transformation roadmaps, and executive-level communications that inform leadership and Board decision-making.

The position requires a highly analytical, collaborative, and self-directed individual who can translate complex business challenges into compelling strategic narratives and actionable outcomes.

This role will support the OneHome strategic vision and execution through:

  • Organizational strategic planning - Lead strategic planning efforts that define OneHome's long-term growth agenda, including market expansion, capability development, and operational transformation. Facilitate strategic planning processes and deliverables, establishing roadmaps that translate vision into executable priorities.
  • Framework development – Gain internal and external industry insights through research, expert interviews and analytical evaluations to understand new opportunities and abilities to close gaps in business and operations
  • Opportunity evaluation – Assess complex new opportunities to ensure value and feasibility in driving outcomes, growth and improved member care
  • Concept development – Work with enterprise and operational partners to refine strategic recommendations and goals through the development of high-level product requirements and realistic roadmaps
  • Portfolio management & governance - Support the governance and oversight of OneHome's strategic initiative portfolio by establishing prioritization frameworks, monitoring initiative performance, identifying risks and dependencies, and providing leadership transparency through regular reporting and business reviews
  • Program management - Coordinate multifaceted teams to develop strategic recommendations, execute against deadlines and effectively monitor and communicate progress
  • Executive storytelling & strategic communications – Own the development of strategic deliverables, executive dashboards, leadership briefings, Board materials, and enterprise communications that support informed decision-making and organizational alignment.

raw.description:
About exacare ai
exacare ai is a leading health tech company on a mission to build the AI operating system for post-acute care. Our platform turns messy, unstructured referral packets into clear clinical insights and next steps, so teams can make faster, safer placement decisions with less administrative burden. Today, exacare ai powers more than 2,500 facilities, and is growing rapidly.

We recently raised a $30M Series A led by Insight Partners, and are bringing world-class talent together to transform healthcare. If you like building, learning, and want to make a real impact, come join us!

About the Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer who is eager to grow, take ownership, and build products that solve meaningful customer problems. In this role, you will contribute to user-facing features throughout the development lifecycle—from understanding customer workflows and exploring solutions to implementing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-ready software.

Success in this role requires curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an interest in how technical decisions affect the customer experience. You will work with software architecture, data models, APIs, integrations, and AI capabilities, developing your ability to connect these pieces to real-world workflows. With support from experienced engineers, you will learn to balance thoughtful technical design with practical product delivery, building reliable, maintainable solutions that deliver customer value.

As a Software Engineer, you will help shape exacare’s platform by delivering features, improving existing systems, and taking increasing ownership as you grow. Working closely with engineering, product, design, and customer-facing teams, you’ll contribute ideas, participate in code reviews and technical discussions, and build your skills through hands-on experience, collaboration, and mentorship.

What You’ll Do

  • Build features throughout the development lifecycle: Take ownership of well-defined features and improvements—from understanding requirements through implementation, testing, rollout, and support—with guidance from experienced engineers.
  • Develop systems-to-workflow thinking: Learn how software architecture, data models, APIs, and integrations connect to real healthcare workflows, and use that understanding to inform your work.
  • Build and ship user-facing product: Develop full-stack features using TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and modern cloud tooling on AWS, helping customers navigate complex healthcare workflows.
  • Build quality into your work: Write tests, participate in code reviews, and follow observability and deployment practices that help the team deliver reliable software.
  • Improve and reuse existing solutions: Use shared components and established patterns, contribute improvements to existing systems, and identify opportunities to simplify code and workflows.
  • Collaborate and grow: Work with engineering, product, operations, platform, and ML teammates to solve customer problems, ask thoughtful questions, and build your skills through feedback and hands-on experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or similar technical field
  • 2+ years of engineering experience with a focus on building highly scalable distributed systems
  • Self-starter – you are comfortable rapidly learning new technologies and turning a high-level task into a game plan
  • Demonstrated ability to triage and prioritize production incidents efficiently
  • Ownership mentality and resourcefulness
  • Organized, high attention to detail, with emphasis on quality code, automation, validation and testing
  • Experience with AWS, LLMs, TypeScript, PostgreSQL
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into accessible language for cross-functional teams and stakeholders
  • Experience with building automated workflows

Nice to Have

  • Experience building applied AI features or working with LLM infrastructure.
  • Experience with healthcare workflows, care-setting variability, or regulated environments.
  • Experience with EHR integrations or health data standards.
  • Experience with operational tooling or onboarding/support-heavy product surfaces.
  • Experience building reusable patterns or frameworks that help teams move faster.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive salary and equity in a high-growth startup
  • Flexible PTO, take what you need
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Great startup culture, including ChatGPT premium and company off-sites
  • High-achieving team, including ex-Amazon engineers and alumni of Bain, BCG, and Goldman Sachs


An insight into our Core Values
Only the best belong here
We are unapologetic about talent. This should be the best team you have ever been on. Protecting that standard is how we honor each other’s time, ambition, and craft.

We work even harder to keep our partners than we did to earn them initially
The work does not stop when a customer first onboards to our platform. It deepens over time. We partner with operators, listening and learning about real problems, and translate that into solutions that help them succeed in practice. We earn trust through consistent delivery.

We keep the patient downstream of every decision
At the end of the day, this is about the patient. We get there by deeply respecting and reflecting on our purpose: to develop software that aids teams in delivering better care.

Raise the bar on ownership
We grow because people here go beyond the minimum. We invest extra effort, care, and ownership into what we build.

The world is moving fast. We move faster.
This is a race. We work hard, we move early, and we stay ahead of problems and competitors. If we slow down, someone else will pass us.

Radical candor, zero politics
We say what’s true, early, and we keep communication direct and clean so the team can move.

Bring good vibes and win together
We win as a team. We bring energy, support each other, and make the workplace somewhere people are excited to show up.


If this sounds like you, we'd love to have a chat!

raw.description:
Job Description

ABOUT US:

Since 1919, Victaulic has led the industry and continues to grow our outside sales team. At Victaulic, we don't sit back and enjoy success. We move forward and strive to grow.
Victaulic, the global leader in mechanical pipe joining innovations, has the most tenured, largest and best-trained sales team in the industry. We continue to add high-powered sales representatives to our organization, and help them build a successful career with an industry leader.

Victaulic sales representatives are out on the road every day, meeting with valued customers, visiting job sites and building relationships with key stakeholders to ensure continued success. Our sales team consists of team players who are self-starters with strong problem solving skills, mechanical aptitude and a drive to succeed and communicate effectively with a diverse customer base.

Our rewards package consists of a competitive base salary, incentive compensation plan, company automobile and comprehensive benefit and retirement plans.
In this outside sales role, you will:

BECOME THE EXPERT

Learn the Products
First, you'll need to learn all about Victaulic's products and the many ways that we can provide solutions for our customers and help them get their projects done on time and within budget. You'll be happy to know, we have an excellent training program! There's a lot to learn!
Know the Industry
In sales training, we'll teach you not only about grooved mechanical pipe joining methods, but also about the competitive methods of joining pipe, such as welding and flanging. With this knowledge, you can feel confident that you'll be able to overcome any objections you may face in the field from customers who are used to the more traditional ways of joining pipe.

As a territory manager, you'll also need to understand construction cycles, find and follow major construction, expansion or retrofit projects, and keep current with market trends and competitor activity. You'll be expected to integrate into local trade organizations and professional associations while striving to become part of the fabric of the industry within your territory.

Understand the Business


You'll work with your Regional Sales Manager to develop a business plan, including opportunity mapping, sales goals, product promotion plans, and strategies to maximize your sales potential. You'll be responsible for executing all phases of project pursuit and project management to secure a purchase order ' from project inception through design, specifications, drawings, bidding phase, job site training and support, final commissioning and after-sale follow up. You'll need to gain complete information for all quotation requisitions including application, specification, pricing and timing requirements, and lead the inside sales team, engineering and other support staff to ensure good teamwork to meet customer requirements.

BUILD STRONG RELATIONSHIPS


As a territory manager, developing relationships and building trust will be key to your success in this role, so it's essential that you work to build lasting relationships with the mechanical contractors, engineers, and building/project owners in your territory. Maintaining meaningful relationships requires spending time with your customers, and that's a big part of your job. Sometimes, time spent with clients extends beyond 'normal business hours' and you'll be expected to take customers out in the evenings or weekends for dinners, sporting events, and other social events.

In addition to maintaining relationships with your customers, you'll also need to partner with the Victaulic distributors in your territory and manage a balanced distribution network. You'll need to exercise teamwork to coordinate activities with other Victaulic representatives and regional market specialists who could influence or have any dealings with the project or account to ensure the best customer experience.

EDUCATE AND INFLUENCE


During your work day as a sales specialist, you'll seek to learn about your customers' needs and educate them about the overall value utilizing Victaulic can bring to their project. At Victaulic, we know our products are the best, and we want our customers to know it, too! Our sales reps work hard to educate our customers. For example, you may find yourself on a job site early in the morning dressed in jeans, boots, and a hard hat, while meeting with some contractors performing a tool demo or conducting a training on proper installation techniques. While, later that day, you may be doing a lunch and learn presentation for a group of engineers to educate them on our cutting edge products.

Your ultimate goal is to educate customers on why they can feel confident about our products, show the overall value Victaulic products bring to their project, and influence the decision-makers, so you can maximize your sales potential.

QUALITIES WE SEEK IN YOU AS A TERRITORY MANAGER:


We are advocates of lifelong learning at Victaulic, and even offer assistance with tuition reimbursement, but prefer you have a Bachelor's degree walking in the door! Previous sales experience selling 'value added' products/services; preferably related to the commercial construction industry, PVF industry (pipes, valves, fittings) or mechanical products will always make your transition a smooth one, but with our training program those from all backgrounds have experienced great success. Having demonstrated achievements in sales, and showing you have a history of developing and nurturing long standing relationships is also beneficial. Possessing a competitive nature, and showing both flexibility and resiliency will assist you in growing business in your territory year over year.

Because our territory managers work remote with minimal supervision, you should be self-motivated and self-driven to achieve success. When meeting with customers, you should exude confidence, a professional image, and present an engaging, affable personality. Having strong problem solving skills, the ability to be resourceful, and the ability to exercise creative thinking will help you in your daily interactions. Having strong organization and time management skills, as well as solid project management skills will help elevate your game to the next level!

Some territories require heavier overnight travel than others, so your willingness to travel is required. While you are in the field, you may run into adverse weather conditions such as snow, heat, mud, rain ' we get dirty around here, and some of our equipment can weigh up to 50+ pounds!

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status.

About The Role

Grace Hill is building a new Account Management function, and we're looking for an Enterprise Director to lead the change. This is a builder's role: there is a thin existing playbook, team structure, or operating cadence to inherit; you'll partner with the VP of Sales to refine it. You'll own retention and drive expansion across our customer base, with a particular focus on our largest Enterprise accounts, and you'll be the executive-level relationship owner who ensures our most strategic customers see continued value from the Grace Hill suite.

This is a highly operational, front line hands-on leadership role. You'll spend time in the business in the data, in customer conversations, in the details of deal structure. You will have an opportunity to influence how Account Management functions at Grace HIll.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with VP Sales to Build the Account Management function: define the team's charter, structure, playbooks, and operating cadence, and stand up the metrics and processes needed to run it well.
  • Own retention and renewal for our customer base, with an emphasis on our largest Enterprise accounts, and drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell in partnership with Sales.
  • Lead a strong push toward multiyear contracts, building the pricing, packaging, and negotiation approach that makes multiyear the default conversation, not the exception.
  • Act as a senior, credible executive presence with customers. Be the presence that C-level and VP-level stakeholders trust in a room, especially at our top accounts.
  • Bring an AI-forward point of view to the role: know how AI is changing the multifamily and SaaS, and use AI to make your team more effective (forecasting, account planning, customer insights, workflow efficiency).
  • Recruit, hire, and develop an Account Management team as it scales, setting a high bar for both relationship management and operational rigor.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, RevOps, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success/Support to ensure a seamless customer experience from close through renewal and expansion.
  • Bring structure and discipline to forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and account health reporting for the renewal and expansion book of business.
  • Lead through change: as a new function inside an evolving go-to-market motion, you'll need to bring the team and cross-functional partners along as processes are defined and refined in real time.
  • Galvanizing leader - this is a new function for Grace Hill and it will be critical for the leader to build culture, belief, and enthusiasm for the segment in the team and cross-functionally.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in an Account Management leadership role.
  • Proven front-line sales or account management leadership experience, with a track record of building or significantly scaling a team or function.
  • Bonus: second-line leadership experience (managing managers).
  • Demonstrated builder mentality: genuine enthusiasm for creating something new rather than optimizing an existing machine, with the change management skills to bring others along.
  • Experience owning retention, renewal, and expansion motions for Enterprise-level customers, ideally with multiyear contract structures.
  • Highly operational: comfortable in the details of forecasting, account planning, and deal mechanics, not just setting strategy from a distance.
  • High executive presence, with experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders at customer organizations.
  • An AI-forward point of view: genuine curiosity and fluency in how AI is reshaping account management, customer engagement, and the broader proptech landscape.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS.
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator, with experience working closely with Sales, RevOps, and Solutions Engineering.

Preferred

  • Multifamily or Proptech industry experience.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $230K--$275K OTE
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Remote work option
  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture

Grace Hill helps companies managing multifamily residential properties develop and retain top talent to reduce the operating risk and elevate property performance - with an integrated talent performance management platform encompassing policies, training, and assessment. Our advanced technology-enabled solutions are bolstered by years of multifamily experience, in-depth service level expertise, and outstanding customer support. Today, over 1,600 companies covering a workforce of over 500,000 people rely on talent performance solutions from Grace Hill.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

This part-time, remote internship offers students and recent graduates hands-on experience conducting quantitative healthcare research focused on pharmacy outcomes and policy. Interns will contribute to real-world evidence studies across areas such as comparative effectiveness, medication access and affordability, healthcare utilization and costs, benefit design, and pharmacy policy, while gaining experience communicating findings to Humana stakeholders.

Humana Healthcare Research: The mission of Humana Healthcare Research (HHR) is to produce high-quality, actionable evidence through the design and execution of research studies, as well as strategic interpretation of findings. HHR aims to produce research that informs how to improve health outcomes, guides Humana’s strategy, and advances the body of knowledge for both the scientific community and society at large.

Areas of focus include pharmacy comparative effectiveness research; health policy, payment and care delivery; and access to care. HHR maintains external partnerships with industry, government, and academia to produce research that is relevant to ongoing problems. We’re a team of research professionals passionate about combining and analyzing diverse types of primary and secondary data.

The Fall Internship is a 16–20-week immersive, professional research learning experience for students or recent graduates interested in pursuing a career in quantitative healthcare research. This intern position is tailored to support pharmacy-oriented health outcomes and pharmacy policy research. The intern will gain experience with real-world evidence generation through the design and conduct of research studies including comparative effectiveness, disease characterization, treatment patterns analysis, cost and healthcare utilization analysis, medication access and affordability, pharmacy benefit design, utilization management, and pharmacy policy evaluation. The intern will participate in synthesizing, communicating, and presenting research findings to Humana stakeholders.


This is a part-time, remote position starting in November through Feb/March. Interns will have the opportunity to apply and strengthen their research skills in a supportive environment among a multi-disciplinary team of research experts. Those seeking a career in pharmacoepidemiology, health economics, outcomes research, pharmacy and health policy are strongly encouraged to apply.



Use your skills to make an impact

Position Responsibilities

The HHR Intern will participate in study team(s) and support research activities. Responsibilities will include some or all of the following:

  • Contributing to study conceptualization, literature reviews, proposal writing.
  • Study protocol development.
  • Executing statistical analysis per specifications in study protocol and under supervision of experienced research scientists.
  • Reporting and interpretation of results.
  • Contributing to manuscript development.

Position Qualifications

Required:

  • Currently pursuing (final-year student) or recently completed PhD in pharmacy, outcomes research, epidemiology, pharmacoepidemiology, health economics, public health or health services research.
  • Knowledge in quantitative health outcomes research, analytics, and statistical techniques.
  • Knowledge of causal inference methods or completion of relevant course work on quasi-experimental methods (e.g., propensity score analysis, inverse probability treatment weighting, interrupted time series analysis, regression discontinuity designs, instrumental variable analysis, and/or causal mediation analysis).
  • Ability to commit to at least part-time employment for 16 to 20 weeks beginning in November 2026.
  • Experience working collaboratively on research teams.
  • Proficiency in at least one statistical coding language.
  • Interest in a career in healthcare research.

Preferred:

  • Enthusiastic to continue to learn and develop research methods skills.
  • Experience using R and/or SAS for data management and statistical analyses.
  • Experience in utilizing real-world data sources, such as claims databases and electronic health records, for observational studies and RWE generation.
  • Experience in scientific writing and/or manuscript authorship.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

1

The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$37,440 - $96,800 per year

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers benefits for limited term, variable schedule and per diem associates which are designed to support whole-person well-being. Among these benefits, Humana provides paid time off, 401(k) retirement savings plan, employee assistance program, business travel and accident.Application Deadline: 10-15-2026

На тебе чекають такі задачі:

  • Технічна підтримка партнерів і колег — аукціон (API), трекінг конверсій, Apply on Jooble, Job benefit/Salary tags

  • Tracking — налаштування, тестування, оптимізація та усунення несправностей у трекінгу кліків та конверсій

  • Statistics API — вирішення проблем з передачею клієнту даних по рекламних кампаніях через API

  • Discrepancy Analytics — аналітика розбіжностей у кліках та конверсіях

  • Крос-функціональна співпраця — щоденна робота з Customer Success, Business Development, Product Engineering, Aggregation Quality Engineering та Analytics; час від часу — спільні дзвінки й переписка з B2B-клієнтами разом із CS або BD

  • Практичний досвід написання SQL-запитів

  • Досвід роботи з REST API (Swagger, Postman) на рівні L3-саппорту

  • Досвід роботи з репозиторіями на GitHub

  • Досвід роботи в тікетній системі (Freshdesk або аналог)

  • Англійська — B1 письмово та усно

  • Досвід використання AI-інструментів (Claude Code, Gemini тощо) для автоматизації рутинних задач

  • Досвід ведення технічної документації (Confluence або аналог) за результатами вирішених кейсів

  • Дисциплінованість у дотриманні дедлайнів і відповідальність за SLA

  • Проактивність

  • Здатність системно аналізувати складні технічні проблеми й розуміти до першопричини

  • Відмінні письмові та усні комунікативні навички: вміння пояснити технічну складність простою мовою для бізнес-користувачів і ефективно взаємодіяти з клієнтами та іншими продуктовими командами

Буде перевагою

  • Досвід роботи з англомовними клієнтами

  • Досвід роботи з системами збору конверсій (Google Tag Manager, Postback, HTML/JS pixel)

  • Навички роботи з інструментами моніторингу й логами (Elastic, Kibana, Grafana)

Job Description:

The Triage Specialist supports a federal agency by receiving, reviewing, and directing incident reports to the appropriate point of contact. The Triage Specialist works as part of a small team of federal and contract staff to ensure inbox coverage 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays.

The schedule for this position will be Thursday - Monday or Saturday - Wednesday.


Position Duties:


  • Monitor a shared incident response inbox in collaboration with other team members to ensure timely response and incident elevation.
  • Analyze each incoming incident in accordance with federal policies to ensure incidents are documented correctly and routed to the appropriate point of contact.
  • Provide technical assistance in situations where incident reports need to be corrected and/or resubmitted in accordance with policy.
  • Create shift reports and complete other activities necessary to prepare team members to take over inbox coverage.
  • Catalog and file incidents in keeping with policies and standard operating procedures.
  • Maintain a tracking system for reported incidents and perform quality assurance to ensure data accuracy.
  • Perform data analysis to identify trends in incident reporting.
  • Provide reports on inbox activity on regular and as-needed bases.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a relevant field with at least 4 years of related experience.
  • Experience in case management, child welfare, or social work required.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and to collaborate with team members in a remote environment.
  • Experience utilizing Microsoft Excel and performing basic data analysis preferred.

Additional Requirements:


  • Must be able and willing to work weekends and some holidays.
  • This position requires an existing Public Trust or the ability to obtain one.
  • This position is 100% remote.

raw.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About the Role

Forbes Advisor is looking for a SEM Strategist to join the Forbes Advisor Performance Marketing team, supporting Forbes Advisor's Financial Services business.

This role is responsible for driving the strategic direction and long-term growth of key paid search categories. The ideal candidate combines deep SEM expertise with strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence stakeholders across the organization. They will identify new opportunities, develop scalable growth strategies, champion innovation, and serve as a key driver of business outcomes across their owned verticals.

If you're looking for challenges and opportunities similar to those of a start-up, with the benefits of an established, successful company, read on.

The Paid Search Strategist will own category growth, shape roadmap priorities, influence cross-functional initiatives, and work closely with publishers, Product, Business Development, Data, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, and leadership teams to unlock new opportunities and drive meaningful business results.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Growth

  • Own the strategic direction, growth plans, and commercial success of key categories.
  • Develop and execute short-term and long-term growth strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Build clear category roadmaps that balance immediate performance opportunities with long-term capability development.
  • Identify, prioritize, and champion high-impact initiatives that drive sustained growth and competitive advantage.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for owned categories, proactively identifying market trends, opportunities, and risks.
  • Influence performance beyond directly owned accounts through thought leadership, best-practice development, and cross-category initiatives.
  • Generate innovative ideas that challenge existing approaches and establish new best practices across the organization.
  • Evaluate emerging industry trends, platform developments, and product innovations to maintain competitive advantage.

Performance Ownership

  • Take full ownership of category performance, including revenue, profitability, volume, efficiency, and growth targets.
  • Drive category growth through data-driven decision making and strategic allocation of resources.
  • Develop forecasting models and growth plans for owned categories, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Analyze performance trends, identify root causes of variance, and communicate strategic recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and account audits to identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.
  • Utilize advanced analytical approaches to identify growth opportunities across campaigns, audiences, funnels, landing experiences, and partner ecosystems.

Innovation & Testing

  • Design and own testing frameworks that support strategic category growth.
  • Identify, prioritize, and scale innovative PPC tactics, automation opportunities, audience expansion strategies, and emerging platform capabilities.
  • Drive experimentation initiatives from conception through implementation and performance evaluation.
  • Build strong hypotheses based on data, market insights, and business needs to unlock new growth opportunities.
  • Scale successful initiatives across additional categories and share learnings broadly within the organization.
  • Partner directly with publishers and platform representatives to leverage beta programs, product innovations, and new capabilities.

Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong relationships with Business Development, Product, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Analytics, and Leadership teams.
  • Influence stakeholders and obtain buy-in for strategic initiatives through compelling data, analysis, and business cases.
  • Partner with Business Development teams to identify new partner opportunities, market expansion opportunities, and monetization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to identify and prioritize enhancements that improve business performance.
  • Present category performance, growth strategies, recommendations, and insights to senior stakeholders and leadership audiences.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor and thought leader within the Performance Marketing team.

Capability Expectations

  • Operates with high levels of autonomy and limited oversight.
  • Owns category strategy and growth as if managing their own business.
  • Develops and drives initiatives that influence performance beyond directly managed accounts.
  • Proactively identifies opportunities and challenges before they impact performance.
  • Leads strategic projects with significant business impact.
  • Creates clear vision, roadmap, and execution plans for owned categories.
  • Builds alignment across multiple stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
  • Balances commercial performance with long-term strategic investments.
  • Drives adoption of new ideas, processes, and best practices across the wider team.
  • Acts as a trusted strategic partner to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Professional Competencies

  • Deep passion for search marketing and digital advertising.
  • Strategic thinker with a forward-looking mindset and strong commercial awareness.
  • Proven ability to identify growth opportunities and convert them into measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to make decisions using incomplete information.
  • Outstanding analytical and critical thinking abilities.
  • Ability to influence and negotiate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving change.
  • Ability to connect market dynamics, business objectives, and performance marketing strategies.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.
  • Growth mindset with a focus on continuous learning and innovation.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in Paid Search / SEM, including extensive experience with Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
  • Proven track record of owning and growing large-scale PPC programs.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing long-term growth strategies that drive measurable business impact.
  • Advanced understanding of Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, automation, smart bidding strategies, and audience targeting.
  • Experience managing significant budgets and delivering revenue and profitability growth.
  • Strong forecasting, planning, and performance analysis experience.
  • Deep knowledge of web analytics platforms, including Google Analytics and internal reporting solutions.
  • Experience using competitive intelligence and market research tools such as SEMrush, Adthena, Similarweb, or equivalent platforms.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive organizational change.
  • Experience presenting business cases, strategic recommendations, and performance insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
  • Bachelor's Degree required.

Comagine Health is a national, mission-driven nonprofit organization dedicated to improving health and creating a better health care system. In this role, you will support the collection, analysis, display, and interpretation of data to help inform team decisions and advance project goals. This is an opportunity to apply and develop your analytical skills in a collaborative, mission-driven environment where data and insights help support meaningful improvements in health care.

Project & Team Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with project teams to ensure analytic products meet the needs of internal and external customers.

  • Partner with multidisciplinary professionals to understand project objectives and analytic needs.

  • Contribute analytical support to projects designed to improve health care in our communities.

Data Governance

  • Work collaboratively with the analytics team and project teams to ensure appropriate data governance principles are followed in all uses of data.

  • Support the appropriate and responsible use of data throughout the analytic process.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and/or related work experience.

  • 2 years of data analysis, research, and/or other relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree.

  • Prior work experience in health care.

raw.description:
Du kennst DATEV aus dem Arbeitsalltag und erklärst gerne Dinge, bis sie wirklich sitzen? Dann suchen wir dich - deutschlandweit, komplett im Homeoffice, in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Wir sind die Digitalagentur1 und begleiten Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei der Digitalisierung. Unsere Kunden sind ausschließlich Steuerberater. Deren Mandanten betreuen wir nicht selbst, aber wir machen die Kanzlei fit darin, ihre Mandanten sicher zu begleiten.

Zu wem passt diese Position?

Du musst kein Steuerfachangestellter sein. Vielleicht kommst du aus einer Steuerkanzlei - oder du hast in einem Unternehmen gearbeitet, das mit DATEV arbeitet. Beides passt. Zu uns passen zum Beispiel Steuerfachangestellte, Finanzbuchhalter, Lohnbuchhalter, Bilanzbuchhalter oder Mitarbeiter aus der Kanzlei-Eigenorganisation.

Unsere Themen

  • DATEV Rechnungswesen

  • DATEV Personalwirtschaft (LODAS und Lohn und Gehalt)

  • Kanzlei-Eigenorganisation

  • DATEV Cloud – zum Beispiel DATEV Unternehmen online, DATEV Personal oder DATEV Meine Steuern

Genau dort tauchen im Kanzleialltag Fragen auf: Wie stellen wir einen Mandanten auf DATEV Unternehmen online um? Warum zieht die Buchung nicht sauber durch? Wie richten wir einen neuen Mandanten in der Personalwirtschaft ein? Du bist die Person, die diese Fragen beantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Support: Du beantwortest DATEV-Rückfragen aus den Kanzleien - per Telefon, Videocall und per Fernwartung direkt am Bildschirm.

  • Schulung: Du zeigst Kanzleiteams in Online-Schulungen, wie sie mit DATEV effizienter arbeiten.

  • Beratung: Du begleitest Kanzleien bei Umstellungen, zum Beispiel auf digitale Belege, DATEV Unternehmen online oder neue Abläufe im Rechnungswesen und in der Personalwirtschaft.

  • Prozesse und Checklisten: Du hilfst uns, unsere internen Abläufe und Checklisten weiterzuentwickeln, damit jeder Vorgang nach demselben klaren Standard läuft.

  • Schulungsakademie: Du baust unsere interne Schulungsakademie mit aus - Unterlagen, Leitfäden und Lerninhalte, von denen das ganze Team profitiert.

Keine Sorge: Wir schulen dich komplett ein.

Du bekommst eine vollständige Einarbeitung in alle Themen, mit denen du zu tun hast. Wir gehen alles gemeinsam durch, üben es mit dir und lassen dich erst dann eigenständig arbeiten, wenn du dich sicher fühlst. Du musst also nicht alles schon können.

So arbeitest du bei uns

  • 100 % Homeoffice, deutschlandweit: Du brauchst nicht umzuziehen und nicht zu pendeln.

  • Alles digital: Termine, Schulungen und Support laufen online, keine Reisetätigkeit.

  • Klare Abläufe: Feste Prozesse statt Improvisation - du weißt jeden Tag, woran du bist.

Wir bieten

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen.

  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig, Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.

  • Volle Einarbeitung: Wir schulen dich in allen Themen ein und üben alles mit dir.

  • Moderne Technik und laufende Weiterbildung, damit du fachlich am Ball bleibst.

Zwei wichtige Hinweise

raw.excerpt: Jooble — це глобальна продуктова IT-компанія, що трансформує сферу працевлаштування.
raw.description:
Jooble — це глобальна продуктова IT-компанія, що трансформує сферу працевлаштування.

Щомісяця мільйони людей у 66 країнах світу використовують Jooble для пошуку роботи та найму талантів. За цим стоїть команда з понад 300 професіоналів, які поєднують глибоку експертизу в аналітиці, технологіях та роботі з даними, щоб зробити цей процес простішим і ефективнішим.

Сьогодні Jooble входить до ТОП-10 найвідвідуваніших сайтів світу у сегменті Jobs and Employment, підтверджуючи свій глобальний вплив.

Про роль

Ми шукаємо Product Analyst, який допомагатиме продуктовим командам приймати рішення на основі даних, знаходити точки росту продукту та оцінювати вплив змін на ключові бізнес- і продуктові метрики.

Ця роль — не лише про побудову дашбордів чи підготовку цифр. Ми очікуємо, що аналітик глибоко розумітиме продукт, поведінку користувачів і бізнес-модель, допомагатиме команді знаходити проблеми, формувати гіпотези та перевіряти їх даними.

Нам потрібна людина, яка не обмежується запитом «дайте ТЗ — я порахую».

Product Analyst має ставити питання, перевіряти припущення, помічати проблеми в даних і продукті та допомагати команді зрозуміти, що відбувається, чому це відбувається і яке рішення варто перевірити наступним.

Аналітик має бути готовим аргументувати свої висновки даними та обговорювати їх із Product Manager, розробниками та іншими командами.

У цій ролі ти будеш:

  • Глибоко розуміти B2B-продукт, user journey роботодавця та ключові бізнес-процеси.

  • Аналізувати продуктові воронки, conversion, retention, churn, cohorts, monetization та поведінку користувачів.

  • Формувати та підтримувати систему продуктових метрик.

  • Допомагати продуктовим командам відокремлювати симптом від реальної проблеми та формулювати правильні аналітичні питання.

  • Оцінювати потенційний ефект продуктових ініціатив

  • Планувати та аналізувати A/B-тести: визначати метрики, sample size, statistical significance та інтерпретувати результати.

  • Оцінювати вплив продуктових змін на користувачів і бізнес.

  • Проводити складні ad-hoc та exploratory дослідження.

  • Будувати та підтримувати дашборди для моніторингу ключових показників.

  • Контролювати якість і консистентність даних та розбиратися в причинах розбіжностей у метриках.

  • Працювати разом із Data Engineering / DWH командою над структурою та доступністю даних.

  • Автоматизувати регулярну аналітику та зменшувати кількість ручних запитів.

  • Перетворювати результати досліджень на зрозумілий data storytelling: що відбулося, чому, наскільки ми впевнені у висновку та яке рішення він підтримує.

  • Проактивно знаходити проблеми та точки росту, які можуть впливати на product roadmap.

Про твій досвід:

  • 2+ роки досвіду на позиції Product Analyst / Data Analyst.

  • Впевнене володіння SQL.

  • Досвід роботи з великими обсягами даних.

  • Розуміння продуктових метрик та принципів побудови системи метрик.

  • Практичний досвід аналізу воронок, retention, cohorts та user behavior.

  • Розуміння статистики та принципів проведення A/B-тестів.

  • Досвід роботи з BI-інструментами: Tableau, Power BI, Looker або аналогами.

  • Здатність працювати з невизначеними задачами та самостійно визначати підхід до аналізу.

  • Вміння комунікувати результати з Product Managers та іншими стейкхолдерами.

  • English — Intermediate / Upper-Intermediate або вище.

Якщо ти готовий/а впливати на життя мільйонів людей у всьому світі — надсилай резюме, і ми зв’яжемося з тобою найближчим часом.

Ready to leverage your fundraising expertise, grow major partnerships and help advance a mission that transforms lives? As the Director of Annual Giving, you are responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing a comprehensive annual giving program to grow unrestricted revenue and build a sustainable pipeline of future major and planned giving donors. Within this role you'll primarily focuses on securing Annual Fund and mid-level gifts, $10,000 or less. You will oversee a year-round fundraising plan implementing multi-channel fundraising strategies, data-driven donor segmentation, and stewardship efforts to increase donor acquisition, retention, and upgrade rates. Join our dedicated team in completing transformative work and apply!

ABOUT SENECA

Seneca has been nominated among theBay Area’s Top Workplaces for several consecutive years. We’re committed to providing traditionally marginalized communities with a network of excellent mental health, community-based, and educational services. We are committed to building a diverse staff. Our programs deeply engage in conversations and training on Diversity, Equity, and Inclusionto bring equity and justice to the youth and families we serve.

Responsibilities:

  • Build a strong base of philanthropic support through managing and cultivating a portfolio of annual and mid-level donors (>$10,000), that also serves as a pipeline for major and legacy gifts
  • Develop and implement a comprehensive, multi-channel annual giving plan and appeal strategy (direct mail, email, digital, social, events) that is targeted, purpose driven, timely and donor lifecycle stage appropriate
  • Lead all annual fund campaigns including End of Year giving, Giving Tuesday, monthly giving appeals, special appeals and rapid response campaigns
  • Build data-driven, segmented campaigns for new, renewing, mid-level, upgrade and lapsed donors
  • Set revenue, acquisition, retention, upgrade, engagement and qualitative goals for the Annual Fund program; analyze and produce reports of program KPIs and metrics

  • Track all campaigns in Raiser’s Edge, adjusting strategies in real time and crafting reports and analytics to replicate and improve successful solicitation campaigns
  • Partner with Major Gifts team to transition qualified donors for individualized relationship management
  • Partner with Donor Relations Coordinator to design and manage donor giving societies, including monthly giving program
  • Partner with the Donor Relations Coordinator to develop and implement stewardship plans and other meaningful communications to improve donor experience and retention of Annual Fund and mid-level donors

Required

Preferred

The Manager, Registered Plans Support role is responsible for providing specialized support and oversight for Registered Disability Savings Plans (RDSPs) and Registered Education Savings Plans (RESPs). This role acts as a key liaison between Sales, Client Services, Fund Administration, Transfer Agency, and external government agencies including ESDC and the CRA. The successful candidate will ensure effective servicing, timely issue resolution, and continuous improvement of RDSP and RESP processes for Advisors, Dealers, and internal BMO partners.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate closely with Sales, Client Services, Fund Administration, Transfer Agency, and external agencies such as ESDC and CRA to support Advisors, Dealers, and BMO Sales teams with the servicing of RDSP and RESP plans.
  • Act as the primary point of escalation for complex RDSP and RESP servicing issues raised by Sales teams or Client Services.
  • Provide hands‑on support to Advisors and Dealers with the processing and administration of RDSP and RESP plans, as required.
  • Serve as the key contact for RDSP and RESP NIGO (Not In Good Order) items, working with Transfer Agency and other stakeholders to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Monitor, track, and analyze NIGOs specific to RDSP and RESP plans to identify root causes and recurring issues.
  • Maintain ongoing oversight of RDSP and RESP activity, identifying trends and systemic issues impacting Advisors and Dealers.
  • Coordinate and support scheduled communications to clients and Advisors, in partnership with the Sales team and/or Contact Centre.
  • Make recommendations to improve servicing models, processes, and support for registered plans, with a particular focus on RDSPs and RESPs.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of policies, procedures, and support materials related to RDSP and RESP plans.
  • Work closely with the Product Support team on RDSP/RESP‑related issues and contribute to the creation and enhancement of registered plan support materials.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of RDSP and RESP products, servicing requirements, and regulatory considerations
  • Proven ability to manage escalations and resolve complex plan issues
  • Strong coordination and relationship‑management skills across multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Detail‑oriented, with the ability to identify trends and systemic issues
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while operating effectively within a cross‑functional team environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting registered investment plans within the Canadian financial services industry
  • Familiarity with Transfer Agency servicing models, dealer operations, and Advisor workflows
  • Understanding of CRA and ESDC reporting and registration requirements for RDSPs and RESPs
  • Typically between 4 - 6 years of relevant experience and post-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Knowledge of business analysis, project delivery practices and standards across the project lifecycle.
  • Technical proficiency gained through education and/or business experience.
  • Verbal & written communication skills - In-depth.
  • Collaboration & team skills - In-depth.
  • Analytical and problem solving skills - In-depth.
  • Influence skills - In-depth.
  • Data driven decision making - In-depth.

$55,500.00 - $120,000.00

Salaried

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit:

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

description: Hello!  🦜Thanks for checking out our job posting.

raw.title: [Flexible & Remote Work] Relocation Coach, United States
raw.excerpt: Hello!  🦜Thanks for checking out our job posting.
raw.description:
Hello! 🦜

Thanks for checking out our job posting. You’ve already taken a tiny step towards being a part of our team – huzzah!

We know that taking your next career step is as exciting as it can be exhausting. So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.

About PerchPeek

At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere – one move at a time.

Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be—immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.

We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.

About the role

Flexible Relocation Coaches work with PerchPeek to support current markets with surges in business volume, provide flexibility for Relocation Coach capacity, and improve coverage to support relocators across multiple markets and timezones. Flexible Coaches work within a network of third-party consultants and with PerchPeek’s Network Manager to deliver quality customer experience in line with customer requirements and PerchPeek’s SLAs for quality and productivity.

You might be an awesome Relocation Coach if you’ve previously worked as a Customer Success Manager, Concierge, Personal Assistant, Support or Operations Specialist, or if you’ve worked in industries like travel, hospitality, SaaS startups, or HR. Previous experience in the Global Mobility / Relocation industry and knowledge of relocation management and/or destination services is helpful, but not essential, to being a successful Flex Relocation Coach. You’ll receive comprehensive materials to guide you and paid training on all of our internal systems.

Scope of Work

Flexible Relocation Coaches will be contracted to deliver end-to-end Relocation Coach services to a diverse portfolio of relocators by:

  • Building trusted relationships with relocators over the duration of their relocation journey as their main point of contact, delegating tasks when appropriate.
  • Communicating with relocators via a) the PerchPeek app and b) through consultative and supportive calls to understand the customer’s needs, explain relocation services, and provide expertise, guidance & support to relocators within your portfolio.
  • Handling difficult or complex relocator enquiries or situations, using critical judgement to ensure the best outcomes for your movers, including escalating these as appropriate.
  • Providing the “right expertise at the right time” on all aspects of the relocation journey and life in the destination country to equip relocators to integrate successfully to their new location.
  • Supporting relocators in understanding and abiding to their company’s relocation policy, including management of their relocation allowances.
  • Recommending and coordinating additional relocation services from providers, working within PerchPeek’s Supply Chain. Examples include immigration, tax or shipping providers.
  • Systems Cleanliness: utilizing Operations and Relocation Experience processes to the highest standards to help make sure that our teams and systems run smoothly. i.e. ensuring collected data is accurate and useful for data analysis, reporting, and insights.
  • Process implementation: supporting the rollout of process improvements by engaging with new processes and tools.
  • Appropriately delegating relevant tasks to third-party consultants, monitoring service delivery to ensure all tasks are completed to a high quality within PerchPeek’s delivery SLAs.
  • Identifying and managing escalations, delivery issues and inefficiencies appropriately to ensure your deliverables align with service delivery requirements, policies, and expectations.
  • Familiarizing yourself with PerchPeek’s products and providing guidance to relocators on how they can utilise the Relocator App and its tools and content.
  • Advocating for high-quality knowledge capturing and contributing to developing the PerchPeek content library.
  • Collaborating with other Relocation Coaches for creative problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
Requirements
  • You must be based within UTC-8, UTC-7, UTC-6, or UTC-5 timezones (between Pacific Standard Time and Eastern Standard Time).
  • The role requires fluency in verbal and written English, as well as awareness or first-hand knowledge of major cities and lifestyle norms in the US.
  • Bonus if you have lived or relocated within the US!
  • Bonus if you speak one (or more!) of these languages: French, Italian, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Arabic.
  • No prior relocation experience is required, as we provide comprehensive materials to prepare you for success as a Relocation Coach!

About You

Whilst not necessary, we’re especially interested in candidates with the following skills or qualities:

  • You share our value of being Customer Obsessed: in this role, you have the customer’s needs at the heart of your thoughts and actions every day.
  • You are organized, efficient and prioritize your time so that you can balance being both proactive and reactive to the needs of your portfolio of customers and manage them across different timelines and stages of their relocations.
  • You are an eloquent and concise communicator and can tailor your written and verbal communications to the specific customer. You are comfortable managing expectations and diplomatically handling concerns or objections.

You will lead services sales and delivery, managing cross-functional collaboration, ensuring aligned and value-based outcomes for Collibra customers.

Senior Manager of Professional Services at Collibra are responsible for

  • Talent development and market insights: Develop team skills, onboard new members, and stay informed on SaaS industry trends and competitive offerings to refine sales and delivery strategies.

You have

  • Bachelor's Degree at minimum with 10+ years of relevant working experience in consulting, Professional Services sales, solution sales, and services delivery.
  • Proven track record of success in meeting or exceeding quota and building/leading high-performing professional services teams.
  • Experience scoping, pricing, negotiating, and closing SOWs for complex enterprise organizations.
  • Domain expertise in AI transformation, data governance, data management, and data quality.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.

You are
