raw.title: Design Manager (Freelance)
raw.excerpt: Charcoalblue is a global leader in delivering complex, creative, and high-profile projects across theatre, cultural institutions, immersive environments, and experiential venues.
raw.description:
Charcoalblue is a global leader in delivering complex, creative, and high-profile projects across theatre, cultural institutions, immersive environments, and experiential venues. Our Experience Design & Strategy team (XDS) applies our expertise from working with globally renowned cultural organizations to the workplace, sports, exhibition, and events markets.

We work with world-leading organizations to create spaces and experiences that support collaboration, storytelling, and meaningful engagement for staff, visitors, guests, and spectators. Our work spans a diverse range of environments, including hybrid workplaces, one-off event spaces, sports facilities, broadcast studios, conference and executive briefing centres, and integrated experiences across buildings and campuses.

The XDS team brings together specialist Design Managers, Design Strategists, Experience Designers, Digital Design Consultants, Design Coordinators, and creative and technical designers, supported by a broad range of multidisciplinary design and project management expertise across the wider Charcoalblue team. We frequently work closely with individual clients, becoming embedded within their workflows and project teams to provide specialist expertise, leadership, and delivery support.

Engagement Details

We are seeking to engage a Freelance Design Manager to support our growing Charcoalblue Experience Design & Strategy (XDS) team, across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. The primary project and client location is Singapore, locality to Singapore is a preference but we are interested in applicants across the APAC region. Locality to our APAC Charcoalblue office in Melbourne is a secondary preference. This freelance engagement is anticipated to be approximately 16 hours per week, with an initial term until the end of the calendar year (December 2026) with the potential for the scope and duration of the engagement to extend depending on project requirements and upcoming opportunities.

Initially, the role will be focused on providing oversight and guidance for the design and delivery of events, executive briefings, and collaboration spaces within the workplace sector, as part of a key Charcoalblue account for a major Technology Workplace client. The role will provide design management and project delivery services, including working as an embedded vendor within a client team as a key part of our Design Management and Creative consultancy teams. This is a client-facing role, and you will be integral in the complex task of stakeholder management. You will act as the subject-matter expert, often representing the client and serving as part of a wider team in a self-directed, managed-services environment.

You will be responsible for working with our clients to understand their vision and translate this into an actionable brief. You will support the delivery of the project, ensuring the client brief is delivered upon.  You will produce clear documentation, presentation, and graphics to illustrate design considerations such as user journeys, creative visioning, master planning, adjacencies, operational needs, and guest experience.

We are looking for a multifaceted, innovative problem solver with broad knowledge of event spaces and/or guest experiences, and the ability to guide the delivery of these projects aligned with the client vision and delivery strategy. Additionally, you must be a clear communicator, action-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable with ambiguity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide subject matter expertise and design guidance for Events and Experiences spaces

  • Ensure the architectural design of Event, Collaboration, and Executive Briefing Venues, Activations, and Support Spaces are optimized for the overall guest and user experience.

  • Develop client requirements documentation for new event and experience spaces and produce briefs for the architectural design team, including architectural requirements, operational considerations, and program constraints.

  • Develop, document, analyze, and present user journey studies and wider strategic visioning studies

  • Deliver and maintain progress reports and presentations to key stakeholders and partners as required using written and drawn documentation to communicate stakeholder requirements, project aims, and design intent.

  • Act as a key point of contact for client stakeholder teams, project managers, and the design teams to ensure accurate communication between all parties.

  • Be a trusted, friendly, and flexible collaborator for all client and external partners while balancing diverse team priorities.

  • Be actively involved in Design Team and other key project meetings, providing subject matter expert advice to guide the project with an understanding of schedule and cost considerations.

This list is not intended to be exhaustive and may be subject to change in response to project and business requirements.

About You

We're interested in professionals who have:

Essential

  • Minimum five (5) years of professional experience required in either the event management and operations field, or in the design and construction of spaces relating to the performing arts, events, executive briefing centers, experiential design, or hospitality & leisure.

  • Ability to read construction drawings and specifications, and a professional interest in construction projects

Desirable

  • Minimum three (3) years of relevant experience in design management or client representation relating to events or experiential spaces and/or formal qualification/degree in architecture, interior design, venue design, or related field.

  • Skilled in the visual, written, and verbal communication of design issues with capability to think outside the box and bring creative, non-standard, and innovative solutions to the table.

  • A practical understanding of both RIBA and AIA design stages, and the typical level of information required at each stage.

  • Adept at synthesizing complex information and high-level concepts into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations for executive and cross-functional audiences

  • Experience in experiential design, executive briefing programs, theatre, performing arts, or event space buildings either through direct experience or professional design work.

  • Proven vision, leadership, and strategic skills to prioritize evolving initiatives; ability to turn ideas and capabilities into effective initiatives that engage users.

  • An understanding of construction terminology and building systems, and overall project sequence/timing.

  • Ability and proven record of helping to steer decision making and processing.

  • An imaginative approach to problem-solving will be a significant advantage.

  • A collaborative and personal approach.


Interpersonal Skills

  • Ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment with a high degree of self-motivation and initiative.

  • Outstanding verbal and written communicator

  • Ability to easily manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Detail oriented with ability to think, plan, and execute on multiple projects in different phases simultaneously with little direct supervision.

  • Informed design sensibility, with a curious and open approach to design

  • Able to work calmly and effectively under pressure.

  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing business needs.

  • Ability to build relationships with colleagues, clients, vendors, stakeholders, and management.

Availability

The freelancer must be available to participate in daily meetings during standard business hours in the GMT+8 time zone. While the engagement can be performed remotely within the APAC region, availability during core business hours is essential to support effective collaboration with clients and project teams.

The engagement will initially be on a5-6 month initial term, running to the end of the current calendar year (December 2026).

Application

To apply, please complete the online application form. A cover letter is also required to be considered for this engagement. In your letter, please share what excites you about this opportunity and why you’d like to work with the Charcoalblue team. In addition, please respond to the following prompts:

  1. Describe your experience in design management or client representation related to the design of events or experiential spaces, or how your experience in architecture or events could be applied to this field.

  2. Share how your professional background aligns with the required experience in either event management and operations, or the design and construction of spaces related to the performing arts, events, executive briefing centers, experiential design, or hospitality and leisure.

Please also include links to any personal or professional work you would like us to review as part of your application.

Interviews will be conducted remotely (via Microsoft Teams), starting in August 2026. The time and date will be confirmed for shortlisted freelancers.

Start Date

As soon as possible

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion Overview

We are committed to becoming an increasingly inclusive organization. We continuously work to eliminate unfair and discriminatory practices within the company while encouraging full and equal contributions from our diverse community.

Our mission is to foster an inclusive ethos by creating a welcoming work environment across our global practice. We provide recruitment opportunities that are open to all and encourage applications from candidates of diverse backgrounds to ensure our global team reflects the clients we collaborate with and the communities we serve.

If you require this application in a different format or need support during the application process, please contact Natalia Abril at or via telephone at+61 (03) 9417 6524. If you have any questions about accessibility or how the role may accommodate your personal circumstances, please reach out.

Charcoalblue strives to provide an environment free from discrimination and is committed to ensuring that all clients and customers can access the services and products we offer, across our three regions. We believe that all individuals – employees and clients alike – are entitled to be treated with respect and dignity.

About Ritual

Ritual is a personal health brand that is raising the bar for daily wellness. Known for our best-selling, clinically backed prenatal, we create science-backed supplements with transparency at their core. We believe women deserve products they can trust, backed by real evidence—not just promises.

We started by reinventing the multivitamin with the first visible supply chain of its kind. Today, we’re expanding into new categories with the same high standards that built our reputation. Hundreds of thousands trust Ritual, and we’re growing fast.

Our team of 120+ scientists, creatives, and skeptics is raising the bar for women’s health. We’re venture-backed, based in sunny Los Angeles, and always looking for people ready to challenge the industry—and do the best work of their careers.

About the role

The Brand Manager leads the positioning, commercialization, and go-to-market strategy for a portfolio of Ritual products. This role owns how assigned products are brought to market and communicated to consumers across DTC, Amazon, and Retail.

The Brand Manager independently leads defined product and commercialization initiatives, translating consumer, product, and business insights into clear marketing strategies and compelling consumer storytelling. This person serves as a cross-functional partner across Innovation, Science, Regulatory, Creative, Growth, and Customer, proactively identifying opportunities, navigating tradeoffs, and driving work forward within their scope.

What you'll do

  • Lead end-to-end product commercialization and go-to-market strategy for assigned products and key initiatives, developing positioning, messaging, launch plans, and integrated marketing strategies from concept through execution.
  • Develop clear, differentiated product positioning and messaging, independently translating product features, scientific information, consumer insights, and competitive trends into compelling consumer-facing stories.
  • Serve as the cross-functional marketing lead for assigned launches and commercialization initiatives, building strong partnerships and driving alignment across Product Innovation, Science, Regulatory, Creative, Growth, Customer, Retail, Sales, and other key stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute integrated launch and marketing plans in partnership with channel teams, proactively identifying dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs and bringing forward recommendations to keep initiatives moving. Ensure current portfolio health is checked and tracking towards goals.
  • Lead ongoing product messaging and creative optimization, using consumer insights, competitive trends, and performance data to identify opportunities, test new approaches, and improve product adoption, conversion, and engagement.
  • Monitor and analyze product and campaign performance, synthesizing multiple sources of business, consumer, and market data into clear insights, recommendations, and actions.
  • Partner with Consumer Insights and Product Innovation to understand consumer needs, category trends, and whitespace opportunities, helping inform product positioning, innovation, and future commercialization strategies.
  • Manage key elements of the product lifecycle, including expansions, reformulations, packaging updates, claims changes, and other initiatives, while proactively identifying gaps and opportunities that improve the consumer experience and product performance.

Who you are

  • A creative problem solver. You independently work through routine challenges and bottlenecks, and when facing a new or more complex problem, you bring forward thoughtful options and recommendations—not just questions.
  • Strategic and curious. You are naturally curious and dig deep to understand consumers, products, categories, and business performance. You can quickly absorb new information and adapt your approach when priorities or strategies shift.
  • A dot connector. You look beyond your immediate work to understand dependencies, tradeoffs, and opportunities across teams. You proactively identify potential gaps and help connect the right people and information to move work forward.
  • A sound decision maker. You use multiple inputs—including data, consumer insights, stakeholder perspectives, and judgment—to make thoughtful decisions and clearly articulate your rationale.
  • A strong collaborator. You build productive relationships across functions, proactively share information, and adapt your working style to complement the strengths and expertise of others.
  • A clear and kind communicator. You communicate clearly and thoughtfully, tailoring your message and communication style to the audience and creating alignment around priorities, decisions, and next steps.
  • An agile learner. You embrace new information, approaches, and ways of working. You adapt quickly to changing priorities, identify potential friction early, and view change as an opportunity to improve.
  • Accountable for the outcome. You take ownership of your work from start to finish, maintain a high bar for quality, proactively communicate risks or timeline changes, and use the appropriate tools and support to keep projects moving.

What you'll need

  • Education: BS/BA, preferably in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. Equivalent experience also accepted.
  • Experience: 4+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Brand Management, Marketing, or a related role, preferably within CPG, VMS, wellness, beauty, or another consumer-focused industry.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading product launches, commercialization initiatives, or complex marketing workstreams from strategy through execution.
  • Strong experience developing product positioning, messaging, and consumer-facing marketing, with the ability to translate complex product information into clear and compelling storytelling.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to independently resolve routine challenges and bring thoughtful options and recommendations to leadership when navigating more complex or ambiguous decisions.
  • Ability to synthesize multiple sources of consumer, market, and business data to identify opportunities, understand tradeoffs, and recommend clear paths forward.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and project management skills, with strong accountability for deliverable quality, timelines, and project outcomes.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships, proactively connect workstreams, and drive alignment across multiple stakeholders.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed above. We're committed to building a diverse team and recognize that skills can be developed in many different ways.

Compensation

  • Pay Range: $106,000 - $140,000
  • Your base salary is one part of your total compensation package. The salary range represents the entire compensation range for this position. Exact compensation will depend on a number of factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, level, years of experience, technical expertise, and other qualifications. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. This role is also eligible for equity + generous benefits + 401k + unlimited PTO etc - see our list of perks/ benefits below.

You'll lead creative and omnichannel marketing services at a segment level, manage the concepting, production, and refinement of marketing creative to bring marketing strategies and plans to life. You will play a key role in shaping the future of the Workplace Solutions creative organization, from building the team to defining how creative services are delivered across the business.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary: $110,000- $114,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Oversees the development and delivery of creative and omnichannel marketing services to meet the needs of segment marketing strategies and plans. Ensures delivery aligns with corporate brand standards.
  • Leads, mentors, and manages staff to foster a high-performance culture, ensuring their team has the necessary skills, training, feedback and decision-making autonomy. Oversees all personnel functions, including hiring, performance management, development planning and compliance with company policies.

Collaborates with stakeholders to ensure the target audience, business objectives, success measures, messaging, products and distribution channels, etc. are well understood - so the creative team is positioned to deliver with confidence. Participates in concepting and reviews with stakeholders as needed.
  • Engages and works collaboratively with other functions (such as segment marketing, brand and communications, marketing operations, insights, analytics and technology) to ensure alignment with standards and requirements, coordination in strategies and plans, and effective use of their skills, knowledge and capabilities.
    Develops and manages a roadmap for the ongoing improvement of creative and omnichannel marketing services at the segment level. Proactively seeks and implements improvement opportunities, such as leading and/or partnering on changes to process, training, technology, data and analytics, and use of AI.
  • Actively manages expenses within assigned budgets to ensure they are appropriate and optimized for results. Develops, negotiates and maintains relationships with key vendors and external partners as needed. Serves as a primary contact and/or coordination point for external creative agencies/contractors.
    Contributes to marketing strategy for the broader segment, annual planning and budgeting, and supports internal communications.
  • Stays abreast of market, economic, audience, competitive, legal/regulatory, innovation and other trends that could impact audience expectations and behaviors, results, and what's possible. Assesses the implications and incorporates into creative and omnichannel development.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Significant experience with creative and omnichannel marketing practices, such as writing, design, video, print and digital marketing (such as email, SMS, search and social media marketing.)
  • Effective people and change leadership, including the ability to inspire, coach, develop and hold team members accountable to change.
  • Solid relationship building and influencing skills. Ability to lead, collaborate and challenge cross-functionally, build trust, and manage conflict productively.
  • Proven ability to lead teams to execute on multiple projects in parallel and partner to make prioritization and tradeoff decisions, while enforcing quality and brand standards.

    Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex concepts into clear, compelling, and actionable communication for multiple audiences including senior leadership, teams, and external stakeholders.
  • You promote a collaborative culture, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

PREFERRED:

  • Significant experience with graphic design software (Adobe Creative Suite; i.e., InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, etc.), marketing automation tools (such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud), and CRM (such as Salesforce.com).

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

As a Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will be the post-sales primary point of contact for our Commercial customers. You will be responsible for taking lead on customer engagements across onboarding, implementation, and adoption. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering and Sales to ensure the successful onboarding and support of your customers. You are their day-to-day contact, building relationships with customers and driving outcomes, adoption, and delivering time-to-value.

What you’ll do:

  • Success Planning & Value: Drive business success planning by partnering with customers, pre-sales, and post-sales teams to align on requirements, goals, and challenges. Provide thought leadership on change management for large, scaled rollouts. Support the full Business Value Realization cycle to ensure customers can demonstrate and prove value internally.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for customer needs and requirements to internal teams. This means being a team player and having strong collaboration skills - this role must align with many different internal teams, influence them to act toward customer needs.
  • Issue Management: Collaborate with Technical Support and Customer Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution to customer issues.
  • Product Expertise: Develop hands-on technical knowledge of Chainguard and stay up-to-date with industry trends, new features, and best practices so you can help customers optimize their use of Chainguard.
  • Training & Education: Collaborate with customers and our Edu team to ensure customers are educated on product features, best practices, and security principles.
  • Account Management: Develop relationships with multiple levels of customer stakeholders from technicians to CISOs. Work closely with sales teams to identify the best path to renew and expand customers while minimizing churn risks.

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years experience in customer facing roles collaborating with both technical and business teams - Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management or a combination of those plus Sales, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Support.
  • Relevant domain knowledge of one or more of the following: Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security infrastructure, containers, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle.
  • This is a strategic and proactive role, our expectation is that this person will take full ownership of their customer portfolio and act with a high level of autonomy. This includes making key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; deciding when to include our executive team or c-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict, and advocating to internal teams including sales, product, engineering, etc.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be often build entirely new process or practices to ensure we best serve customers.
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to continuous personal and professional development, actively seeking opportunities to enhance skills, expand knowledge, and advance within their career and field.
  • Driven, high emotional intelligence, and strong priority management skills

Strongly Preferred:

  • Previous early-stage startup experience
  • Passion for technology & cybersecurity
  • Relevant hands-on technical experience, in one or more of the following domains: cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), containers, Linux, Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security, security infrastructure, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle

Compensation: up to $130,000 base salary + bonus

If your experience is close but doesn’t fulfill all requirements, please apply. Chainguard is on a mission to build the best team. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring Chainguardians with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

raw.excerpt: About Lydian EnergyLydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America.
raw.description:
About Lydian Energy

Lydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America. Lydian owns 14 assets in development, construction or under operation, consisting of both solar and storage, which reached or are expected to reach FNTP from 2024-2028.

Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital (“EEC”), a leading private equity fund manager with more than $1.5B in assets under management, that is exclusively focused on north American middle market renewables investing. Lydian’s relationship with EEC provides several critical advantages, including access to (i) a specialized team of value-add investor-operators with decades of renewables development, construction, and transaction experience and (ii) committed discretionary equity capital, strong relationships with debt and tax equity investors, and deep experience structuring tax equity and project financings.

Lydian has built a team of seasoned, passionate energy infrastructure professionals with deep expertise in project development, construction, financing, and M&A. This is an opportunity to join a fully capitalized development platform that is running at full capacity, but still at an early-enough stage for you to have a real impact on company culture and commercial outcomes.

Job Scope

As a Senior High Voltage Engineer , you demonstrate the perfect combination of technical expertise and project management savvy. The Senior High Voltage Engineer is responsible for the design review , equipment specification, and validation of high voltage systems and components, typically ranging from 34.5kV to 800kV, used in BESS and PV systems collector substation as well as any self-built HV utility switchyard. This role involves ensuring technical compliance with standards, optimizing system performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient high voltage solutions.

Responsibilities

You are responsible for the development, coordination and review of designs and technical standards for utility scale solar and BESS projects, managing engineering service providers to achieve this goal.

  • Working with Project PM to finalize the EPC contract and the technical exhibits.
  • Manage the work of engineering services providers and consultants.
  • Establish, maintain and improve technical specifications for Company facilities and equipment.
  • Provide technical support and supervision for the design and construction phases of the project, including value added engineering consistent with the required project specifications and requirements.
  • Provide technical support for the review/preparation of client proposals and EPC/equipment RFP packages.
  • Participate in the evaluation and selection of EPC and main equipment suppliers.
  • Participate in the preparation, review, and negotiations of the technical exhibits for project sales, equipment procurement and EPC contracting agreements.
  • Provide engineering and QA/QC support to the project management team during project construction and commissioning.
  • Provide technical support for interconnection in collaboration with transmission engineering team.
  • Provide technical direction during startup, testing and commissioning and performance monitoring.
  • Refine procedures for the interface between development and engineering as well as between project managers and engineering.
  • Communicate and influence cross-functionally within Company.
  • Responsible for consultant scopes and associated costs
  • Interfaces with third-party engineering service providers, and subcontractors
  • Specify and Select appropriate materials and components (e.g., cables, connectors, bushings, relays, circuit breakers, MPT, MVT ) for high voltage applications.
  • Review and approve substations, switchyards, and HV collection systems (34.5kV–345kV+)
  • Own protection schemes, relay coordination, grounding, and insulation strategy
  • Define and enforce clear HV scope in EPC contracts and technical exhibits
  • Hold EPC, OEM, and consultants accountable for HV deliverables
  • Lead commissioning readiness and energization for all HV systems
  • Own protection testing, relay validation, and SCADA integration
  • Ensure compliance with utility and interconnection requirements
  • Support transmission and interconnection teams with HV technical inputs
  • Establish and enforce HV QA/QC plan across design, construction, and commissioning
  • Identify and close scope gaps between EPC, OEM, and subcontractors

Qualifications

  • Experience as an electrical, power systems engineer or equivalent: 5+ years
  • Experience with HV equipment 115KV-345KV+ 5+ years
    • Design ,testing and commissioning experience
  • Familiarity with PV or energy storage related controls: 3+ year(s)
    • System protection and control design
    • Expertise in model-based systems/controls engineering
    • Expertise in closed-loop control algorithms.
    • Strong familiarity with power generation and/or grid level control systems.
  • Enthusiasm for getting things done, taking personal responsibility, adding value within a team setting, and ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Experience commissioning of HV substation
  • Experience in Energy Management System SCADA or other types of control systems
  • Experience in product HV equipment FAT testing ands report assessment
  • Experience with AutoCAD to develop single line, 2-D Electrical
  • Experience with interconnection applications upgrade requirements
  • BSC in electrical engineering , PE is Plus
  • 7+ years’ experience in HV systems (substations, protection, commissioning)
  • Proven track record leading energization and commissioning
  • Strong EPC and OEM coordination experience
  • IPP background preferred
  • Proven leadership presence, with experience representing an organization's engineering position in external technical discussions with clients, EPC contractors, and utility partners
  • Professional Engineer (PE) preferred

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are committed to equal-employment principles and are dedicated to diversity and the strength it brings to the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, military status, sexual orientation or any other protected category or class that may be applicable.

raw.description:
We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking.

Woolpert is an award-winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting-edge technology to deliver exceptional client value. Our team is passionate about their work and committed to building the next generation of industry leaders, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, Woolpert embraces progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.

Position Overview:

Woolpert is seeking an experienced Project Surveyor to support survey and geospatial projects throughout the United States. This position provides technical leadership and project coordination for infrastructure, transportation, aviation, utility, and other geospatial projects. The Project Surveyor will plan, coordinate, review, and deliver survey work in accordance with project scope, schedule, budget, quality standards, and professional requirements. This role works closely with project managers, field crews, survey technicians, CADD professionals, engineers, geospatial specialists, subconsultants, and clients to produce accurate, fit-for-purpose deliverables. The successful candidate will bring strong technical surveying knowledge along with project leadership, communication, quality management, and familiarity with emerging geospatial technologies. This role will also mentor staff, support proposals and business development, and help strengthen client relationships. This position may be located within the United States and will support projects and teams across multiple geographic regions.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead survey tasks and project phases from planning and scoping through final delivery.
  • Review project scopes, RFPs, plans, specifications, records, and client requirements to establish survey limits, technical approaches, staffing, schedules, and budgets.
  • Develop survey methodologies based on project requirements, site conditions, accuracy standards, schedule, and available technology.
  • Plan and coordinate horizontal and vertical control, GNSS/GPS observations, total station surveys, leveling, topographic, construction, boundary, right-of-way, and supplemental design surveys.
  • Coordinate boundary and property research, including deeds, plats, easements, field evidence, and right-of-way determinations.
  • Prepare and review survey deliverables including plats, legal descriptions, exhibits, reports, control documentation, basemapping, surface models, and design-ready datasets.
  • Integrate conventional survey data with technologies such as UAS, terrestrial lidar, aerial imagery and photogrammetry, mobile mapping, GNSS, GIS, and other geospatial datasets.
  • Oversee survey data processing, adjustments, feature coding, terrain development, planimetric mapping, and CADD production.
  • Coordinate survey and subsurface utility information, including utility records, field evidence, test holes, and Quality Level A and B data when included in project scope.
  • Apply applicable federal, state, local, client, CADD/GIS, and professional surveying standards.
  • Develop and implement project-specific QA/QC procedures and review field observations, calculations, control networks, mapping, boundary and right-of-way determinations, surfaces, and final deliverables.
  • Monitor project scope, schedule, staffing, and budget; identify risks or variances and coordinate corrective actions with project managers.
  • Coordinate field activities, staffing, equipment, property access, traffic control, permitting, restricted-access requirements, and project-specific safety expectations.
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to survey crews, technicians, CADD personnel, and geospatial staff.
  • Collaborate across engineering, transportation, aviation, utilities, GIS, photogrammetry, remote sensing, and other disciplines to support multidisciplinary projects.
  • Communicate with clients, contractors, subconsultants, property owners, utility representatives, government agencies, and internal teams to resolve project needs and recommend practical solutions.
  • Support proposals, scopes of work, staffing plans, schedules, fee estimates, presentations, interviews, and other business development activities.
  • Maintain organized project documentation and promote a culture of safety, quality, collaboration, accountability, innovation, and client service.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring:

  • Bachelor's or Associate degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, Geography, GIS, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience will be considered.
  • Extensive experience with Aviation surveys (18B) and a strong background in Geodesy strongly preferred. LSIT or Surveyor Intern certification preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating survey work for infrastructure, transportation, aviation, utility, land development, construction, or similar projects.
  • Strong knowledge of professional land surveying practices, including boundary and topographic surveying, horizontal and vertical control, right-of-way, GNSS/GPS, total station surveying, differential leveling, aviation surveys, and construction survey support.
  • Experience establishing, processing, adjusting, and documenting survey control networks.
  • Familiarity with modern geospatial technologies, including UAS, terrestrial lidar, mobile mapping, aerial photogrammetry, remote sensing, GIS, and high-accuracy GNSS.
  • Experience interpreting engineering plans, survey scopes, deeds, plats, easements, right-of-way plans, utility records, construction documents, and technical specifications.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing survey calculations, plats, legal descriptions, exhibits, control reports, basemaps, terrain models, and related deliverables.
  • Strong understanding of survey QA/QC principles and applicable surveying, mapping, CADD, and GIS standards.
  • Ability to manage scopes, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, project changes, and multiple concurrent assignments.
  • Strong technical judgment, organization, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across disciplines and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior staff.
  • Commitment to professional ethics, quality, safety, client service, and applicable surveying laws and standards.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and commonly used project collaboration tools.
  • Ability and willingness to travel, including occasional overnight travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a Project Surveyor, Survey Task Lead, Technical Lead, or Survey QA/QC Reviewer on multidisciplinary projects.
  • Experience with Trimble Business Center and related Trimble surveying technologies.
  • Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D, MicroStation, OpenRoads Designer, or comparable CADD platforms.
  • Experience with GIS, mobile mapping, terrestrial lidar, UAS, aerial photogrammetry, or other remote sensing workflows.
  • Experience with high-order horizontal or vertical control surveys.
  • Experience leading survey work for state DOTs, airports, municipalities, federal agencies, utilities, or other public-sector clients.
  • Experience working on active transportation or aviation facilities with significant access, safety, traffic control, security, or operational requirements.
  • Experience supporting proposals, fee development, technical approaches, interviews, qualifications packages, or other business development activities.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing junior survey staff.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to perform prolonged computer and office work and operate standard office equipment.
  • Ability to occasionally visit active survey, roadway, aviation, infrastructure, utility, and construction sites.
  • Ability to safely work around active construction or transportation environments using required personal protective equipment.
  • Ability to walk on uneven terrain and occasionally reach, bend, climb, balance, and lift or move equipment associated with project activities.
  • Ability to safely and effectively perform the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. raw.description:
Location: Remote, United States

About Trail of Bits

Founded in 2012 by 3 expert hackers with no investment capital, Trail of Bits is the premier place for security experts to boldly advance security and address technology's newest and most challenging risks. It has helped secure some of the world's most targeted organizations and devices. Our combination of novel research with practical solutions reduces the security risks that our clients face from emerging technologies. Our work helps drive the security industry and the public understanding of the technology underlying our world.

Cybersecurity preparedness is a moving target. Companies like ours are the tip of the spear in the fight against attackers. Our research-based and custom-engineering approach ensures that our client's capabilities are at the forefront of what's available. For companies and technologies that live and die by their security, a proactive, tailored approach is required to keep one step ahead of attackers.

Democratizing security information is essential. As part of our business, we provide ongoing informational support through blogs, whitepapers, newsletters, meetups, and open-source tools. The more the community understands security, the more they'll understand why a company like ours is so unique and valuable.

The Role

Trail of Bits seeks a Security Engineer I for our Application Security practice. You will contribute to security assessments of client software, partner with more experienced engineers, identify vulnerabilities across the application and system levels, and own clearly scoped pieces of client engagements. You will drive your own vulnerability analysis, develop tools alongside the team, and help clients understand and fix the issues you find.

This role bridges vulnerability research and applied security. Your work will be hands-on: analyzing complex code, building custom tooling, conducting threat modeling, and owning your findings through client delivery. It is distinct from roles centered on security operations, SOC work, GRC, compliance, policy, audit, or general security administration. Candidates from broader or adjacent security backgrounds should be prepared to talk through relevant hands-on, code-level security work they have personally completed.

Security Engineer I is an early-career role, but it is not a training role for someone new to software or security. Relevant experience may come from professional work, internships, advanced coursework, independent research, open-source contributions, CTFs, or substantial personal or academic projects. Regardless of where you gained the experience, you should be able to talk through code-level security work you performed, how you approached the problem, and the conclusions you reached. You will receive direction and review from a project lead while independently completing well-scoped technical work.

What You'll Achieve

  • Security Assessment Ownership: Lead the review of a specific component, module, or system within a larger client engagement. Trace root causes and own your analysis from discovery through client delivery.
  • Vulnerability Discovery and Analysis: Find and validate vulnerabilities in application code and systems, explain exploitation paths, assess impact, and develop proof-of-concept code when appropriate.
  • Custom Security Tooling: Design and build security-testing tools and automation for vulnerability detection and deeper analysis.
  • Architecture and Threat Modeling: Review software architectures, identify attack surfaces, data flows, trust and privilege boundaries, and recommend concrete mitigations.
  • Client Communication: Translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for engineering teams and explain the evidence behind your conclusions.
  • Research and Innovation: Contribute to security research, open-source tools, internal knowledge sharing, and technical documentation.

What You'll Bring

The following are requirements for this role:

  • At least 1 year of combined relevant experience in application security, vulnerability research, security-focused software engineering, or a closely related area. This experience may come from employment, internships, advanced coursework, independent research, open-source contributions, CTFs, or substantial personal or academic projects.
  • Demonstrable vulnerability-discovery capability. You can talk through a vulnerability or security weakness you personally found or validated, including how you identified it, established its impact, and reached your conclusion. Evidence may come from professional work, coursework, projects, CTFs, CVEs, bug bounties, responsible disclosure, open source, or comparable research.
  • Strong code-analysis skills. You can read unfamiliar code, trace execution and data flow, identify logic or implementation flaws, and distinguish a tool signal from a validated vulnerability.
  • Hands-on coding proficiency in at least two relevant languages, such as Rust, Go, C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar languages used in security analysis and tool development.
  • Working knowledge of memory-corruption vulnerabilities and common mitigations, such as buffer overflows, use-after-free, stack cookies, ASLR, NX/DEP, CFI, or MTE, including the ability to reason about exploit primitives at an appropriate early-career level.
  • Familiarity with operating-system concepts, IPC, privilege boundaries, and the ways applications interact with system internals.
  • Ability to independently investigate a well-scoped problem, debug issues, document evidence, ask focused questions when blocked, and deliver work with review from a project lead.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical findings and remediation guidance to software engineers and work productively on a distributed team.

Preferred Qualifications

These are not day-one requirements, but areas where the role can grow.

  • Active or recent CTF participation, competition results, or comparable hands-on security challenges.
  • Published vulnerability research, CVEs, responsible disclosures, bug bounty findings, or security writeups.
  • Contributions to open-source security tools, libraries, or research.
  • Experience with mobile application security, mobile system internals, or binary analysis on mobile platforms.
  • Experience assessing cloud platforms or infrastructure and working with tools such as Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, or Ansible.
  • Experience with kernel code, drivers, reverse engineering, fuzzing, or other low-level systems work.
  • Published technical writing, conference talks, or substantial technical documentation.

Compensation

The base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 to $160,000 and will include additional bonuses. Compensation is informed by geographic location, relevant experience, and internal equity. These figures represent starting compensation for U.S.-based candidates. For specifics, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process.

Trail of Bits offers a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, retirement contributions, professional development stipends, and generous PTO.

Trail of Bits, Inc. participates in E-Verify, the US federal electronic employment eligibility verification program. Learn more.

Trail of Bits is an equal-opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law, and we provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process on request.

Benefits, Perks & Wellness

Trail of Bits is our people, not a place. With over 100+ employees working from every time zone across the globe, our remote-first culture is built on autonomy and trust (and backed by smile-worthy benefits) for full-time employees:

Empowered Living

  • Competitive salary complemented by performance-based bonuses.
  • Fully company-paid insurance packages, including health, dental, vision, disability, and life.

raw.title: Maintenance Dispatcher
raw.excerpt: SFR3 is a boutique real estate investment fund managing $2B+ of affordable single-family homes.
raw.description:
SFR3 is a boutique real estate investment fund managing $2B+ of affordable single-family homes. The fund renovated distressed homes, using software drivin operations to run many "tertiary" markets concurrently. Today we own 10k homes across 20 states, and will launch a second fund on the same rails.

You are a hands-on problem solver who achieves the right outcome through excellent communication skills. You have turned the wrench, or you have stood next to the person turning it — either way you know how residential systems actually fail, not how a manual says they fail. When a resident says “my sink is leaking,” you are three questions from knowing whether it is the supply line, the P-trap, or something behind the wall. “No cooling” does not make you reach for the dispatch button - it makes you ask about the filter, the breaker, and the thermostat setting first.

You speak clear, conversational American English and you are comfortable running a call — guiding it, slowing it down, keeping it professional when the person on the other end is having the worst day of their month. You write the same way you talk: clean, specific, no filler. Your work-order notes and scopes are the reason the field resource shows up prepared instead of guessing.

What drives you is getting it right the first time. An unnecessary truck roll offends you. A repeat visit for a part someone should have brought offends you more. You sit at the intersection of the trades and customer service responsible for bringing both sides together to deliver best in class resident service EVERY time.

Your Mandate

Diagnostic accuracy is the name of the game: you are the single decision point between a resident’s description of a problem and the money we spend solving it. You determine what is actually happening in the home, whether anyone or the property is at risk, whether the resident can safely resolve it themselves, who should do the work, how urgently, and exactly what they need to know before they knock on the door. What kinds of calls are you working?

  • Sorting a “no cooling” call into a filter, a tripped breaker, a thermostat setting, or a real HVAC failure
  • Recognizing an uncontrolled leak, sewage backup, gas odor, or electrical hazard fast — and escalating before it becomes property damage
  • Getting a Property Engineer to the door with the right trade and the right parts on the first trip
  • Knowing when a specialized vendor is worth the spend, and when it is not

Talk & Diagnose

  • Excellent communication skills verbal and written in clear-professional English
  • Ability to guide the conversation with effective diagnostic questions
  • Translate what the resident describes into accurate maintenance terminology
  • Explain the issue and the next steps in language the resident can actually follow
  • Professionally manage a large volume of issues to completion

Troubleshoot & Self-Resolve

  • Guide residents through safe, basic troubleshooting where appropriate — GFCIs, breakers, thermostat settings, HVAC filters, simple plumbing conditions, appliance controls
  • Use real maintenance knowledge to determine what is occurring at the home, not just what was reported
  • Know when troubleshooting should stop and a qualified field resource must be dispatched

Triage Emergencies & Habitability

  • Quickly recognize life-safety, emergency, active-damage, and habitability conditions
  • Ask the questions that establish real severity and urgency - If everything is an emergency, nothing is an emergency. You know where to hold the line based on facts not resident frustration or other market dynamics.

Dispatch & Own the Outcome

  • Write work orders carrying enough diagnostic detail that the field resource arrives prepared - First visit resolution is what keeps you up at night.
  • Monitor the work through completion and keep the resident informed every step of the way
  • Control maintenance spend by cutting unnecessary dispatches, wrong-trade assignments, repeat visits, and avoidable vendor use

You will be measured on response time, triage quality, resident communications, resident satisfaction, and your team’s productivity. Build & Ship

What We Are Looking For

  • Previous experience in residential maintenance, construction, property management maintenance, facilities management, maintenance dispatch, or a related field — required
  • Working knowledge of common residential systems: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing/water intrusion, sewer/drain, appliances, doors/windows, drywall, flooring, and general residential construction
  • Strong spoken and written English — not just understanding conversational American English, but ability to run a professional call with a U.S. resident, explain technical information simply, and summarize it in clear, grammatically correct writing.
  • Solid grasp of what constitutes a maintenance emergency and a habitability concern
  • Sound decision-making on information gathered remotely, at volume, without someone checking your work
  • Proficient with computer-based work-order systems, dashboards, and communication platforms

Strong Signals

  • 5+ years of relevant maintenance, construction, property management, facilities, or dispatch experience
  • Hands-on field time — you have personally diagnosed and repaired residential systems
  • Prior remote work supporting U.S.-based customers or field teams
  • Experience in a high-volume, fast-moving environment where you owned the call and the outcome

Overview

SailPoint is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Partner Manager to lead and develop our Japan partner ecosystem.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record in partner management and channel development within the enterprise software industry, with the ability to collaborate effectively across account sales, inside sales, marketing, solution engineering, professional services, customer success, legal, contracts, operations, global programs and worldwide & regional leadership teams.

This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial role requiring strong business acumen, strategic thinking, excellent communication skills, and a strong bias toward action. The Partner Manager will be expected to build trusted executive relationships, identify new market opportunities, create pipeline and drive measurable business outcomes through strategic partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive partner ecosystem strategy aligned with SailPoint’s business priorities and growth objectives.
  • Build and strengthen strategic relationships with key partners including consulting partners, system integrators, technology partners and distributors.
  • Identify, recruit and onboard new strategic partners to expand SailPoint's coverage and penetrate new emerging markets.
  • Leverage distributor and partner networks to increase SailPoint’s market presence and reach.

  • Embed SailPoint’s solutions, technology and value proposition into partners’ go-to-market strategies and solution portfolios.
  • Establish a regular business review cadence with strategic partners to identify opportunities, track performance and drive mutual business outcomes.
  • Develop and execute partner enablement programs to strengthen partner sales, technical and delivery capabilities.
  • Drive partner delivery certifications and accreditations to strengthen implementation capabilities and ensure successful customer outcomes.
  • Develop and execute joint partner marketing strategies to generate market awareness, demand, pipeline and net-new opportunities.
  • Collaborate with partners on campaigns, field events, account-based initiatives and other demand-generation activities.
  • Ensure partners are aligned with SailPoint’s vision, product roadmap, corporate strategy and go-to-market priorities.
  • Ensure compliance on corporate channel policies, partner programs, operational processes, legal and contractual requirements.
  • Establish and maintain strong executive-level relationships across SailPoint and strategic partner organizations.

About SH/FT

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

About the Role

We're looking for a seasoned Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Technical Lead to join our team. In this role, you'll be the go-to expert for a suite of Adobe technologies – spanning AEP, Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and Customer Journey Analytics – serving clients across multiple industries.

You'll balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution: architecting solutions, building within the platforms, and guiding other developers through implementation. You'll work alongside a collaborative team of strategists, analysts, creatives, and engineers working across the broader tech ecosystem – including Salesforce, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, and Adobe Target – and you'll be a trusted voice in the room with our clients.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and architect end-to-end AEP implementations, including data ingestion, schema design (XDM), identity resolution, and segmentation strategies
  • Lead solution design sessions, translating business requirements into scalable, best-practice technical implementations
  • Define implementation standards, patterns, and documentation for the AEP ecosystem across client engagements
  • Break down complex technical implementations into clear, manageable tasks, delegating ownership to other developers and team members
  • Conduct peer reviews of other developers' work, providing constructive technical feedback and ensuring quality and consistency
  • Mentor and guide other developers working alongside you on AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and CJA

Hands-On Platform Work

  • Configure and build within Adobe Experience Platform: data streams, datasets, schemas, sources, destinations, and merge policies
  • Implement and manage Real-Time CDP audiences, identity graphs, and activation workflows to downstream channels and platforms
  • Build and optimize customer journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer, including triggers, decisioning logic, and cross-channel orchestration
  • Set up and configure Customer Journey Analytics workspaces, connections, data views, and calculated metrics
  • Collaborate with adjacent developers on integrations with AEM, Target, Marketo, Salesforce, Snowflake, and other ecosystem tools

Client Engagement & Advisory

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for clients, helping them understand platform capabilities, constraints, and best practices
  • Lead and participate in discovery sessions, technical workshops, and solution presentations
  • Recommend implementation approaches based on industry experience, making trade-offs clear and actionable
  • Translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders including marketing, strategy, and product teams
  • Stay current with the Adobe product roadmap and proactively bring relevant updates and opportunities to client conversations

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with strategists, analysts, and creatives to ensure technical solutions support campaign goals and data insights
  • Coordinate with other platform developers (AEM, Salesforce, Target, Marketo) to deliver cohesive, integrated solutions
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and technical discovery as part of an agile delivery team

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of experience working in the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem, with deep, hands-on expertise across AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and CJA
  • Proven ability to architect and implement AEP solutions from the ground up, including XDM schema design, data ingestion pipelines, and identity resolution
  • Experience activating audiences from RTCDP to paid media, email, Adobe Target, and other downstream destinations
  • Hands-on AJO experience building multi-step customer journeys, decisioning, and cross-channel messaging
  • Strong understanding of CJA configuration, including connections, data views, and Analysis Workspace reporting
  • Experience with AEP RESTful APIs and Configuration as Code (CaC) best practices and techniques
  • Experience guiding and reviewing the work of other developers, with a strong eye for implementation quality
  • Comfortable presenting technical solutions and recommendations directly to clients and stakeholders
  • Familiarity with adjacent technologies including AEM, Adobe Target, Salesforce, or other marketing/data platforms

Nice to Have

  • Adobe certifications (e.g., Adobe Certified Expert in RTCDP, CJA or AJO)
  • Experience with data engineering concepts: SQL, ETL pipelines, API integrations, or event streaming
  • Familiarity with web data collection via Adobe Web SDK / alloy.js or Launch/Tags
  • Agency or consultancy background with experience managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
  • Understanding of data privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and how they apply to customer data platforms

Why This Role

  • Work on complex, high-impact engagements across a diverse client portfolio
  • Shape how our practice approaches the Adobe ecosystem – your architecture decisions matter
  • Collaborate with experienced practitioners across the full digital experience stack
  • Grow your craft in a team that values technical depth and client partnership equally

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact
  • Remote flexibility
  • Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking
  • Work that makes a measurable difference for your clients

Why SH/FT:

SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. At SH/FT you'll shape the future of how organizations connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable systems, and the power of data-driven strategy.

Comp & Benefits

The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000+. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

raw.excerpt: GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence.
raw.description:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, we deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.

ABOUT THE DATA TEAM

The Data Science team at GenLogs transforms raw observational data from the our sensor network into high-value intelligence used by law-enforcement agencies, regulators, ports, and private-sector freight operators. We build models, analytics, and measurement frameworks that enable vehicle detection, entity resolution, behavioral insights, fraud and theft indicators, compliance signals, and network-wide operational performance metrics. Our work sits at the center of our platform, shaping how billions of roadside observations become actionable information. We partner closely with Engineering and Product to deploy algorithms at scale and with Go-to-Market teams to define customer-facing analyses that drive real operational outcomes. The team blends statistical rigor, ML capability, and domain expertise to create a new standard for freight intelligence in the United States.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own computer-vision problems end to end from the photons entering a roadside camera to the structured vehicle intelligence delivered by our platform.

This is not a role where you train a model, publish an evaluation, and hand it to another team to productionize. You will be responsible for understanding the entire system: camera placement and configuration, image quality, training data, model architecture, edge inference, production deployment, monitoring, and downstream outcomes.

Our operating environment is unforgiving. Trucks move at highway speeds through darkness, glare, rain, snow, occlusion, extreme perspectives, and inconsistent connectivity. Models must run reliably on constrained edge hardware across a geographically distributed sensor network. Improvements that look promising offline must survive actual roadside conditions and measurably improve the intelligence our customers receive.

You will have the autonomy to attack these problems wherever the evidence leads. One day that may mean designing a better OCR or detection model. The next may mean profiling a TensorRT pipeline, diagnosing video compression artifacts, redesigning an evaluation dataset, or working with field teams to change exposure, shutter speed, lighting, or camera positioning.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t stop at “the model works.” You own the outcome.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  1. Own computer-vision capabilities from initial problem definition through field deployment and sustained production performance.
  2. Build systems for vehicle detection, tracking, OCR, attribute extraction, embedding generation, and re-identification.
  3. Establish evaluation frameworks that connect model performance to successful vehicle identification and customer outcomes, not merely offline accuracy.
  4. Diagnose failures across the entire imaging pipeline, including camera placement, optics, exposure, lighting, encoding, training data, model behavior, edge compute, and downstream processing.
  5. Develop models and write the production software required to run them reliably at scale.
  6. Optimize multi-model pipelines for latency, throughput, memory utilization, and accuracy on constrained CPU and GPU edge hardware.
  7. Design experiments, analyze failure modes, and make clear decisions about what to improve next.
  8. Build monitoring and feedback loops that reveal model degradation, environmental shifts, hardware issues, and new failure modes.
  9. Work directly with field operations to test camera configurations and validate improvements under real roadside conditions.
  10. Partner with platform and data engineers while remaining accountable for getting your work into production.
  11. Improve annotation strategy, training datasets, and hard-example selection based on observed production failures.
  12. Evaluate new research, determine what is genuinely useful, and translate promising ideas into dependable systems.
  13. Raise the technical standard for computer vision across GenLogs through strong engineering, documentation, and mentorship.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficient in Python, SQL, OpenCV, and PyTorch programming
    • Proficient in fundamental computer vision techniques including planar homography, keypoint detection, perspective projection, epipolar geometry, object tracking, camera calibration (intrinsic/extrinsic parameters), and re-identification
    • Knowledgeable in GPU computing and inference optimization tools including CUDA, ONNX, OpenVINO, and TensorRT
    • Knowledgeable in object detection, segmentation, optical character recognition, signal processing, linear algebra, and Vision Transformer models
    • Experience or interest in geospatial data analysis (e.g., GIS, GeoPandas)
    • Experience with version control systems like Git
    • Experience with linux systems
  • Experience:
    • Minimum 4 years of professional experience in computer vision, data science, or research
    • Hands-on experience with applied computer vision techniques, especially on edge hardware
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
    • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE

At GenLogs, ownership does not end when a pull request is merged or a model artifact is produced.

If a model performs well offline but fails in the field, you investigate why. If inference is too slow, you profile and optimize it. If image quality is limiting performance, you work with the people configuring and installing the cameras. If the available data cannot answer the question, you help define what needs to be collected. If production metrics do not reflect the real outcome, you improve the metrics.

You will have strong partners across Engineering, Data, Product, Hardware, and Field Operations, but you remain accountable for driving the problem to resolution.

We value people who cross boundaries, follow evidence, and finish what they start.

WHO WILL SUCCEED HERE

You will thrive here if you:

  • Own outcomes, not artifacts: your responsibility does not end with a trained model, a notebook, or a pull request.
  • Follow problems across boundaries: you will move between research, data, production software, hardware, and field operations when the problem requires it.
  • Are comfortable being the expert in the room: you can form a point of view, defend it with evidence, and make consequential technical decisions.
  • Operate well without a playbook: many of our hardest problems do not have established benchmarks or obvious solutions.
  • Prefer reality over elegant abstractions: you care whether the system works on a dark highway in the rain, not merely whether it performs well on a curated dataset.
  • Build durable systems: you consider monitoring, failure recovery, maintainability, and operational performance part of the work.
  • Have urgency without sacrificing rigor: you iterate quickly, measure honestly, and know when the evidence is strong enough to ship.
  • Finish the job: when something fails, you stay with it until the underlying problem is understood and resolved.

US SALARY RANGE

GenLogs establishes compensation based on role, level, experience, and location. Salary bands are benchmarked against high-growth technology companies and adjusted for market conditions. Equity grants are included in most full-time offers to ensure every team member participates in the company’s long-term value creation. A recruiter will provide a precise range during the hiring process.

BENEFITS

  • Employer-covered comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Employer contribution towards premiums of optional higher-end plans

Time Off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Sick leave
  • Company holidays (GenLogs observes all US Government holidays)
  • Flexible leave for caregiving and medical needs

Family Support

  • Paid parental leave

Professional Development

  • Budget availability for approved professional development courses, certifications, and training

Travel Support

  • 100% travel reimbursement for all approved company travel and spending

Retirement Savings

  • 401(k) plan (US based employees)

Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.

Why you will love this opportunity as a LiveOps Engineer at Civica

Our LiveOps team sits at the front line of this mission: monitoring systems, responding to incidents, and continuously improving the automation and observability that keep our services healthy. Every action you take directly contributes to the stability and trust our customers depend on.

As a LiveOps Engineer, you will help operate, monitor, and enhance Civica’s production and cloud environments. Working closely with SRE, Platform, and Development teams, interfacing with the support and services teams, you will support uptime, automation, and observability improvements that make our services more reliable. You’ll contribute to incident response, environment management, and the ongoing evolution of how Civica delivers and supports its software in the cloud.

Working closely with SRE, Platform, and Development teams, you will help detect, troubleshoot, and resolve live issues; while also contributing to the continuous improvement of our monitoring, deployment, and incident management practices.

You will participate in an on-call rotation, respond to production alerts, and you will play a key role in maintaining Civica’s high standards for reliability, performance, and customer experience.

What you will be doing:

  • Automation and operational efficiency: Automate environment builds, deployments, and day-to-day operational tasks using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, or Bash. Reduce manual intervention and help improve speed, consistency, and resilience.
  • Cloud and infrastructure operations: Support and maintain our environments across Azure, AWS, and VMware. Work with containerised workloads (Docker, Kubernetes) and contribute to scaling and performance improvements.
  • Continuous improvement: Capture learnings from incidents and partner with SREs and developers to drive root cause analysis (RCA) and preventative action. Help refine alerting thresholds, deployment processes, and monitoring coverage.
  • Collaboration and documentation: Work closely with engineers across teams to maintain runbooks, document operational standards, and ensure knowledge is shared and applied consistently across Civica’s cloud services.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting or automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Go/Python).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and fluent with version control (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Experienced with monitoring and alerting solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, Elastic, Azure Monitor).
