raw.description:
What you would be taking on

This is an opportunity to get into healthcare technology and work at a fast pace, using AI to speed up how we design, build and deliver.


In this role, you would be the person who makes sure we build the right thing the first time. You would connect the business and technology teams across our enterprise applications, with Salesforce at the center. You would lead requirements, process analysis and backlog management across Salesforce, Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud and Boomi integrations. We are looking for a strong analyst first: someone with deep Salesforce experience who applies the same approach to any system.

Why this role

  • Shape what gets built. You would own backlog readiness, so the work our developers pick up starts with your problem statement, your requirements and your acceptance criteria.
  • See the whole business. You would work with Sales, Finance, Professional Services, Customer Success and Marketing, and follow processes like quote-to-cash and the customer lifecycle across every system they touch.
  • Be part of big changes. We are rethinking quote-to-cash, including a move from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud. You would help design how it works.
  • Learn more than one platform. Salesforce is the center, but you would also work with Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud and Boomi.
  • Use AI every day. You would have AI tools to draft requirements, map processes and analyze data faster, so more of your time goes to the analysis that needs a person.
  • Set the standard. You would define how we write requirements and documentation, and help the rest of the team follow it.
  • Work that matters in healthcare. Veradigm builds technology used by physician practices, health plans and life sciences companies. The systems you improve keep that work running.

What you will do

  • Manage the intake of business requests: clarify the problem, define scope, assess business value and prepare the work for the delivery backlog.
  • Run requirements sessions with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Professional Services, Customer Success and Marketing.
  • Document current-state and future-state business processes, and identify gaps, risks and improvements.
  • Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows in Jira, and maintain supporting documentation in Confluence.
  • Own backlog readiness. Make sure work is well-defined, prioritized and ready before sprint planning.
  • Take part in Agile Scrum ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
  • Work with developers, admins and QA through delivery. Answer requirements questions, support testing and confirm solutions meet acceptance criteria.
  • Analyze cross-system processes and data flows, such as quote-to-cash, professional services delivery and customer lifecycle, across Salesforce, Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight and Boomi integrations.
  • Help prioritize work by bringing data, business impact and tradeoffs to stakeholders.
  • Set and maintain requirements and documentation standards. Guide stakeholders and other contributors to follow them.
  • Influence stakeholders at all levels. Push back constructively on incomplete, conflicting or low-value requests.
  • Support user acceptance testing, release communications and change management.

What we need

All of these are required:

  • 4+ years of business analysis experience with enterprise business applications.
  • 3+ of hands-on business analysis on Salesforce, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or CPQ.
  • Proven ability to apply business analysis skills across multiple platforms and quickly learn new systems.
  • Strong experience in Agile Scrum environments, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience with process mapping and documentation, such as BPMN, swimlane diagrams, Visio or Lucidchart.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

What helps

  • Salesforce Business Analyst or Administrator certification.
  • Experience with Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud or other SaaS business applications.
  • Understanding of integration concepts and middleware, such as Boomi or MuleSoft, including data mapping and system dependencies.
  • Experience with quote-to-cash, revenue operations, professional services or customer success processes.
  • Basic SQL or reporting skills for data analysis.
  • Healthcare technology or regulated-industry experience.
  • CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA or Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) certification.

Compensation Range:

$84,520-$117,483

Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate’s unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates’ unique contributions and support their professional growth.

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work and to further their professional development. Together, we are In the Network. Interested in learning more?

You’ll be diving deep into web and desktop applications, hunting down game-level vulnerabilities, and collaborating closely with our Architects, Studio, Slots, and Platform Developers to engineer more resilient systems.

Mechanical Design Drafter

Location: Severna Park, MD (Remote/Hybrid Options Available) Start Date: ASAP

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Drafter to perform Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) drafting services for federal clients. This role will support design-build and design-bid-build projects using AutoCAD and REVIT software. The ideal candidate will provide highly competent drafter with technical excellence working with senior Professional Engineers (PEs).

Role on the Team

Reporting to the Project Manager, the Drafter will be responsible for developing/producing technical engineering drawings. Drafter will interact with other disciplines, working in BIM/CAD to execute designs, developing drawings, and incorporating specification edits. PEs will provide Drafter with guidance on code compliance, design parameters, and calculations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft drawings for MEP requirements based on input from PEs, including room type(s) and code requirement(s), zones, etc.
  • Prepare technical drawings, specifications, and submittals to ensure installation and operations conform to drafting/drawing codes, standards, and customer requirements.
  • Operate independently in engineering/design software to perform drafting tasks, drawings, specifications, etc.
  • Review and incorporate load calculations from PEs.
  • Review and incorporate equipment from PEs.
  • Review and incorporate specifications from PEs for purchases of materials or equipment.
  • Confer with engineers, customers, or others to discuss project submittal requirements .
  • Compile data and write reports regarding existing or potential mechanical engineering studies or projects.
  • Support project production efforts to ensure projects are on time and within budget.
  • Perform pre-bid site walks to identify requirements for price proposals as required.
  • Perform post-award site investigations to gather information prior to designs or studies as required.

Qualifications

Education & Client Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of general experience in MEP drafting/design.
  • 5+ years of MEP engineering drafting/design experience on Federal Government A/E projects with federal agencies (USACE, NAVFAC, VA, USDA, DHA, USACE Huntsville MST, USACE Little Rock MST, USACE Mobile MST, VA, etc.).
  • Technical Expertise
  • Experience with industry-standard software (i.e. Revit, CAD, Bluebeam, etc.)
  • Drafting/design experience using UFCs, WBDG, USACE Huntsville Design Guide, or others.
  • Proficient with MEP engineering principles, practices, process, design/build, and the application to permitting and project work-related issues.
  • Experience with MEP planning, design, and construction management; including active involvement in a variety of renovation, new design, and construction projects.
  • Specific knowledge of relevant engineering and MEP construction laws, codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.
  • Ability to review or make technical computations and calculations involving the application of Mechanical engineering principles, understanding plans and specifications, and making factual comparisons to the appropriate regulations.

Travel & Work Arrangement

· Remote

Salary: $90k - $115k

raw.description:
The Co-Head of Engineering is responsible for leading Oakwell's engineering practice alongside the firm's existing engineering leadership — setting technical direction, upholding the highest standards of engineering rigor, and serving as the senior-most technical voice in front of Oakwell's hospital and university clients. This is a leadership-of-leaders role: the Co-Head guides senior engineers and discipline leads across mechanical, electrical, and energy engineering, builds the systems and standards by which the practice operates, and is accountable for the quality, profitability, and growth of Oakwell's engineering work.

The Co-Head is a client-facing principal who brings established, senior-level relationships within major health systems and universities — including at their current clients — and who knows how to cultivate those relationships into long-term partnerships. They translate an owner's mission, financial constraints, and campus master plan into multi-decade infrastructure and decarbonization strategies, and they earn the trust of C-suite and facilities leadership through candor, reliability, and demonstrable results.

This role is structured for a vesting co-owner of the business. The Co-Head of Engineering should expect to hold and vest into equity in Oakwell and to think and act like an owner — investing in the firm's people, reputation, and long-term enterprise value rather than in any single project, and comfortably leading other leaders.

Key Responsibilities

Practice Leadership & Ownership
  • Co-lead the engineering practice with firm leadership, setting technical strategy, staffing, and standards across the mechanical, electrical, and energy disciplines.
  • Operate as a vesting co-owner — accountable for the practice's profitability, growth, and long-term enterprise value, and personally invested in Oakwell's reputation and people.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop senior engineers and discipline leads, building succession and deepening the firm's technical bench.
Client & Relationship Leadership
  • Serve as the senior technical relationship owner for Oakwell's largest hospital and university clients, engaging C-suite and facilities leadership directly.
  • Shape multi-decade infrastructure-renewal and decarbonization strategies aligned with each owner's mission, financial constraints, and campus master plan.
  • Represent Oakwell in high-stakes pursuits, presentations, and negotiations, converting senior relationships into long-term partnerships.
Engineering Rigor & Standards
  • Own the firm's QA/QC program, ensuring reports, drawings, specifications, and analyses meet Oakwell's higher technical standard before issuance.
  • Establish and maintain the MEP building and sustainability standards used across client engagements.
  • Provide senior technical review and final engineering judgment on the firm's most complex and highest-risk projects.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or a related engineering discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • 20+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant experience serving hospital and/or university clients.
  • Established, senior-level relationships at current healthcare and/or higher-education clients.
  • Professional Engineering (PE) license.
  • Demonstrated experience leading other leaders and running an engineering team, practice, or firm.

POSITION SUMMARY:The Associate Account Executive (AAE) is a remote-based sales position supporting multiple local field Account Executive teams. You will perform various business development and sales activities including quality lead-generation via prospecting, list-building, and closing self-prospected opportunities to contribute to team and company goals.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Primary focus is to make outbound cold calls to prospective customers for interest in products provided by Republic Services that generate quality leads and close sales.

  • Work with Account Executive (AE) team to facilitate and resource targeted lead lists.

  • Facilitate AE team huddles by BU in conjunction with the Sales Manager to focus on lead feedback and results.

  • Utilizes the Company’s Salesforce CRM tool to accurately track leads, opportunities, customer records, reporting and all other information to properly use the system as trained.

  • On a daily basis, tracks prospects, identifies decision makers, timelines, and enters data accurately and consistently into Salesforce as trained or required.

  • Utilize Salesforce phone software to log customer calls both inbound and outbound for accurate call activity.

  • Manage sales leads and opportunities in Salesforce to accurately reflect opportunity stage forecasting.

  • Strong time management skills, providing schedules and calendars to AE team for lead calling and coordinating with AEs.

  • Collaborate and share with AAE Team for best practices for overall team success.

  • Attends sales meetings and/or training and maintains open communication with sales team members to maintain current understanding of all company products and services.

  • Participates in learning and training opportunities when appropriate to continuously build sales knowledge, skills and abilities.

  • Participate in team-focused calling initiatives based on the needs of the of the area.

  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned or apparent.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Outstanding interpersonal communication, organizational and time-management skills.

  • Resourceful with proactive problem-solving capabilities.

  • Self-starter who is detail-oriented and able to multi-task.

  • Quick learner with ability to utilize various computer applications and Salesforce CRM platform.

  • Ability to be flexible and contribute to overall goals of the team.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong presentation skills and the ability to produce high quality, error free work in a fast-paced work environment.

  • Relationship building experience and abilities.

  • Proven track record of success working collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 0 - 2 years of experience in sales or a customer-facing role that includes identifying and addressing customer needs.

Rewarding Compensation and Benefits

Eligible employees can elect to participate in:
• Comprehensive medical benefits coverage, dental plans and vision coverage.
• Health care and dependent care spending accounts.

• Short- and long-term disability.

• Life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment insurance.
• Employee and Family Assistance Program (EAP).
• Employee discount programs.
• Retirement plan with a generous company match.

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).

• Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Benefits:

The statements used herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by an employee in this position, and are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required by an incumbent so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the Company.

EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

The team partners closely with Product, Content Development, Production, Digital, Assessment, vendors, and other stakeholders to deliver content that is pedagogically strong, commercially relevant, and aligned with Pearson standards.

You will take ownership of content development delivery, working with Project Managers, authors, external suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams to ensure high pedagogical and quality standards while navigating dependencies, changing requirements, tight timelines, and delivery risks. About Peach

Peach is a modern loan management and servicing platform empowering lenders to launch and scale new lending programs. We provide a fully integrated, configurable system of record with API-first architecture, enabling lenders to bring products to market quickly while maintaining full compliance and operational efficiency.

Peach is a rapidly scaling B2B SaaS platform. We are on a mission to scale to $100M ARR in the next few years. As we enter this next chapter, product will play a critical role in shaping our market position, amplifying our voice, and driving accelerated growth.

About the role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead the next generation of financial products and features at Peach. This is a cross-functional role focused on building and scaling lending capabilities within servicing, collections, and compliance workflows. You’ll define product roadmap, lead execution, and help shape how a new set of features is applied across the Peach platform.

You’ll work closely with engineering, customer experience, legal, compliance, and clients to deliver impactful, production-ready solutions.

Describe the role and team the candidate will be joining

What you'll do

  • Translate operational workflows and lender pain points into clear feature requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, data, operations, legal/compliance) to design, build, and ship features.
  • Work closely with legal and compliance teams to ensure all solutions meet regulatory, audit, and explainability standards.
  • Instrument lending servicing features for performance measurement (accuracy, deflection, compliance rates, etc.) and drive continuous iteration.
  • Act as the internal evangelist for new capabilities, providing product expertise to operations, customer success, and clients.
  • Stay ahead of emerging AI capabilities and vendor landscape to inform the roadmap.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in fintech, credit, lending, payments, or similar regulated domains.
  • Track record of leading cross-functional teams and shipping in regulated environments.
  • Strong analytical skills (SQL fluency, experimentation, metrics definition).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across technical and business audiences.
  • Comfort balancing strategic vendor partnerships with hands-on product development.
  • Obsession for operational detail, scalability, and compliance.

Nice to have:

  • Understanding of lending servicing or collections workflows.
  • Experience building or launching AI-powered products, ideally involving Agentic AI, NLP, chat/voice automation, or compliance tools.
  • Prior engineering or data experience.

U.S. Work Authorization Statement:

Peach is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H-1B) for this role, now or in the future. All applicants must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the United States on a full-time, permanent, and unrestricted basis.

Important Note on Job Scams

At Peach, we are committed to ensuring a safe and secure recruitment process for all candidates. We are aware of the potential for fraudulent job postings and scams. Please be advised of the following:

Official Communication: All official communication from Peach regarding your application will come exclusively from a verified email address. We will never use a generic email service (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo) or a messaging app like Telegram or WhatsApp for interviews or job offers.

Initial Interview Step: The first step of our interview process is always a scheduled phone call from our Senior Recruiter. We will not begin the interview process with an online chat, text message, or other non-standard methods.

Requests for Money: Peach will never ask for payment, personal financial details, or bank information as part of our recruitment process. Any such request is fraudulent and should be reported immediately.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of a job posting or communication, please check our official careers page at or contact us directly at our corporate website."

Peach Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including, but not limited to: Race, Color, National Origin, or Ancestry, Religion or Creed (including all aspects of religious belief, observance, and practice), Sex/Gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), Gender Identity or Gender Expression (including Transgender Status), Sexual Orientation, Physical or Mental Disability (including HIV/AIDS and Cancer), Age (40 and over), Marital Status, Genetic Information (including a refusal to submit to a genetic test), Veteran or Military Status (including uniformed service), Medical Condition (as defined under California law), Political Affiliation or Activity, Status as a Victim of Domestic Violence, Assault, or Stalking.

Employment decisions at Peach are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We prohibit retaliation against any person who files a complaint, assists with an investigation, or opposes discrimination.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities or religious beliefs.
